sanskrit: guruñca jñānadātāraṃ kṛṣṇānandena dhīmatāguruśiṣyayoḥgururityabhidhīyatebrāhmaṇottamaḥ | tapasvī satyavādī ca gṛhastho gururucyatesa yāti nakaraṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā viphalā bhavetśāpamavāpnuyātvāmanaḥ | kunakhī śyāvadantaśca strījitaścādhikāṅgakaḥ(vihīnaḥ pāṭhāntara) yaḥ sa guruḥ śiṣyasammataḥkriyāhīnaṃ śaṭhañcāpi vāmanaṃ gurunindakamguruṃ tantreṇa varjayetvāmanastathā | ityādyapi bodhyamitidānadhyānaparāyaṇdīnāyācāraśūnyāya yantradveṣaparāya cagurubhaktivihīnāya na deyā malināya cakṛpaṇāstatathā | daridrā rogiṇo ruṣṭā rāgiṇo bhogalālasāḥanyāyopārjitadhanāḥ paradāraratāśca yebhraṣṭācārāśca ye kaṣṭavṛttayaḥ piśunāḥ khalāḥparityājyāḥ śiṣyatvenopakalpitāḥgurutā śiṣyatā vāpi tayorvatsaravāsataḥ| svapne tū niyamo na hīti nāradavacanāttathā śiṣyārjjitaṃ pāpaṃ guruḥ prāpnoti niścitamśiṣyayogyatāna hi devāḥ prasīdanti kalau cānya vidhānataḥteṣāmāgamamārgeṇa siddhirna śrautavartmanāteṣā bhidā na karttavyā yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣāvyākhyāṃ prabhutvañca guroragre parityajetna kuryādguruṇā sārddhaṃ śiṣyo bhūtvā kadācanaukārācchivatādātmyaṃ dadyāditi guruḥ smṛtaḥandhakāranirodhitvādgururityabhidhīyatekulārṇave sarvaśātrārthavettā ca gṛhastho gururucyatedaive pitre'rimitre ca gṛhastho deśiko bhavettasya tu | na kadācidbhavet siddhirna mantrairdaivapūjanaiḥkrośamātra sthito bhūtvā guruṃ pratidinaṃ nametekadhā uttarāyaṇe karttavyamsodarasya kaniṣṭhasya vairipakṣāśritasya vāvanavāsinaḥ | viviktāśramiṇo dīkṣā na sā kalyāṇadāyikāsutām | na putrañca tathā bhrātā bhrātaraṃ na ca dīkṣayetdūṣyatīti vacanātsyādbhautike'pi calabhet priye | tadaiva tāntu dīkṣeta tyaktvā guruvicāraṇamprāyaścattantu ayutasāvitrījapaḥ sarvatra darśanātśaṅkha : daśasāhasryajāpena sarvakalmaṣanāśinījyeṣṭhaputrāya dadyādityādimahātrīrthaṃ uparāge sati sarvatra na doṣaḥvaiśampāyanasaṃhitāyāṃ śaunakaṃ prati vyasavacanām| svapnalabdhaṃ striyādattaṃ saṃskāreṇaiva śudhyatimātuścāṣṭaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || idastu gurorupāsitamantraparamyoginītantre strīpadaṃ vidhavāparaṃ ekavākyatābalātnārakī bhavetatkalase prakṣipya uttolya mantraṃ gṛhṇīyādityarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāradavacanāt | tatra siddhādiniyamo nāstikalambāśca kāmbojāścādhamā matāḥtasmāddīkṣati sā proktā munibhistantravedibhiḥsadgatiḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena guruṇā dīkṣito bhavetkurvīttāntrikātgṛhṇāti narādhamaḥ | manvantarasahasreṣu niṣkṛtinaiva jāyatetīrthagamanenā'pi na ca śarīrayantraṇaiḥ92 || tatkṛtaṃ tasya vā śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ yāti hyadhogagimnirayamāpnoti brāhmaṇo yātyadhogatimjānīyāt sa mṛto'dhogacchatidīkṣādhikārī syādanyathā pāpabhāgbhavetyasmāttasmānmantraḥ prakīrtitaḥśodhayetsarveṣu siddhādīnnaiva śodhayetmahāśabdena nīyatevādhitāḥsāmpradāyikāḥāgneyañcāmbahsāṃ ripuḥrāmārcanacandrikādhṛtatvāccaripurmantrādyavarṇa syāttena tasyāhitaṃ bhavetyatnataḥ iti vacanāt | tantrarājaghṛtatvāccasañcitavyayaḥbheditān varṇān revatyaṃśagatān kramātrohiṇī | imāni mānuṣānyāhurnakṣatrāṇi manīṣiṇaḥdevatārakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptamāni nakṣatrāṇi varjanīyānibheditāḥcatuścatukoṣṭhe ṣoḍaśa koṣṭha iti yāvatsampadyante tathā likhetpuṣṇāti poṣako'bhīṣṭaṃ ghātako nā śayed - dhruvamdviguṇādhikāt | tatsiddho grahādeva susiddhāriḥ svagotrahāpatnīghnastadarirhanti sādhakamtat | santyajya tat devatāyāstasyā anyaṃ bhajenmanummānavedibhiḥbhagavāna śivaḥlikhettataḥ | ṛ ṝ varṇadvayaṃ ḷ ḹ taddhi klīvaṃ pracakṣategopālaviṣayakameva | gopāle'ka'kaḍamaḥ smṛta iti vacanātśaivañcākaḍamaṃ smṛtam | iti yāmalīyātgopāle'kaḍamaḥ smṛtaḥdhanaṃ syātmantraḥ śbhado bhavati dhanī cennaītyuktvā ṣaṭkāla - kāla ityuktamtulyaṃ yadā samaphalaḥ kathito mūnīndraiḥtu prāptimātreṇa sarvasaddhistu jāyatetāvatsaṃkhyāṃ saptaguṇaṃ kṛtvā tribhirharetadhikaṃ ṛṇaṃ śeṣaṃ dhanaṃ jñeyaṃyojayet kramātgurṇā yat kṛtaṃ bhavetvadatyanyamanasko'pi tannāma grāhyameva cajapedbudhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smṛtam | kālikāyāśca tārāyāstārācakraṃ śubhāvahammunisattamaiḥṛṇe ca prāptimātreṇa sarvāsiddhistu jāyatedarbhaśayyāṃ pariṣkṛtya śiṣyaṃ tatra niveśayetśiṣyābhimantraṇamyoginītantrāt nānyatraduḥkhaprado nityamevaṃ māsavidhikramaḥdvitīyāyāṃ bhavejjñānaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ śucirbhavetṣaṣṭhyāṃ jñānakṣayaḥ saukhyaṃ labhate saptamīdineaṣṭamyāṃ buddhināśaṃ syānnavamyāṃ vapuṣaḥ kṣayaḥdaśamyāṃ rājasaubhāgyekādaśyāṃ śucirbhavetdvādaśyāṃ sarvaśuddhiḥ syāt trayodaśyā daridratādharmavṛddhiḥ syādasvādhyāyaṃ vivarjayetsandhyāgarjitanirghoṣabhūkampollakānipātanamśaivāgamāntarekṛttikāyāṃ bhavedduḥkhī rohiṇyāṃ vākpatirbhavetpūrvaphalgunyāṃ prānoti ca na saṃśayaḥsutrahāniḥ syānmūlāyāṃ kīrtivarddhanamsaukhyañcottarabhādre ca revatyāṃ kīrtivarddhanampraśasyate | yadīśasya kṛśānorvā mantrārambho yathākramamtatrāmaviṣayamagastyasaṃhitoktatvāttathā yogaḥ sarvatrantre śubhāvahāḥharṣaṇaḥ | varīyāṃśca śivaḥ siddho brahma aindraśca ṣoḍaśaśubhānyeva sarvatantreṣu bhāṣitamcandratārānukūle ca kuryāddīkṣāpravarttanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvisvabhāvataṃ lagnaṃ śaktimantre praśasyatesarvanāśakāḥśuklapakṣe śubhā dīkṣā kṛṣṇe'pyāpañcamaddinātśobhanāśaṅkareṇa ca bhāṣitam| jyeṣṭhe caturdaśī kṛṣṇā āṣāḍhe nāgapañcamīkālavinirṇayaḥśaktiviṣayam || 23 || caturthīti gaṇeśaviṣayaṃ tattatkalpoktatvātsūryaparvaṇi | evaṃ candragrahaṇe'pibhavet | iti yoginīhṛdayāccaathavāpyanurādhāyāṃ revatyāṃ vā praśasyateviśeṣeṇa kārtike ca viśeṣataḥcaturdaśī | saptamī ravivāre ca sūryaparvaśartaḥ samāḥtāsu dīkṣāṃ samācaretśrīgirau kāśyāṃ kālākāṃ na śodhayettithiḥ | kṛtā tāsu budhairdīkṣā sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradāśodhayettridinaspṛśi | tatra lagnādikaṃ kiñcinna vicārya kathañcanaviṣuvāyanayordvandve naiva kiñcidvicārayetśubhāvahāḥguhāsu ca | gaṅgāyāstu taṭe vāpi koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavetgṛhṇīyāttato dīkṣā tīrthaṣveteṣu pārvatidaśaparvasu saṃjapetaṣṭottaraśataviṣayam viṣṇuviṣayañcasamākhyātā sarvatantrapradīpikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: idamapyaṣṭottaraśatādiviṣayam| idamapyaṣṭottaraśataviṣayamviyogācca chidre ca sravate japaḥparvasandhiṣu yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetrākṣasāstena gaṇayet sarvathā budhaḥsudhīḥ | asaṃkhyākārakasyāsya sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalamācchādya vāsasā hastau dakṣiṇena japet sadāyādṛśī mālā saṃkhyāne'pi ca tādṛśīṭu tu pu yu śavoṣṭau prakīrtitāḥityupalakṣaṇamcaramārṇaṃ merurūpaṃ laṅghanaṃ naiva kārayetpratirohataḥśatamayīṃ vargāṣṭakāṣṭottaramlakāradvayaṃ jñeyamitikuśamūlaiśca gṛhasthasyākṣamālikāmokṣañca na dadāti priyaṃkarīprayatnena jananyā jāravat priyeprayacchedvipulaṃ dhanamjape śastā rudrākṣaṃ raktacandanaiḥkarṇanetrāntarasthāsthi mahāśaṅkhaḥ prakīrtitaḥcaturottaraiḥ | aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvasiddhiruktā manīṣibhaḥcelājinakuśottaramiti bhagavadvacanāccapaṭājinakuśottara itiviśedyatirvanasthaśca brahmacārī ca bhikṣukaḥṣaṭkarmasu pratyekaṃ vihitāsanānitanniṣphalaṃ vidyāt kruddhā bhavati devatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: | gopucchasadṛśī mālā yadvā sarpākṛtiḥ śubhāprakalpayet | ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇaṃ grathanādau tu saṃjapetityetābhyāmicchā vikalpaḥnirmāya mālāṃ vai śodhayenmunisattamasadyojātena sajjalaiḥdvijasattamaḥkṛtvā raktapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet | iti śaktiviṣayamaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā sampātājyaṃ vinikṣipetbhavenmṛtyustasmādyatnaparo bhavetgopayedyatnato gṛhīaṃguṣṭhamadhyamāyogāt sarvasiddhiḥ suniścitājyeṣṭhākaniṣṭhāyogena śatruṇāṃ nāśanaṃ matamjapenniṣiddhasaṃsparśaṃ kṣālayitvāyathoditamśataṃ japediti | karabhraṣṭa - chinnayostulyaphalakatvātsampūjya ca guruṃ gṛhṇīyānmālikāṃ śubhāmnaraḥ | tataḥ puraskriyāṃ kuryānmantrasiddhikāmyayātīrthapradeśāḥ sindhunāṃ saṅgamaḥ pāvanaṃ vanamnijālayam | sādhane ca praśastāni sthānānyetāni mantriṇāmcittaṃ prasīdatikoṭirdevālaye puṇyamanantaṃ śivasannidhaujapenmantrī tatra kūrmaṃ vicintayetvāstau gṛhe tañca vicintayetvicārayet | anyathā bhojanāddoṣāt siddhihāniḥ prajāyateprayatnena śastānnāśī bhavennaraḥguḍavarjitam | tilāścaiva sitā mudgāḥ kandaḥ kemukavarjitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paryuṣitañcaiva nisnehaṃ kīṭadūṣitamrasāntaram | kauṭilyaṃ kṣauramabhyaṅgamaniveditabhojanamprajapedyāvattāvanniṣphalamucyatesaṃśayaḥ | tasmāt sarva prayatnena parānnaṃ varjayet sudhīḥsvātvotpādanātsatām | satkulasthānajātanāṃ bhikṣāśī cāgrajanmanāmsparśane'pi ca | evamādīṃśca niyamān puraścaraṇakṛccaretsarvamapavitraṃ bhavet priye| uktasaṃkhyāṃ japaṃ kuryāt puraścaraṇasiddhayebhavennaraḥ| tathā'nāśraminaṃ vipraṃ tathā viśvavinindakamprajapeduktasaṃkhyāyāścaturguṇajapaḥ kalaudvāpare triguṇaṃ proktaścaturguṇajapaḥ kalaujapaniṣṭhā dvādaśaite dharmāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥtathāpi kṛtasaṅkalpovrataṃ naiva parityajetsadā | pratyahaṃ kṣālayet śayyāmekākī nirbhayaḥ svapetjapenmantraṃ bahuvastrākulo'pi vāviniyogavidhāne na bhavedaniyamaḥ kvacityadvā sūryādidarśanam ādisadāvahniṃ brāhmaṇañcatatprakaraṇe viśeṣo draṣṭavyaḥsamantataḥpraśasto japa īritaḥsandhyātraye pūjāṅgatvātjapamaṣṭottaraśatamityarthaḥjapenmauktikahāravatsyādupāṃśuḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smṛtaḥ | upāṃśurnijakarṇasya gocaraḥ parikīrtitaḥuccairjapādviśiṣṭaḥ syādupāṃśurdaśabhirguṇaiḥjihvājapaḥ śataguṇaḥ sahasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥvasukṣayaḥ | akṣarākṣara saṃyuktaṃ japenmauktikahāravatniṣphalaṃ yāti bhinnabhāṇḍodakaṃ yathākevalāḥ | sauṣumnadhvanyuccaritā prabhutvaṃ prāpnuvanti tepūjāhomādibhirvinādhyātvā punaḥ punaḥmārutaḥ | na sidhyati varārohe kalpakoṭiśatairapiparameśvari | saptavāraṃ japenmantraṃ sūtakadvayamuktayekramotkramātsahasrastu tasya siddho bhavenmanuḥsamarpayet | devasya dakṣiṇe haste kuśapuṣpārghyavāribhiḥsaphalaṃ tadvibhāvyaivaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ samācarethomādikamathācaretathavā lakṣasaṃkhyāyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ homamācaretvidhiñcaret | anāśritasya śūdrasya diksaṃkhyākaḥ samīritaḥśūdrasya viprabhabhaktasya tatpatnyāḥ sadṛśo japaḥvaiśyena caturguṇaḥ śūdreṇa pañcaguṇaḥhomādhikāraḥ sa ca brāhmaṇadvārāśrībījamityarthaḥsvakarttṛkahoma iti kecithomamarmaṇi | vahnijāyāṃ parityajya hṛdayāntena homayetsākṣāttatadbhuṅktehariḥ svayamviprabhojane'pyanukalpaḥviprārādhanamātreṇa vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgaṃ bhaveddhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: marddinī pātu satataṃ marddinī rakṣayet sadāmarddinī pātu satataṃ marddinī rakṣayet sadāprabhā pātu maheśāni kanakā sarvadāvatuprabhā pātu mahāmāyā māyā pātu sadā mamnandinī pātu satataṃ suprabhā sarvadāvatuśaktayaḥ pāntu satataṃ mudrāṃ pāntu sadā mamyoginyaḥ pāntu satataṃ khecaryaḥ pāntu sarvadāsarvatra sarvadā pātu devī mahiṣamarddinīyatra tatra na vaktavyaṃ gopitavyaṃ prayatnataḥsarvatra sulabhā vidyā kavacaṃ durlabhaṃ mahatna stavaṃ darśayeddivyaṃ kavacaṃ suradurlabhamdattvā tebhyo maheśāni naśyanti siddhayaḥ kramātaśubhañca bhavet tasya tasmādyatnena gopayetlikhitvā śubhayoge ca brahmendre vaidhṛtau tathāvaṇije śravaṇāyāñca revatyāṃ vā punarvasauaśvinyāṃ vā rohiṇyāṃ vā tṛtīyānavamītithaukuhvāṃ vā pūrṇimāyāṃ vā niśāyāṃ prāntare tathāguruṇā vaiṣṇavaurvapi svayambhūkusumaistathātadā dharenmahārakṣāṃ kavacaṃ sarvakāmadamvādī mūko bhaveddṛṣṭvā rājā ca sevakāyateṣaṇmāsairvā tribhirmāsaiḥ khecaro bhavati dhruvamarogī balavāṃścaiva rājā ca dāsatāmiyātya evaṃ kurute dhīmān sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥyathā tvamacalā kṛṣṇe tathā bhava mayi sthirāpadmā padmālayā sampaduccaiḥ śrīpadmadhāriṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthirā lakṣmīrbhavet tasya putradārādibhiḥ sahayasya vijñānamātreṇa bhavet sākṣātsadāśivaḥsa bhavet pārvatīputraḥ sarvaśāstrapuraskṛtaḥvidyārthibhissadā sevyā kamalā viṣṇuvallabhāhrīṃ pātu cakṣuṣormadhye cakṣuryugme ca śāṅkarīoṣṭhādhāre dantapaṃktau tālumūle hanau punaḥpṛṣṭhadeśe tathā guhye vāme ca dakṣiṇe tathājānucakre padadvandve ghuṭikagulimūlakesarvāṃge pātu kāmeśī mahādevī samunnatiḥṛṣiḥ pātu sadā devi sarvatra śambhuvallabhāramā pātu mahādevī pātu māyā svarāṭ svayamvijayā pātu bhavane jayā pātu sadā mamabhairavī pātu sarvatra bheruṇḍā sarvadā'vatupātu māṃ kālikā nityaṃ kālarātriḥ sadā'vatuyoginyaḥ sarvadā pāntu mudrāḥ pāntu sadā mamasarvatra sarvakāryeṣu sarvakarmasu sarvadāiti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ kavacaṃ sarvasiddhayeśaṭhāya bhaktihīnāya nindakāya maheśvarina stavaṃ darśayeddivyaṃ darśanācchivahā bhavetvaiṣṇavāya viśuddhāya dadyātkavacamuttamamdadyātkavacamityuktaṃ sarvatantrasamanvitamyāvakena likhenmantraṃ sarvacakrasamanvitamsvaśukraiḥ puraśukraiśca nānāgandhasamanvitaiḥsutithau śubhayoge vā śravaṇāyāṃ raverdinepūrvabhādrapadāyoge svātyāṃ maṅgalavāsare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyuṣmatprītiyoge ca brahmayoge viśeṣataḥkaulave bālave caiva vaṇije caiva sattamaḥkumārīṃ pūjayitvā ca yajeddevīṃ sanātanīmghṛtādyaiḥ sopakaraṇaiḥ puṣpadhūpairviśeṣataḥākheṭakamupākhyānaṃ tatra kuryāddinatrayamsa bhavet pārvatīputraḥ sarvaśāstra puraskṛtaḥabhedena yajedyastu tasya siddhiradūrataḥpādanamrakṣitipamukuṭalakṣmīlakṣaṇānāṃ cirāyaprotpluṣṭājñānakūṭe harinijadayite devi saṃsārasāreviśvāntarāle suravaranamite niṣkale nityaśuddhemārgātītaprabhāve bhava mama varadā śārade śubhrahāremātrārddhatattve matimati matide mādhavaprītinādegīrgaurvāgbhāratī tvaṃ kavivṛṣarasanā siddhidā siddhavidyāviśvāntarāle suragaṇanamite niṣkale nityaśuddheśāstre vāde kavittve prasaratu mama dhīrmāstu kuṇṭhā kadācitsaubhāgyaṃ tasya loke prasarati kavitā vighnamastaṃ prayātisārasvato naraḥ pāṭhātsa syādiṣṭārthalābhavānavicchedaṃ paṭheddhīmāndhyātvā devīṃ sarasvatīmvāñchitaṃ phalamāpnoti sa loke nātra saṃśayaḥprayatnena paṭhennityaṃ so'mṛtatvaṃ prayacchatinirantaraṃ nirgatadānatoyaistaṃ naumi vighneśvaramambujābhamnivārayantaṃ nijakarṇatālaiḥ ko vismaretputramanaṅga śatroḥlīlābhirārācchivamarcayantaṃ gajānanaṃ bhaktiyutā bhajantivyomāṅgane te vicaranti tārāḥ kālātmanā mauktikatulyabhāsaḥtvayi kṣaṇaṃ kālagatiṃ vihāya tau prāpatuḥ kandukatāmitendu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devānṛṣonbhaktajanaikamitraṃ herambamarkkāruṇamāśrayāmiśivayorbhajāmitvatto na cānyatpratipādyametaistadāsti cetsarvamasatyakalpamgajānanaṃ yaṃ praviśanti santastatkālayogaistamahaṃ prapadyestutyānayā ye vidhivat stuvanti te sarvalakṣmīnidhayo bhavantipaṭhitvā pāṭhayitvā ca naro mucyate sarvasaṅkaṭātsiddhirna jāyate tasya kalpakoṭiśatairapisammodo bhrūyuge pātu bhrūmadhye ca gaṇādhipaḥgaṇakrīḍānvitaḥ pātu vadane sarvasiddhayevighneśo hṛdaye pātu vighnanāśaśca vakṣasivighnakartā ca udare vighnakartā ca liṅgakelambodaraḥ sadā pātu guhyadeśe mamārunaḥjāpakaḥ sarvadā pātu jānujaṅghegaṇādhipaḥya idaṃ prapaṭhennityaṃ gaṇeśasya maheśvarisarvasiddhikaraṃ sākṣātsarvapāpavimocanamsarvasampatpradaṃsākṣātsarvaśatrukṣayaṃ karampaṭhanāddhāraṇādeva nāśamāyānti tatkṣaṇātsamaṃ nāsti meheśāni trailokye gaṇapasya cakimanyairasadālapairyatrāyurvyayatāmiyāttrailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutamyaddhṛtvā ca mahādevo gaṇanāmadhipo'bhavatevamindrādayaḥ sarve sarvaiśvaryamavāpnuyuḥśrīsūryodevatā cātra sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥpraṇavo me śiraḥ pātu ghṛṇirme pātu bhālakamaṣṭākṣaro mahāmantraḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candrabījaṃ visargāḍhyaṃ pātu me guhyadeśakamśivo vahnisamāyukto vāmākṣivindubhūṣitaḥguhyādguhyataro mantro vāṃchācintāmaṇiḥ smṛtaḥiti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhamkuṣṭhādirogaśamanaṃ mahāvyādhivināśanambahunā kimihoktena yadyanmanasi varttatebhūtapretapiśācāśca yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥdūrādeva palāyante tasya saṃkīrtanādapiravivāre ca saṃkrāntyāṃ saptamyāñca viśeṣataḥtrilohamadhyagaṃ kṛtvā dhārayed dakṣiṇe bhujeiti te kathitaṃ sāmba trailokyamaṅgalābhidhamsiddhirna jāyate tasya kalpakoṭiśatairapibalabhadrarāmamśrīvatsacihnaṃ jagadādimūlaṃ tamālanīlaṃ hṛdi viṣṇumīḍedharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmāptaye puruṣottamamyathā sugrīvamukhyānāṃ yastamugraṃ namāmyahamvibhīṣaṇāyābdhitaṭe yastaṃ vīraṃ namāmyahamstutaṃ jaṭāyunā yena mahāviṣṇuṃ namāmyahamprakāśate svatantro yastaṃ jvalantaṃ namāmyahamrākṣaseśvarayodhānāṃ taṃ vande sarvatomukhamsiṃhaḥ sattveṣvivotkṛṣṭastaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ namāmyahambhiyaṃ tinoti pāpānāṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ tat namāmyahamdadātyeva nijaudāryādyastaṃ bhadraṃ namāmyahamtatrodāhṛtayo bahvayo mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahamtamīśaṃ sarvadevānāṃ namanīyaṃ namāmyaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaje'haṃ pratyahaṃ rāmaṃ sasītaṃ sahalakṣmaṇamśivamayo diśastasya siddhayastasya dāsikāḥpaṭhedanudinaṃ yastu sa rāme bhaktimān bhavetnātaḥ parataraṃ guhyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyateupaviṣṭastato bhoktuṃ pārvatīṃ śaṅkaro'bravīttato bhokṣyāmyahaṃ deva bhujyatāṃ bhavatā prabhodhanyāni kṛtapuṇyāsi viṣṇubhaktāsi pārvatirakārādīni nāmāmi śṛṇvato mama pārvatiiti rāmapadenāsau paraṃ brahmābhidhīyaterāmetyuktvā mahādevi bhuṃkṣṇa sārddhaṃ mayādhunātato bhuktvā mahādevī patinā saha saṃsthitākathyatāṃ mama deveśa tatra me prītiruttamānāmāni rāmabhadrasya sahasranteṣu cādhikamviṣṇorekaikanāmāni sarvavedādhikaṃ phalamtasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ rāmanāmnaiva labhyaterājīvalocanaḥ śrīmān rājendro raghupuṅgavaḥviśvāmitrapriyo dāntaḥ śaraṇatrāṇatatparaḥsatyavrato vrataphalaḥ sadā hanūmadāśrayaḥvibhīṣaṇaparitrātā daśagrīvāśiroharaḥjāmadagnyamahādarpajvalanastāḍakāntakaḥdūṣaṇatriśirohantā trimūrttistriguṇastrayītrilokīrakṣako dhanvī daṇḍākāraṇyapuṇyakṛtjayantatrāṇavaradaḥ sumitrāputrasevitaḥmāyāmārīcahantā ca mahābhogo mahābhujaḥmahāyogī mahodāraḥ sugrīvepsitarājyadaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādipuruṣo mahāpuruṣaḥ paramaḥ puruṣastathāsmitavaktro mitabhāṣī pūrṇabhāṣī ca rāghavaḥmāyāmānuṣacāritro mahādevābhipūjitaḥśyāmāṅgaḥ sundaraḥ śūraḥ pītavāsā dhanurddharaḥśivaliṅgapratiṣṭhātā sarvāghagaṇavarjitaḥparaṃ jyotiḥ paraṃ dhāma parākāṣṭhā parātparaḥityetatrāmabhadrasya nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatamsa sarvairmucyate pāpaiḥ kalpakoṭiśatodbhavaiḥrājāno dāsatāṃ yānti vahnyo yānti saumyatāmaṇugraha grahā yānti nāśamāyāntyapadravāḥjñānenāpi ca kuvarṇo na sa pāpena lipyatetatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ stavenānena labhyatevaikuṇṭhe vāsamāpnoti daśapūrvairdaśāparaiḥstuvanti nāmabhirdivyairna te saṃsāriṇī narāḥraghunāthāya nāthāya sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥsarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyātkathitaṃ tava gāṅgeya yatastvaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥjānakīhṛdayānandacandanaṃ raghunandanamsvalīlayā jagattrātumāvirbhūtamajaṃ vibhumrāmarakṣāṃ paṭhet prājñaḥ pāpaghnī sarvakāmadāmśrīrāmacandro devatā śrīrāmacandra prītyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥkauśaleyo dṛśau pātu viśvāmitrapriyaḥ śrutījihvāṃ vidyānidhiṃ pātu kaṇṭhaṃ bharatavanditaḥkarau sītāpatiḥ pātu hṛdayaṃ jāmadagnyajitpārśvo kulapatiḥ pātu kukṣimikṣvākunandanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guhyaṃ jitendriyaḥ pātu pṛṣṭha pātu raghūttamaḥuru raghūttamaḥ pātu rakṣaḥ kulavināśakṛtpādau vibhīṣaṇaśrīdaḥ pātu rāmā'khilaṃ vapuḥsa cirāyuḥ sukho putrī vijayī vinayī bhavetna draṣṭumapi śaktāste rakṣitaṃ rāmanāmabhiḥnaro na lipyate pāpairbhukti muktiñcavindatiyaḥ kare dhārayet tasya karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥkṛtvā vai dhārayedyastu so'bhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyātbahvapatyā jīvavatsā sā bhavennātra saṃśayaḥavyāhatājñaḥ sarvatra labhate jayamaṅgalamtathā likhitavān prātaḥ prabuddho budhakauśikaḥvīrau māṃ pathi rakṣetāṃ vāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇaupuṇḍarīkaviśālākṣau cīrakṛṣṇājināmbarauputrau daśarathasyaitau bhrātarau rāmakṣmaṇaurakṣaḥkulanihantārau trāyetāṃ vo raghūttamauyacchanmanorathañcāsmān rāmaḥ pātu salakṣmaṇaḥdhanuṣmantau saśarau rāmalakṣmaṇaukākutsthaḥ puruṣaḥ pūrṇaḥ kauśaleyo raghūttamaḥjānakīvallabhaḥ śrīmānaprameyaparākramaḥpurato mārutiryasya taṃ namāmi raghūttamamguṇābhirāmaṃ śrīrāmaṃ bhūyo bhūyo namāmyahamaśvamedhāyutaṃ puṇya sa prāpnoni na saṃśayaḥtavāṃghripaṅkajarajorāgiṇīṃ bhaktimuttamāmaprameya prasīdāsmadduḥkhahan puruṣottamaacintyasāra viśvātman prasīda parameśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasīda guṇagambhīra gambhīrāṇāṃ mahādyuteprasīdārdrārdrajātīnāṃ prasīdāntāntayāyināmjaya mādhava māyātman jaya śāśvata śaṅkhabhṛtjaya cakragadāpāṇe jaya deva janārdanajaya pakṣipaticchāyāniruddhārkakarāruṇanamaste lalitāpāṅga namaste narakāntakanamaḥ sambhṛtasarvātman namaḥ sambhṛtakaustubhanamo vibhinnaveśāya namaḥ śrutipathātigaviṣṇave tridaśārātijiṣṇave paramātmaneviśvāya viśvavandyāya viśvabhūtānuvartinebhaktipriyāya bhaktānāṃ namaste muktidāyinedeveśa karma sarvaṃ me bhavedārādhanaṃ tavajananamṛtivimuktāmuttamāṃ muktimetigopairīḍyaṃ gosahasrairnaumi gokulanāyakamdharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmaptaye puruṣottamamvallavīnandanaṃ vande kṛṣṇaṃ gopālarūpiṇamkadambakusumodvaddhavanamālāvibhūṣitamsthūlamuktāphalodārahāradyotitavakṣasammandamārutasaṃkṣobhavalgitāmbarasañcayamlasadgopālikāceto mohayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥkṣobhayantaṃ manastāsāṃ sasmerāpāṅgavīkṣaṇaiḥvicitrāmbarabhūṣābhirgopanārībhirāvṛtamkadambapādapacchāye sthitaṃ vṛndāvane kvacitkalpapādamadhyastha hemamaṇḍapikāgatamgovarddhanagirau ramye sthitaṃ rāsarasotsukam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khaṇḍitākhaṇḍatonmuktamuktāsāraghanāghanamsavatsairunmukhaiḥ śaśvadgokulairabhivīkṣitamdaṇḍapāśodyatakarairgopālairupaśobhitamprītisusnigdhayā vācā stūyamānaṃ parātparamtrisandhyaṃ tasya tuṣṭo'sau dadāti varamīpsitamacalāṃ śriyamāpnoti sa vāgmī jāyate dhruvamtrailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kṛpayā kathaya prabhonārāyaṇena kathitaṃ kṛpayā brahmaṇe purāatiguhyataraṃ tattvaṃ brahmamantraughavigrahamyaddhṛtvā paṭhanāt pāti mahālakṣmīrjagattrayamtrailokyajananī durgā mahiṣādimahāsurānevamindrādayaḥ sarve sarveśvaryamavāpnuyuḥśiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya sādhakāya prakāśayettrailokyamaṅgalasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥdharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥbhālaṃ me netrayugalamaṣṭārṇo bhuktimuktidaḥklīṃ kṛṣṇāya sadā ghrāṇaṃ govindāyeti jihvikāmaṣṭādaśākṣaro mahāmatraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ pātu daśākṣaraḥhṛdayaṃ bhuvaneśāni klīṃ kṛṣṇāya karau stanau mamaklīṃ kṛṣṇāya sadā pātu pārśvayugmaṃ manūttamaḥaṣṭākṣaraḥ pātu nābhiṃ kṛṣṇeti dvyakṣaro'vatusakthinīṃ satataṃ pātu śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇaṭhadvayamśrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ padato gopījanavallabhapadaṃ tataḥjānunī ca sāda pātu hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ ca daśākṣaraḥaṣṭādaśākṣaro hrīṃ-śrīṃ-pūrvako viṃśadarṇakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣīrakhaṇḍādya bhojyaiśca bahumānapuraḥsaramsaha | evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī sādhayetsakalepsitānsparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥsandeho japasya phalabhāgbhavetsamāhitaḥmantrasya jāyate siddhiruttamāsarvasamañjasamtataḥ | athavā taddaśāṃśena homādīṃśca samācaretsyāddevatā ca prasīdatisa yāti parameśāni narakānekaviṃśatimkevalajapamātrapuraścaraṇe kṛte nādhikāra iti sarvasammatamcācaretpraśasyate | grahaṇe ca mahātrīrthe na kālamavadhārayetpañcopacāraiḥ pūjayet | evaṃkrameṇa anyānapi pūjayetvedikāmadhye pañcopacārairgaṇeśaṃ pūjayetsnānādikaṃ kṛtvā svastivācanapūrvakaṃ saṅkalpaṃ kuryātmadhyandinaṃ yāvatjapaṃ kuryāt | tato homastatastarpaṇamsnānaprakaraṇe vaktavyamabhiṣiñcatsvamūrddhānaṃ toyaiḥ kumbhākhyamudrayātato'cchidrāvadhāraṇaṃ kuryātpuraścaraṇaprayogaḥsiddhidāyakamśaive bhasma samākhyātaṃ mātṛkāyantralekhanevaṃ vidikṣu ṭhaṃ likhetmātṛkāyantram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namo bhagavate paścādvāsudevāya tatparamhrīṃ śrīṃ daśākṣaro mantro dakṣiṇe māṃ sadā'vatusvāheti ṣoḍaśārṇo'yaṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ diśi rakṣatuaṣṭādaśārṇaḥ kāmānto vāyavye māṃ sadā'vatudvādaśārṇātmako viṣṇuruttare māṃ sadā'vatuśrīṃ gopījanavallabhānte bhāya svāhā karau tataḥkāliyasya phaṇāmadhye divyaṃ nṛtyaṃ karoti tamdvātriṃśadakṣaro mantro'pyadho māṃ sarvadā'vatutanno'naṅgaḥ pracodayādeṣā māṃ pātu cordhvataḥtrailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavaca brahmarūpakamtava snehānmayā'khyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacitsakṛddvistriryathājñānaṃ sa hi sarvatapomayaḥśatamaṣṭottaraṃ cāsya puraścaryāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥyadi syātsiddhakavaco viṣṇureva bhavet svayamspardhāmuddhūya satataṃ lakṣmīrvāṇī vaset tataḥdaśavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyātkaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so'pi viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥmahādānāni yānyeva prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathākavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥidaṃ kavacamajñātvā yajedyaḥ puruṣottamamśatalakṣaṃ prajapto'pi na mantrastasya siddhyatimahāviṣṇornṛsiṃhasya kavacaṃ brūhi me prabhokavacaṃ narasiṃhasya trailokyavijayābhidhamsraṣṭāhaṃ jagatāṃ vatsa paṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥpaṭhanāddhāraṇāddevā babhūvuśca digīśvarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yasya prasādāddurvāsāstrailokyavijayī bhavetṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī nṛsiṃho devatā vibhuḥkṣrauṃ bījaṃ me śiraḥ pātu candravarṇo mahāmanuḥnṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahamkaṇṭhaṃ pātu dhruvaṃ kṣrauṃ hṛdbhagavate cakṣuṣī mamadīptadaṃṣṭrāya ca tathāgninetrāya ca nāsikāmsarvajvaravināśāya daha daha padadvayamtārādirāmacandrāya namaḥ pātu hṛdaṃ mamanārāyaṇāya nābhiṃ ca āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ kṣrauṃ ca huṃ phaṭvāsudevāya ca pṛṣṭhaṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya ūrudvayamklī glauṃ klīṃ śyāmalāṅgāya namaḥ pāyātpadadvayamiti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigrahamgurupūjāṃ vidhāyātha gṛhṇīyātkavacaṃ tataḥśatamaṣṭottaraṃ cāsya puraścaryāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥtatastu siddhakavacaḥ puṇyātmā madanopamaḥpuṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ dattvā mūlenaiva paṭhetsakṛtbhūrje vilikhya guṭikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayedyadiyoṣidvāmabhuje caiva puruṣo dakṣiṇe karekākavandhyā ca yā nārī mṛtavatsā ca yā bhavetkavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥbhūtapretapiśācāśca rākṣasā dānavāśca yetaddeśaṃ tu parityajya prayānti hyatidūrataḥsarvabhūtāntarasthāya śaṅkarāya namo namaḥatīndriyāya mahase śāśvatāya namonamaḥbhavāya bhavasambhūtaduḥkhahantre namo'stu te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturvargavadānyāya sarvajñāya namonamaḥyogidhyeyāya mahate nirguṇāya namonamaḥkandarpadarpanāśāya kālahantre namo'stusaridvāmasamābaddhakapardāya namonamaḥpurāntakāya pūrṇāya puṇyanāmne namonamaḥvivāsase'vivāsāya viśvena śāstre namonamaḥtridhāmnādhāmarūpāya janmaghnāya namonamaḥkāntāya nijakāntāyai dattārddhāya namonamaḥbhaktimuktipradaṃ bhaktyā sarvajñaṃ parameśvaramaihikaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tatra muktireva kare sthitāsarvaṃ me kathitaṃ deva kavacaṃ na prakāśitamsarvarakṣākaraṃ deva yadi snehe'sti māṃ pratisādhakābhīṣṭasiddhau ca viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥoṃ śiro me sarvadā pātu prāsādākhya sadāśivaḥaṣṭākṣaraḥ śaktiruddhaścakṣuṣī me sadāvatumṛtyuñjayastrivījātmā āyu rakṣatu me sadāsadā māṃ sarvataḥ pātu ṣaṭtriṃśārṇasvarūpadhṛktrivarṇātmā nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rakṣatu sarvadāsadā rakṣatu me guhyaṃ sarvasampatpradāyakaḥmārtaṇḍabhairavī nityaṃ pādau me parirakṣatusadā māṃ raṇabhūmau ca rakṣatu tridaśādhipaḥdakṣiṇasyāṃ tatpuruṣo'vyānme girivināyakaḥuttarasyāṃ sadā pātu sadyojātasvarūpadhṛkprātaḥkāle paṭhedyastu so'bhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyātkīrttiśrīkāntimedhāyurvṛt hito bhavati dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yuddhe vijayamāpnoti dyūte vāde ca sādhakaḥdevā manuṣyā gandharvā vaśyāstasya na saṃśayaḥkarastāstasya deveśi aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhayaḥyasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācanaanyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt satyametanmanoramena deyaṃ kasyacit bhadre yadīcchedātmano hitamtenārcitā mahādevi sarve devā na saṃśayaḥśaṅkaraṃ paripapraccha pārvatī parameśvaramāpaduddhāraṇaṃ mantraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇāmviśeṣatastu rājñāṃ vai śāntipuṣṭiprasādhanamvaktumarhasi deveśa mama harṣavivarddhanamsarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvaśatrunivarddhanamnāśanaṃ smṛtimātreṇa mantrarājamimaṃ priyesnehādvakṣyāmi te mantraṃ sarvasāramidaṃ priyeāpadaduddhāraṇaṃ mantraṃ vakṣyāmīti viśeṣataḥvaṭukāyeti vai paścādāpaduddharaṇāya cadevīpraṇavamuddhṛtya mantroddhāramimaṃ priyeaprakāśyamimaṃ mantraṃ sarvaśakti samanvitamvidravanti bhayārtā vai kalerudrādiva prajāḥnāgnicaurabhayaṃ vāpi graharājabhayaṃ tathābhavanti satataṃ tasya pustakasyāpi pūjanātsāramuddhṛtya teṣāṃ vai nāmāṣṭaśatakaṃ vadasarvān kāmanavāpnoti sādhakaḥ siddhimeva caāpaduddhārakasyeha nāmāṣṭaśatamuttamamsarvakāmārthadaṃ devi sādhakānāṃ sukhāvaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādayordevadeveśaṃ sarvāṅge vaṭukaṃ nyasetsarvakāmārthasiddhārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥkṣetradaḥ kṣetrapālaśca kṣetrajñaḥ kṣatriyo virāṭraktapaḥ prāṇapaḥ siddhaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhasevitaḥtrinetro bahunetraśca tathā piṅgalalocanaḥabhīrurbhairavo bhīmo bhūtapo yoginīpatiḥnāgahāro nāgakeśo vyomakeśaḥ kapālabhṛttrilocano jvalannetrastriśikhī ca trilokapātvaṭuko vaṭukeśaśca khaṭvāṅgavaradhārakaḥdhūrto digambaraḥ śaurirhariṇaḥ pāṇḍulocanaḥaṣṭamūrttinidhīśaśca jñānacakṣustamomayaḥbhūdharo bhūdharādhīśo bhūpatirbhūdharātmakaḥjṛmbhaṇo mohanaḥ stambhī māraṇaḥ kṣobhaṇastathābālabhukbalibhūtātmā kāmī kāmaparākramaḥsarvasiddhiprado vaidyaḥ prabhaviṣṇuḥ prabhāvavānmayā te kathitaṃ devi rahasyaṃ sarvakāmadamna tasya duritaṃ kiñcinna rogebhyo bhayaṃ tathāna śatrubhyo bhayaṃ kiñcit prāpnoti mānava kvacitmārībhaye rājabhaye tathā caurāgnije bhayebandhane ca mahāghore paṭhet stotraṃ samāhitaḥekādaśa sahasrantu puraścaraṇamiṣyatesa siddhiṃ prāpnuyādiṣṭāṃ durlabhāmapi mānuṣaḥrājā śatruvināśāya japenmāsāṣṭakaṃ punaḥjapenmāsatrayaṃ rātrau rājānaṃ vaśamānayetpaṭhedvāratrayaṃ yadvā vāramekaṃ tathā niśi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhanaṃ putrāṃstathā dārān prāpnūyānnātra saṃśayaḥyānyānsamīhate kāmāṃstāṃstān prāpnoti nityaśaḥdadyāt stotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradambhujaṅgamekhalaṃ devamagnivarṇaśiroruhamkhaṭvāṅgamasipāśañca śūlañcaiva tathā punaḥnīlajīmutasaṅkāśaṃ nīlāñjanacayaprabhamātmavarṇasamopetaṃ sārameyasamanvitamdhyātvā japet susaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyātsādhakānāmbhairavāya prahṛṣṭābhūt svayañcaiva maheśvarīyayā vrajasti tāṃ lakṣmīṃ manujāḥ surapūjitāmsakalavāṅmaya mātṛbhūtāmtripure bhajāmaḥjaḍadhiyastavarūpamambamanyāmahevayamapārakṛpāmburāśimhastakamalairdadhatīṃ trinetrāmkadāpi na vismarāmikṛtinastaruṇārkamitramkinnarībhirāsvāditāsavarasāruṇanetrapadmāḥparāmṛtasiktagātrīmtripure yathāvatvismarāmisvāmanuprāpya vāksiddhiṃ prāpnuyuste narāḥ śriyamsāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ yatpuroditamtvattaḥ parataro nātha kaḥ kṛpāṃ kartumarhati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trailokya vijayaṃ nāma śastrāstra kavacaṃ mantravigrahamjaghāna sakalāndaityān yaddhṛtvā madhusūdanaḥdhanādhipaḥ kubero'pi vāsavastridaśeśvaraḥna deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo'sādhakebhyaḥ kadācanabhairavyāḥ kavacasyāsya ṛṣirdakṣiṇāmūrtireva cadharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥbhṛgurmanusvarayutaḥ sargo bījatrayātmakaḥbhālaṃ pātu kumārī ca sargahīnā kumārikākāmabījaṃ sadā pātu ghrāṇayugmaṃ sadāvatuhasaiṃ kaṇṭhaṃ hasakalarīṃ skandhau pātu hasaurbhujauhṛdayaṃ hasakalarīṃ vakṣaḥ pātu hasaroḥ stanauhasraiṃ pātu sadā pārśvayugmaṃ hasakalarīṃ sadāaiṃ īṃ oṃ me madhyadeśaṃ bījavidyā sadāvatupātu hasauḥ kaṭīdeśaṃ ṣaṭkuṭā bhairavī mamaguhyadeśaṃ hasauḥ pātu jānunī bhairavī mamapātu hasauḥ sarvadehaṃ bhairavī sarvadāvatuhasauḥ me dakṣiṇe pātu bhairavī cakramāsthitāhasaiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasarauḥ paścime pātu bhairavīhrīṃ hrīṃ pātu sadaiśānye dakṣiṇe kālike'vatudigvidikṣu svāhā kālikā khaḍgadhāriṇīsaṃgrāme kānane durge toye taraṅgadustaretrailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutamsparddhāmūddhūya bhavane lakṣmīrvāṇī vaset tataḥvilikhya bhūrje gulikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayedyaditadgātraṃ prāpya śastrāṇi bhavanti kusumāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etat kavacamajñātvā yo japedbhairavīṃ parāmbālāṃ vā prajapedvidyāṃ daridro mṛtyumāpnuyātkiṃ manasi bhaktimatāṃ jānānāmparayāplutasyataruṇīrbhuvanatraye'pilokapālaiḥśaśvadamṛtāplutaśītalasyavasudhāṃ dadātivaddhadṛṣṭimjāyate vālakṣmīḥnānyammūrtirekāparamāmṛtāktamnirmalasūktibhārabharitā jāgarti dīrghaṃ yaśaḥyogaṃ tvayi na tanute cittamālambitāyāmstutā tvaṃ vāñchitaṃ devi dadāsi karuṇākarecidviśrāntimahāsattāmātre mātre namo'stu teguṇatrayātmikāsi tvaṃ jagataḥ karaṇecchayābhaktasya me nityapūjāyuktasya parameśvaritāpatrayaparimlānabhājanaṃ trāhi māṃ śiveyannyūnamatiriktaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasitatsarvaṃ kṛpayā devi kṣamasva tvaṃ dayāndihetatsarvañca jagaddhātri kṣantavyamayamañjaliḥsūcitaṃ yanmahādevyāḥ kavacaṃ kathayasva me
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ sakalābhīṣṭasiddhidamdharmārtha kāmamokṣāṇāṃ viniyogaśca sādhanevāgbhavaḥ pātu śīrṣe māṃ kāmarājastathā hṛdiaiṃ klīṃ saurvadane pātu bālā māṃ sarvasiddhayesundarī nābhideśe'vyācchīrṣe kāmakalā sadālalāṭe subhagā pātu bhagā māṃ kaṇṭhadeśataḥbhagamālā nābhideśe liṅge pātu manobhavācaitanyarūpiṇī pātu pādayorjagadambikābrahmāṇī pātu māṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe vaiṣṇavī tathāāgneyyāṃ pātu kaumārī mahālakṣmīśca nair-ṛteākāśe pātu varadā sarvatra bhuvaneśvarīpaṭhetprātaḥ samutthāya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥna ca mārībhayaṃ tasya pātakānāṃ bhayaṃ tathāgacchecchivapuraṃ devi satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi tesa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya prāpnuyācchastraghātanamtvatprasādānmahādeva śrutā mantrāntvanekadhāśāpādidūṣaṇoddhāraḥ śrutastvatto mayā prabhośrotumicchāmi tvattastatkathayasva mayi prabhostrīsvabhāvātpunardevi pṛcchasi tvaṃ mayi priyeprītaye tava deveśi kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tatmahātripurasundarī devatā puruṣārthasādhane viniyogaḥmālinī paścime pātu trāsinī tūttare'vatuadhastātpātu deveśī pātālatalavāsinīḍāmaraḥ pātu māṃ nityaṃ mastake sarvakāmadaḥmahāvidyā bhagavatī pātu māṃ parameśvarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sauḥ pātu ca gale sahrīṃ hṛdaye nābhideśakesahahrīṃ māṃ sarvataḥ pātu saklīṃ pātu ca sandhiṣuhūṃ kṣe māṃ tvaritā pātu sahrīṃ saklīṃ manobhavājvālā ca mālinī nityā sarvadā pātu māṃ śivātava prītyā mayā khyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥdhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhogamokṣapradaṃ śivamākarṣaṇakaraṃ devi stambhoccāṭakaraṃ śiveyo'rcayedyoginīvṛndaiḥ sa bhakṣyo nātra saṃśayaḥtasmādetat sadābhyasyedadhikārī bhavet tataḥtatpunarantakāletaruṇārka koṭivilasattejaḥ svarūpāṃ śivāmbālādityasamaprakāśavilasannetratrayodbhāsinīmpratyālīḍhorupādāmaruṇitanayanāṃ yoginīṃ yoganidrāmsadyaśchinnātmakaṇṭha-pragalitarudhirairḍākinīṃ varddhayantīmyasyāḥ smerapadāravinduyugale lābhaṃ bhajante'marāḥbhairavo'haṃ śivo'hamsarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣānmahāpātakanāśanamtasya siddhirbhaveddevi vāñchitārthapradāyinīvasundharāṃ mahāvidyāmaṣṭau siddhīrbhaveddhruvammātarbhaktajanānukampini mahāmāye'stu tubhyaṃ namaḥtvayā nāthena jīveśa śrutāścādhigatā mayātrailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ kathyatāṃ prabhotrailokya vijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ sarvamohanamdhāraṇāt paṭhanādīśastrailokyavijayī vibhuḥkartā pātā ca saṃhartā bhuvanānāṃ sureśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatavāraṃ tu jīvanaṃ tadudāhṛtam | daśasaṃkhyo vā japaḥmatam | tāḍanaṃ śatadhā vāvāpi bodhayettumanuṃ tataḥtanmantravarṇasaṃkhyākairhanyādrepheṇa bodhanamtarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ matamghṛtena dugdhena tarpaṇaṃ samyagīritam | abhiṣeka'pi tathāśatamaṣṭorañcaiva dīpayetsādhakottamaḥdhenumudrāṃ pradarśya, omityaṣṭadhā daśadhā vā japetityetāvanmātramvāṇīṃ tato japet | iti viśeṣaḥśivājñayā | iti tānvikiretsandiṣṭāḥ sarvāvighnaughanāśakāḥpārṣṇighātaistribhibhaumān | iti vighnānnivārayetmantreṇa cādarāt | iti śāradīyātvighnānutsārayetmaṇḍapañca viśodhayettato'rghyasthāpanamāgamāntare pāṣṭhaḥsāmānyārghyaviśeṣārghyadvayasyāvaśyakatvampade | ihaloke daridraḥ syānmṛte ca paśutāṃ vrajetśivasūryārcanaṃ vinā | ajaḥ śaṅkhaḥdharmādīnpūjayetsarvatra prāṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayetnamo'ntena pūjayetgandhādyaiḥ pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deyaṃ śiṣyāya bhaktāya prāṇebhyopyadhikāya caṛṣirvirāṭ chandastu devatā cchinnamastakāhūṃkāro me śiraḥ pātu chinnamastā balaprabhāśrīṃ hrīṃ hūṃ aiṃ dṛśau pātu muṇḍakatrīdharāpi sāvajravairocanīye huṃ phaṭ svāhā ca dhruvādikāśrīmāyākūrcavāgbījairvajravairocanīye hūṃsvapārśvevarṇī cāsṛgdhārāṃ pāyayantī mudāmuṇḍakartṛdharā raktā sādhakābhīṣṭadāyinīramādyā pātu jihvāṃ ca lajjādyā pātu kaṇṭhakamramayā puṭitā vidyā pāśvauṃ pātu sureśvarīkūrcena puṭitā devī pṛṣṭhadeśe sadāvatuīśvarī kūrcavāgbījairvajravairocanīye hūṃchinnamastā sadā pāyādūruyugmaṃ saśaktikāsarvavidyāsthitā nityā sarvāṅgaṃ me sadāvatuḍākinī dakṣiṇe pātu śrīmahābhairavī ca māmindrākṣī pātu vāyavye'sitāṃgī cottareityaṣṭa śaktayaḥ pāntu digvidikṣu sakartṛkāḥhrīṃ hrīṃ māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu dakṣiṇe kālike'vatuhūṃ hūṃ pātu marutkoṇe svāhā pātu sadottaretāro māyā vadhūḥ kūrcaṃ phaṭkāro'yaṃ mahāmanuḥtārā tu sahitā khe'vthānmahānīlasarasvatīyaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbhīmaḥ krodhākhyo bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥyasyājñayā madhumatī yāti sā sādhakāntikamājñāṃ gṛhṇanti tāstasya kavacasya prasādataḥdevīmabhyarcya gandhādyairmūlenaiva paṭhet sakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūrje vilikhiñcaitatguṭikāṃ kāñcanasthitāmsarvaiśvaryutau bhūtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetbrahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi tadgātre yānti saumyatāmsopi śastraprahāreṇa mṛtyumāpnoti satvaramsvacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānāmmahāghorarāvāvataṃsesṛkkadvandvāsradhārādvayadharavadane dakṣiṇe kāliketiteṣāmaṣṭau karasthāḥ prakaṭitavadane siddhayastryambakasyalakṣmīlāsyalīlākamaladaladṛśaḥ kāmarūpā bhavantidivyamuṇḍasragatiśayalasatkaṇṭhapīnastanāḍhyedhyāyañjanani jaḍacetā api kaviḥkvacidapi na teṣāṃ paribhavaḥkhalu paśuroṣaḥ samucitaḥsiddhughā bhuvi cirataraṃ jīvati kaviḥharavadhusiddhinivahāḥsakalamapi kiṃ staumi bhavatīmsvairaṃ ratirasamahānandaniratāmbhavamanu na bhūyānmama manuḥbhavati dharitrīparivṛḍhaḥkṣitiparivṛḍhaḥ satkavivaraḥparamapadalīnaḥ prabhavatijanani sa syāt smaraharaḥpratipadamapūrvā prabhavatisamyaksmaraharasamānaḥ kṣititaleprasarati kavitvāmṛtarasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanuḥidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ pūrvasūcitamtvameva śaraṇaṃ nātha pāhi mā duḥkhasaṅkaṭātśrījaganmaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ mantravigrahamnārāyaṇo'pi yaddhṛtvā nārī bhūtvā maheśvaramvaradṛptān jaghānaiva rāvaṇādiniśācarāndhanādhipaḥ kubero'pi sureśo'bhūcchacīpatiḥśrījaganmaṅgalasyāpi kavacasya ṛṣiḥ śivaḥchando'nuṣṭupdevatā kālikā dakṣiṇeritāyoṣidākarṣaṇe caiva viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥlalāṭaṃ ca kālikā khaḍgadhāriṇīdakṣiṇe kālikā pātu ghrāṇayugmaṃ maheśvarivadanaṃ sakalaṃ pātu hrīṃ hrīṃ svāhā svarūpiṇīkhaḍgamuṇḍadharā kālī sarvāṅgamabhito'vatuaiṃ hūṃ oṃ aiṃ stanadvandvaṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā kakutsthalamkrīṃ krīṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ karau pātu ṣaḍakṣarī mamakrīṃ svāhā pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ ca kālikā sā daśākṣarīsaptākṣarī mahāvidyā sarvatantreṣu gopitākālī daśākṣarī vidyā svāhā mamoruyugmakamkālī hṛdayavidyeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradākrīṃ hūṃ hrīṃ svāhā padaṃ pātu caturdaśākṣarī mamavidyābhiḥ sakalābhiḥ sā sarvāṅgamabhito'vatuvipracittā tathogrograprabhā dīptāghanatviṣāetāḥ sarvāḥ khaḍgadharā muṇḍamālā vibhūṣaṇāḥmāheśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā kaumārī cāparājitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rakṣantu svāyudhairdikṣu māṃ yathā tathāśrījaganmaṅgalaṃ nāma mahāvidyaughavigrahamgurupūjāṃ vidhāyātha vidhivat prapaṭhet tataḥetacchatārddhamāvartya trailokyavijayī bhavetmahākavirbhavenmāsāt sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetśatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyātśikhāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vā dhārayedyadiputrabāndhavānśrīmānnānāvidyānidhibhavetnāśamāyānti yā nārī vandhyā ca mṛtaputriṇībahvapatyā jīvavatsā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥśiṣyebhyo bhaktiyuktebhyaścānyathā mṛtyumāpnuyātpautrāntaṃ sthairyamāsthāya nivasatyeva niścitamsaśastraghātamāpnoti socirānmṛtyumāpnuyāttvameva śaraṇaṃ tvāmīśvarīmāśrayesaubhāgyāmṛtavarddhanena kṛpayā siñca tvamasmādṛśambhīme bhayannāśayahi gocarā kathamapi prāptāṃ nu tāmāśrayepadasevane hi vimuhān kiṃ mandadhīssevatetattulyānniyataṃ yathā śaśiravī nāśaṃ vrajanti svayamkupitāntakāśca manujānmātaḥ kṣaṇaṃ bhūtalekānta manobhavotra bhavati kṣudro'pi vācaspatiḥprātarmadhyāhnakāle ca sāyāhne niyataḥ śuciḥvikhyātiñcāpi lokeṣu prāpyānte mokṣamāpnuyātdivyaṃ hi kavacaṃ tasyāḥ śṛṇuṣva sarvakāmadamhrīṃkāra pātu lalāṭe bījarūpā maheśvarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hūṃkāraḥ pātu hṛdaye bhavānīśaktirūpadhṛkkharvā māṃ pātu deveśīgaṇḍayugme bhayāpahāvyāghracarmāvṛtā kaṭyāṃ pātu devī śivapriyāraktavartulanetrā ca kaṭidaśe sadāvatukarālāsyā sadā pātu liṅge devī harapriyāpretakharparadharā devī jānucakre maheśvarīnāgakuṇḍaladharā devī pātu pādayuge tataḥnāgakaṅkadharā devī pātu prāntaradeśataḥkhaḍgahastā mahādevī śravaṇe pātu sarvadākartṛhastā sadā pātu vivāde śatrumadhyataḥnāgakaṅkaṇadharā devī bhojane pātu sarvadāvīrāsanadharā devī nidrāyāṃ pātu sarvadānāgāñcitakaṭī pātu devī māṃ sarvakarmasucitāmadhyasthitā devī māraṇe pātu sarvadāalaṅkārānvitā devī pātu māṃ haravallabhābījarūpā mahādevī parvate pātu sarvadārakṣarakṣa hūṃ hūṃ oṃ hrīṃ svāhā maheśvarīoṃ hrīṃ vajrapuṣpe hūṃ phaṭ prāntare sarvakāmadāhūṃ svāhā śaktisaṃyuktā dārān rakṣatu sarvadāoṃ hrīṃ sarvavighnotsāriṇī devī vighnānmāṃ sadāvatupṛthivyāṃ pātu māṃ devī sarvavighnavināśinīpātāle pātu māṃ devī lākinīṃ nāmasaṃjñikāstrīṃkāro pātu deveśī vadhūrūpā maheśvarīphaṭ svarūpā mahāmāyā uttare pātu sarvadāmadhye māṃ pātu deveśī hūṃ svarūpā nagātmajā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavānī pātu bhavane sarvaiśvaryapradāyinīśāstre vāde ca saṃgrāme jale ca viṣame giraubhūtapretālaye ghore durgā māṃ bhīṣaṇāvatukavacasya ca māhātmyaṃ nāhaṃ varṣaśatairapiputradāreṣu bandhūnāṃ sarvadeśe ca sarvadāśucirbhūtvā'śucirvāpi kavaca sarvakāmadamsarvaśāstre maheśāni kavirāṭ bhavati dhruvamraṇe dyūte vivāde ca jayastatra bhaveddhruvamśatravo dāsatāṃ yānti sarveṣāṃ vallabhaḥ sadāmṛtyuśca vaśyatāṃ yāti dāsāstasyāvanobhujaḥprapaṭhanvā smaranmartyaḥ śāpānugrahaṇa kṣamaḥsarvavāgīśvarī martyo loka vaśyaḥ sadā sukhītatrāpi kavacaṃ devi durlabhaṃ bhavanatrayeabhedena bhajedyastu tasya siddhiradūrataḥnābhau jyotistathā vaktraṃ hṛdayopari cintayetnityaṃ tasya maheśāni mahilāsaṅgañcaretśaktiyukto bhavenmartyaḥ siddho bhavati nānyathātaṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakaṃ devi lajjāyuktā bhavanti tepraśaṃsanti sadā devi taṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakottamampraśaṃsanti sadā sarve taṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakottamambhuktimuktikaraṃ sākṣātkalpavṛkṣasvarūpakamtasya nṛpāśca devi vipado naśyanti tasyāśu catasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīrvāṇī vaktre vaseddhruvamalpāyurnirdhano mūrkho bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥtasya sarvārthasiddhiḥ syādyadyanmanasi vartate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāvakairvā maheśāni likhenmantraṃ samāhitaḥsandhyāyāṃ devadeveśi likhedyantraṃ samāhitaḥsiṃharāśau gate candre karkaṭasthe divākarelikhitvā dhārayedyastu uttarābhimukho bhavanniśāyāṃ yo likhedyantraṃ tasya siddhiracañcalādhyānadhāraṇayogena dhārayedyastu bhaktitaḥacirāttasya siddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāsāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ mantravigrahampuraiva sūcitaṃ nātha kṛpayā me prakāśayatrailokyamohanaṃ nāma śrūyatāṃ kavacaṃ paramsarvarakṣākaraṃ devi sarvavidyāpradāyakamsarvasiddhiyutāḥ santaḥ sarvaiśvaryamavāpnuyuḥkrodhādhipo mahābhīmo deveṣu kathitaḥ prabhuḥabhaktebhyo'pi putrebhyo dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyātcaturvargeṣu vidyāyāṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥsārddhapañcākṣarī tārā pāyānnetrayugaṃ mamatārā ṣaḍakṣarī pāyādvadanaṃ muṇḍabhūṣaṇāhrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ me galaṃ pāyātsāpi nīlasarasvatīhūṃ ghāṭāṃ me sadā pātu bījaikākṣararūpiṇīśrīṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ ca phaṭ pāyātśrītārā me stanadvayamhūṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūñca phaṭ bījaṃ tārā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatuoṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ namaḥ pāyātmahāṣaḍakṣarīsaptākṣarī cogratārā mūlavidyāsvarūpiṇīsvāheti ca mahāvidyā jānunī sarvadā'vatumahogratārā pādau me pātu me nityaṃ maheśvarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catustrīṃśallipimayī pātu tārākhilaṃ vapuḥkūrcādyantā pātu cordhvaṃ mūlavidyādaśākṣarīvidhivadgrahaṇādasyā mṛtyuṃ mṛtyupathaṃ nayetsāmprataṃ kathitā tubhyaṃ kavacāṅgatayā priyetrailokyamohanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ mantravigrahamtriḥ sakṛdvā yathā jñānaṃ bhairavastatkṣaṇādbhavetguruḥ syāt sarvavidyāsvapyadhikārī japādiṣutrailokyaṃ vicaredvīro gaṇanātho yathā guhaḥpañcavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyātsarvasiddhīśvaro bhūtvā vicaredbhairavo yathātasya gehe ciraṃ lakṣmīrvāṇī vaseddhruvamalpāyunirdhano mūrkho bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥvimukhavāṅmanasstambhinīmtasyāmitramukhasya vāci hṛdaye jāḍyaṃ bhavettatkṣaṇātbagalāmukhi pratidinaṃ kalyāmi tubhyaṃ namaḥtvannāmagrahaṇena saṃsadi mukha stambho bhavedvādināmmṛtyormāraṇamāvirastu purato mātastvadīyaṃ vapuḥvighnaughaṃ bagale hara praṇamatāṃ kāruṇyapūrṇe kṣaṇeśaraṇāgataḥ karuṇayā viśveśvari trāhi māmvimohitā ripugaṇā lakṣmīḥ sthirā siddhayaḥjihvākolanabhairavī vijayate brahmādimantro yathātattadbhūtale'sminnareṇaduṣṭānāṃ nigrahārthāya tadgṛhāṇa namostu tegurubhaktāya dātavyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacitmātaṅgīkavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gopanīyaṃ mahādevi maunī jāpaṃ samācarettoḍalā karṇayugalaṃ tripurā vadarna mamatripurā pārśvayoḥ pātu gude kāmeśvarī mamamahāmāyā pādayugme sarvāṅgeṣu kuleśvarībrahmarandhre sadā rakṣenmātaṅgīnāma saṃsthitānetrayoḥ sumukhī rakṣeddevī rakṣattu nāsikāmlajjā rakṣatu māṃ dantāñcoṣṭhau sammārjanīkarāsavisargaṃ mahādevi hṛdayaṃ pātu sarvadāudare pātu cāmuṇḍā liṅge kātyāyanī tathābhujau rakṣatu śarvāṇī hṛdayaṃ caṇḍabhūṣaṇāvijayā dakṣiṇe pātu medhā rakṣatu vāruṇeaiśānyāṃ rakṣayeddevī mātaṅgī śubhakāriṇīūrdhvaṃ pātu mahādevi devānāṃ hitakāriṇīpraṇavaṃ ca tato māyā kāmabījaṃ ca kūrcakamsārddhaikādaśavarṇā sā sarvatra pātu māṃ sadātrailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ devadurlabhamparamaiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥaiśvaryaṃ sukavitvaṃ ca vāksiddhiṃ labhate dhruvambrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca ye devāḥ surasattamāḥtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakaṃ devi lajjāyuktā bhavanti terājāno'pi ca dāsatvaṃ ṣaṭkarmāṇi ca sādhayetidaṃ kavacamajñātvā mātaṅgī yo bhajennaraḥgurau bhaktiḥ sadā kāryā kavace ca dṛḍhā matiḥtasmai mātaṅginī devī sarvasiddhiṃ prayacchatikalpayāmi namaḥ paścādupacāreṣmayaṃ vidhiriti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādakaṭakamaṣṭādaśopacāraistu mantrīṃ pūjāṃ samācaretprayojayecca pūjāyāmupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśagandhādayo naivedyāntā upacārā daśakramātakhaṇḍaṃ phalamāsādya kaivalyaṃ labhae dhruvamna nirmālyaṃ dvādaśābdaṃ tāmrapātraṃ tathaiva camodakaṃ kṛṣarañcaiva yāmārddhena maheśvariyāvaduṣṇaṃ bhavedannaṃ paramānnaṃ tathaiva camuhūrtaṃ dadhi dugdhañca ājyaṃ yāmena śaṅkarijavāraktañca mādhyañca nirmālyaṃ sārddhayāmakeyāmārddhena maheśāni tāmbūlaṃ dattamātrataḥsaugandhikañca kadalīṃ prayatnena niyojayetbhaktakalpalatike śrīpādukāmādarātgandhodvartanamādareṇa taruṇī dattaṃ gṛhāṇāmbikeprojvalagandhakaṃ bhavatu te śrīsundari tvanmudetripurasundari śrīpadenirmalamātanotu vasanaṃ śrīsundari tvanmudemukuṭaṃ śirasyanudinaṃ dattonmudaṃ stūyatāmracayatu śrīśāmbhavi śrīpadevimalaṃ saṃbhrameṇa dattaṃ gṛhāṇāmbiketāmrāmbhojanivāsinīṃ bhagavatīṃ śrīsundarīṃ pūjayesurakāminīviracitaḥ śrīsundari tvanmudedevi dīpo mudesurakāminīviracitaṃ śrīsundari tvanmudesphuritamanba tāmbūlakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guhyātiguhyagoptrītvamityādinā japaṃ samarpayettasmiñjale sakalāḥ kalā āvāhya pūjayet| jaṭāmāṃsī kapiyutā śaktergandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥviṣṇorgandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtamkuṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtampūjayet | tataḥ pratyekena pūjayetkṛtvā pūjayettatrāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetjalavācakatvādidamācamanīyaṃ vamiti vadantisvadhāmantro yujyate na tu sudhetyāhuḥpuṣpāṇi vauṣaṭ iti | sarvatra dāne mūlamantroccāraṇamtataḥ āvaraṇapūjādhūpayedājyasammiśrairnīcairdevasya deśikaḥvimalaṃ gandhaṃ mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥtathā devi dhūpaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥdahet | tataḥ samarpayeddhūpaṃ ghaṇṭāvādyajayasvanaiḥabhyarcya vādayedghaṇṭāṃ sudhūpairdhūpayettataḥtantre : na bhūmau vitareddhūpaṃ nāsane na ghaṭe tathāevaṃ dīpadāne'pi ghaṇṭāvādanamdarśanātpakvañca devatāvāme āmānnañcaiva dakṣiṇesuropamam | iti sāmpradāyikāḥdakṣakarṇe iti dvijātiviṣayameṣa vidhidvijātīnāṃ strīśūdrāṇāñca vāmataḥkīrtiśrīkāntiputrāyurbalārogyaṃ sadā'stu te | iti utthāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahātripurasundari prakaṭamātapatraṃ mahatkriyamāṇa eva kurutāṃ śarmāṇi vedadhvaniḥkolāhalairākulitā tavāstuvidyādharīnṛtyakalāsukhāyatatranaunyamapi satphalamekaṃ janmakoṭibhirapīha na labhyamyaḥ parāṃ devatāṃ stauti sa teṣāṃ phalamāpnuyātrudrākṣaṃ dhārayedbhaktyā sa śaivaṃ lokamāpnuyātcaturdaśamukhañcaiva śikhāyāṃ dhārayedbudhaḥavadhyatvaṃ pratisrotā vahnistambhaṃ karoti catrivaktro'gnistrijanmotthapāparāśiṃ vināśayetpañcavaktrastu kālāgniragamyākṣyapāpanutsaptavaktrastvanantaḥ syāt svarṇasteyāghanutsadābhairavo navavaktrastu śivasāyujyakārakaḥekādaśamukho rudro nānāyajñaphalapradaḥtrayodaśamukhaḥ kāmaḥsarvakāmaphalapradaḥniśchidrāśca supakvāśca rudrākṣā dhāraṇe smṛtāḥrudrākṣasya pratiṣṭhayāṃ mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ tathātato yathā svamantreṇa dhārayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥoṃ namo namaḥ | 14 |so'pi rudrapadaṃ yāti kiṃ punarmānavā guhayaḥ karoti naraḥ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavettasya prīto bhavedrudraḥ svapadañca prayacchatisa yāti narakān ghorānyāvadindrāścaturdaśaḥdaśaikādaśadvādaśatrayodaśacaturdaśaguṇañca kīdṛśaṃ teṣāṃ kathayasva yathārthataḥśṛṇu ṣaṇmukha tattvena vaktre vaktre yathā kramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekavaktraḥ śivaḥ sākṣātbrahmahatyāṃ vyapohatitrivaktro dahanaḥ sākṣādbrahmahatyāṃ vyapohatimucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ pañcavaktrasya dhāraṇātbrahmāhatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥgurutalpādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥpṛṣṭhodarakareṇāpi saṃspṛśedvā guroḥ striyamvighnāstu tasya naśyanti mukto yāti parāṃ gatimnavavaktro bhairavaḥ syāddhārayedvāmake bhujetatsarvaṃ dahate śīghraṃ navavaktrasya dhāraṇātpannagāśca vinaśyanti daśavaktrasya dhāraṇāttatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vaktraikādaśadhāraṇātādityastuṣyate nityaṃ dvādaśarkā vyavasthitāḥcaturdaśāsyaḥ vaṃśoddhārakaraḥ paraḥoṃ ḍaṃ māṃ | 14 |prāyaścittantu tantroktamayutaṃ mantrajāpataḥupacāravidhāvetatdravyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥdaghnā saha palaikantu śuddhaṃ vāri tathā camenirmalenodakenātha sarvatra paripūrṇatāvitastimātrādadhikaṃ vāsoyugmañca nūtanamcandanāgurukarpūrapaṅkagandhaḥ palāvadhiḥkāṃsyādinirmite pātre dhūpo guggulukarṣabhāknaivedyaṃ vividhaṃ vastu bhakṣyādikacaturvidhamkāryaṃ tāmrādipātre tatprītaye vanamālinaḥuttamo'yaṃ vidhiḥ prokto vibhave sati sarvadāanukalpaṃ varjayecca dravyāṇāṃ vibhave sati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvabhogānvito bhūtvā vrajedante hareḥ puramiti āsanamiti svāgatamityāvāhanamiti pādyamityācamanīyamiti madhuparkaḥiti punarācamanīyamiti snānīyamityuttarīyamiti yajñopavītamiti bhūṣaṇāniiti gandhaḥiti puṣpamiti dhūpaḥiti dīpaḥiti naivedyaṃtato jalaṃ samastadevadeveśa ityādināupalepananirmālyadūrīkaraṇameva cayogo nāma svadevasya svātmatvenaiva bhāvanātattvādiśāstrābhyāśca svādhyāyaḥ parikīrttitaḥsārṣṭi-sāmīpya-sālokya-sāyujya-sārupyadāḥ kramātbhaktyā pradakṣiṇañcaiva pādayoḥ śodhanaṃ punaḥkarayoḥ sarvaśuddhīnāmiyaṃ śuddhirviśiṣyatebhaktyā ca kṛṣṇadevasya vacasaḥ śuddhiriṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrotrayornetrayoścaiva śuddhiḥ samyagihocyateucyate śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ praṇatasya hareḥ punaḥviśuddhiḥ syādantarasya ghrāṇasyāpi vidhīyatetadekaṃ pāvanaṃ loke taddhi sarvaṃ viśodhayetnandakañcaiva hṛnmadhye śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ bhujadvayeprayāge yā gati proktā sā gatistasya gautamadevotsaveṣva sevā ca apraṇāmastadagrataḥekahastapraṇāmaśca tatpurastātpradakṣiṇamśayanaṃ bhakṣaṇañcaiva mithyābhāṣaṇameva canigrahānugrahau caiva strīṣu ca krūrabhāṣaṇamaślīlabhāṣaṇañcaiva adhovāyuvimokṣaṇamtattatkālodbhavānāñca kalādīnāmanarpaṇamspaṣṭīkṛtyāsanañcaiva paranindā parastutiḥaparādhāstathā viṣṇordvātriṃśatparikīrtitaḥgataḥ kiṃ na rasātalamdānantu prītaye tasya nānyathā gatiriṣyateprakṣepaṇaṃ prakurvīta brahmahā sa nigadyatetadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ pāpaṃ bhūmau bindunipātanātviṣṇupādodakaṃ pītvā śirasā dhārayāmyahampade pade'śvamedhasya phalamāpnoti nityaśaḥmantravidyāvibhāgena dvividhā mantrajātayaḥstrīpuṃnapuṃsakātmāno mantrāḥ sarve samīritāḥetacchūnyā bhavedvidyā mahāśabdeti gīyatekarmaṇorvahnitārāntyaviyatprāyāḥ samīritāḥāgneyā saṃprabudhyante prāṇe carati dakṣiṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prayacchanti phalaṃ sarve prabhuddhā mantriṇāṃ sadāprabodhakālo vijñeyaḥ svāpakālastataḥ paraḥubhayastho yadā vāyūstadā syādubhayātmakaḥevaṃ japto yadīṣṭaścetprabudhaḥ śīghrasiddhidaḥvīrāsanamiti proktaṃ kramādāsanapañcakampadmāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ yogināṃ hṛdayaṅgamamṛjukāyo viśedyogī svastikaṃ tatpracakṣatebhadrāsanaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ yogibhiḥ parikalpitamkarau nidadhyādākhyātaṃ vajrāsanamanuttamamṛjukāyo viśenmantrī vīrāsanamitīritamtasmānmudreti vikhyātā munibhistantravedibhiḥyābhirviracitābhiśca modante mantradevatāḥsthāne mudrāḥ pradraṣṭavyāḥ svasvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥtathā ṣaḍaṅga-mudrāśca sarvamantreṣu yojayetvāṇamudrā tataḥ parśurjaganmohanikā parākhaṭvāṅgā ca kapālākhyā ḍamaruḥ śivatoṣadāḥbījapūrāhvayā mudrā vijñeyā vighnapūjanemauṣalī mudrikā daurgī mudrāḥ śakteḥ priyaṅkarāḥsaptajihvāhvayā mudrā vijñeyā vahnipūjanemahāyoniriti khyātā sarvasiddhisamṛddhidāmatsyakūrmalelihākhyā mudrāḥ sādhāraṇī matāḥlelihāneti saṃproktāḥ pañcamudrā vilokitāḥsaṃkṣobhadrāvaṇākarṣavaśyonmāda-mahāṃkuśāḥgālinī ca prayoktavyā jalaśodhanakarmaṇivarāhasya sa pūjāyāṃ vārāhākhyāṃ prayojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uddeśānukramādāsāmucyante lakṣaṇāni caaṃguṣṭhau nikṣipetseyaṃ mudrā tvāvāhanī smṛtāucchritāṃguṣṭhamuṣṭyośca saṃyogāt sannidhāpanīuttānamuṣṭiyugalā sammukhīkaraṇī matāavaguṇṭhanamudreyamabhito bhrāmitā matāamṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt tayā sādhakasattamaḥprayojayedimā mudrā devatāhvānakarmaṇivaiṣṇavīnāntu mudrāṇāṃ kathyante lakṣaṇānyathadakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhasaṃspṛṣṭā jñeyaiṣā śaṅkhamudrikākaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakau lagnau mudraiṣā cakrasaṃjñikāgadāmudreyamuditā viṣṇoḥ santoṣavarddhinītalāntamilitāṃguṣṭhau kṛtvaiṣā padmamudrikāveṇumudrā bhavatyeṣā suguptā preyasī hareḥtarjanyau kārayedeṣā mudrā śrīvatsaṃjñitācatasro'pyagrasaṃlagnā mudrā kaustubhasaṃjñikākaradvayena mālāvanmudreyaṃ vanamālikājñānamudrā bhavedeṣā rāmacandrasya preyasībilvākhyā mudrikaiṣā sphuṭamiha gaditā gopanīyā vidhijñaiḥeṣā garuḍamudrā syāt viṣṇoḥ santoṣavarddhinīadhomukhībhiḥ sarvābhirmudreyaṃ nṛharermatāaṃgulyagrantu saṃyuktaṃ mudrā vārāhasaṃjñikāhayagrīvapriyā mudrā tanmūrteranukāriṇīdakṣamuṣṭestu tarjanyā dīrghayā bāṇamudrikābāṇamudreyamākhyātā ripuvarganikṛntanīsaṃhatāḥ prasūtāḥ kuryānmudrā paraśusaṃjñikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ucchritāṃguṣṭhamuṣṭi dve mudrā trailokyamohinīkāmamudreyamuditā sarvadevapriyaṅkarīliṃgumudreyamākhyātā śivasānnidhyakāriṇīaṃguṣṭhāgradvayaṃ nyasedyonimudreyamīritāprasārayet triśulākhyā mudraiṣā parikīrtitāprasārayedakṣamālā mudreyaṃ parikīrtitāadhaḥsthito dakṣahastaḥ prasṛtovaramudrikāūrdhvīkṛto vāmahastaḥ prasṛto'bhayamudrikāśliṣṭāṃgulyucchrite kuryānmṛgamudrayamīritākhaṭvāṅgamudrā vikhyātā devasyātipriyā matānidhāyocchritavatkuryānmudrā kāpālikī matāeṣā mudrā ḍamarukā sarvavighnavināśinīdantamudrā samākhyātā sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥeṣā pāśāhvayā mudrā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitāsaṃyojyākuñcayet kiñcitmudraiṣāṃkuśasaṃjñikāadhomukhī dīrgharūpā madhyamā vighnamudrikābījapūrāhvayā mudrāprasiddhatvādupekṣitāpāśāṃkuśavarābhītidhanurbāṇāḥ samīritāḥśiṣṭāṃgulī tu prasṛte saṃsṛṣṭe khaḍgamudrikāākuñcitāṃgulīṃ kuryāccarmamudreyamīritākuryānmuṣalamudreyaṃ sarvavighnavināśinīkṛtvā śirasi saṃyojya durgāmudreyamīritālakṣmīmudrā parā hyeṣā sarvasampatpradāyinīvīṇāmudreyamākhyātā sarasvatyāḥ priyaṅkarīdakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhatarjanyāvagralagne parāṃgulīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīrāmasya sarasvatyā atyantapreyasī matāsaptajihvākhyamudreyaṃ vaiśvānarapriyaṅkarīmudraiṣā gālinī proktā śaṅkhasyo paricālitāsāvakāśāmekamuṣṭiṃ kuryāt sā kumbhamudrikāsarvarakṣākarī hyeṣā kumbhamudrā prakīrtitākuryātsvahṛdaye seyaṃ mudrā prārthanasaṃjñikāañjalyañjalimudrā syādvāsudevāhvayā ca sātāvevābhimukhau kuryānmudreṣā kālakarṇikādakṣiṇā niviḍā muṣṭirnāsikārpitatarjanīmudrā vismayasaṃjñā syādvismayaveśakāriṇītarjanyaṃguṣṭhasaṃyogāgrato bindumudrikāeṣā saṃhāramudrā syādvisarjanavidhau smṛtāaṃguṣṭhau cālayetsamyakmudreyaṃ matsyarūpiṇīkūrmamudreyamākhyātā devatādhyānakarmaṇi (pṛṣṭhe kroḍe)darśayeddakṣiṇe bhāge muṇḍamudreyamucyateasyāstu bandhanānmantrī bandhanānmucyate dhruvampārśvasthaṃ muṣṭiyugalaṃ lelihaneti kīrttitābījāni coccaranmantrī mudrābandhanamācaretlelihānāma mudreyaṃ jīvanyāse prakīrtitāaṃguṣṭhāgre tu nikṣipya mahāyoniḥ prakīrtitāyābhirviracitābhiśca sānnidhyaṃ traipuraṃ bhavettrikhaṇḍeyaṃ samākhyātā tripurādhyānakarmaṇieṣā ca paramā mudrā sarvasakṣobhakāriṇīkriyate parameśāni sarvavidrāviṇī tadāiyamākarṣiṇī mudrā trailokyākarṣiṇī parā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudreyaṃ parameśāni sarvavaśyakarī matāmudraiṣonmādinī nāmnākarṣiṇa sarvayoṣitāmiyaṃ mahāṃkuśā mudrā sarvakāmārthasādhanīiyaṃ sā khecarī nāmnā pārthivasthānayojitābījamudreyamacirātsarvasiddhivivarddhinīeṣā tu paramā mudrā yonimudreyamīrtitāpūjākāle prayoktavyā yathānukramayogataḥsaubhagyadaṇḍinī mudrā nyāsakāle'pi sūcitāripujihvā grahā mudrā nyāsakāle'pi sūcitāaṃguṣṭhau ca tadagre mudreyaṃ bhūtinī matāprasārya tarjanīmudrā nirdiṣṭā vajrapāṇināvaśyakaraṃ grahādibhayahṛllakṣmīpradaṃ kāntidambahunā kimihoktena yantraṃ tatkāmado maṇiḥbahunā kimihoktena paramasmānna vidyatesamākhyātā traipurī sarvasiddhidāpañcamanobhavātmakamidaṃ saundaryasampatkaramtatspṛṣṭvā prajapenmantraṃ nyāsadhyānaparāyaṇaḥsarvasiddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ samastapuruṣārthadamguhamukhamitānaṣṭame pañcavarṇānkṣudraviṣagrahāmayaripupradhvaṃsanaṃ śrīpadamanaṅgaḥ kṛṣṇagovindau ṅe'ntāvaṣṭākṣarī manuḥgosthāne nikhanedetatgavāṃ vṛddhirbhavet tadātadbahiraṣṭadalāni racayitvā daleṣu mātṛkāṣṭavarṇānlikhetśrīpadaṃ kīrtidāyilikhedyastrijagati sa guruḥ śaṅkarasyāpi viṣṇoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭākṣaro manuḥ prokto mantrāṇāṃ sāra īritaḥbhūrje dvādaśavarṇāni tadarddhaṃ tāmrapaṭṭakeete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmakāmārthasiddhayedhyānaṃ pūjā japaśceti sarvatantreṣvayaṃ kramaḥkṛtaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ vidyāttasmādādau lipiṃ nyasetanyathānarthakāri syāt saṃkocārcanamīśvarisantoṣayediticakramadhye samāvāhya saṃkṣepārcanamarcayeditisampūjya devyai puṣpāñjalīṃ dattvā mantraṃ japeditibhūyo bhūyo bhavecchāntirjīvedaṣṭottaraṃ śatammucyate malinaiḥ kṛcchraiḥ pāpairghoratarairapividrumaiḥ pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetpadmarāgairyajet kṛṣṇaṃ rājā bhavati niścitamgārutmatamayai ratnaiḥ pūjayan jñānavān bhavetdehānte haritāṃ prāpya nirvāṇa padamṛcchatimaṅgale raktapadmaiśca budhe tagarasambhavaiḥśanivāre śamīpuṣpaiḥ pūjayedbhaktito yatiḥbūdhavāre yāvakaistu gurau sūpasamudbhavaiḥvaiśākhe māsi vidhivattarpayeddhimavajjalaiḥāṣāḍhe māsi vidhivatpavitraiḥ pūjayeddharimpūjānte devarājāya mahiṣībhyo nivedayetevaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ mantrī kṛtvābhīṣṭamavāpnuyātśrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇaṃ tu pūjayet ketakodbhavaiḥelālavaṅgakakkolaphalāni bahudhārpayetīṣe māsi yajedbhaktyā bhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ suvistaraiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathā tasminkṣaṇe devi japenmantraṃ śatāṣṭakamnocetsañcāriṇīśaktirgurumeti na saṃśayaḥsvaśaktirakṣaṇārthāya gururmantraṃ tadā japetpriyamananyadhīḥ | yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke mukhe tannivedayetbhaviṣyativittaśāḍhyaṃ nihantyāśu putrānāyuryaśodhanamdadyātputrapautrānugāminīmbhuñjītavakṣyāmaḥ | iti kalāvatīdīkṣāprayogaḥtapanañcaiva pūjākrama udāhṛtaḥāgneyāṃ gaṇanāthañca nai-ṛtyāṃ tapanantathāsvasthānavarjitā devā duḥkhaśokabhayapradāḥhānidāḥvaikalpikamiti sāmpradāyikāḥāhvānaṃ nijamudrikaviracanaṃ dhyānaṃ prabhoḥ pūjanampratiṣṭhitaprati mādiyantrādiviṣayamdevatāśāpamāpnuyāttathā ca : siddhādiśodhanaṃ naiṣāmaṅgatve sati rājavatdīkṣāṃ vinaiva karttavya upadeśaḥ sadaiva hipanasāmrāśvatthavaṭavakulānivakulameva ca | pañcapallavamityuktaṃ munibhistantravedibhiḥpadmarāgaṃ marakataṃ nīlañceti yathākramātmantritaḥ prokṣaṇītoyaiḥ śāntikumbhajalaistathāaṣṭottaraśataḥjapetkarṇe upadeśe tvayaṃ vidhiḥ | iti saṃkṣepadīkṣā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tulāsthe bhāskare kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayenmāsamātrakamdhṛtadīpavicchinnaṃ dadyānmāsaṃ mahojjvalamasyāṃ tithau tu matimān vārṣikotsavamācaretevaṃ kṛte devatāsya tuṣṭyā ceṣṭaṃ prayacchatisupakvaṃ devarājāya bhaktyā tasmai nivedayetgrahadoṣaṃ vijitvāśu bhūyānnṛpatisannibhaḥdugdhānnaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ miṣṭhānnañca nivedayetsugandhikusumairdhūpairdīpaistatra suvistaraiḥnacet sāṃvatsarī pūjā viphalā tasya jāyatetāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayāviṣṭo varaṃ dātuṃ śivaḥ svayamsundaraḥ sarvalokeṣu krīḍārthaṃ vrajasundaritena pūjanamātreṇa saṃvatsaraphalaṃ labhettāvatsaṃkhyaṃ manuṃ japtvā kṛṣṇaṃ paśyati mantravitkṛtvānena vidhānena kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtalebrahmahatyādi doṣāṇāṃ prāyaścittamanuttamamsamastaraśmisahitaṃ nityāmnāya puraskṛtamjanmāntarakṛtā sarvā nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥjavāpuṣpairmaheśāni pūjayetpūrvavacchivāmnāśayenmātra sandeho dhanavān jāyate budhaḥsaubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥpūrvavatparameśāni sarvaṃ pāpaṃ praṇāśayetsaubhāgyavānbhavenmantrī tripurāyāḥ prasādataḥmāsamātreṇa sakalaṃ mokṣastasya kare sthitaḥtrailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ tasya pūrvapāpaṃ dahennaraḥsamṛddhimānbhavet so'pi sarvapāpaharaḥ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetotpalasamutthaiśca pūjayenmāsamātrakammuktistasya kare devi vācā jīvasamo bhavetpātakaṃ nāśayenmantrī sākṣātkāmasamo bhavetkahlāraiḥ sindhuvāraiśca pūjayet pūrvavatkramātpāpaṃ vināśayeddevi yadi janmasahasrajamgrahapīḍāṃ vijityāśu sa sukhāni samaśnutelabhate maṃjulāṃ vāṇīṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ sadā yajetyāvat phalāptimānyogī tāvadevaṃ samācaretphalañcākṣayasiddhyarthaṃ dadyāddevyai prayatnataḥdurgāṃ tāriṇīmiti prakaraṇānumūlatvātayutaṃ homasaṃkhyā syāt japastāvān prakīrttitaḥbrāhmaṇān vaśayecchīghraṃ pārthivānpadmahomataḥpañcaviṃśatisañjaptairjalaiḥ snānaḥ dine dineavāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavetnaraṃ nārīṃ narapatiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇāmallikākusumairhutvā vaśayedakhilaṃ jagatikṣudaṇḍaiḥ śubhairhutvā mahatīṃ vṛddhimāpnuyātdhānyaiḥ prakṣālitairhutvā śriyamiṣṭāmavāpnuyātphalairjambūdbhavairhutvā labhate dhanamīpsītamdīrghamāyurbhavedāmraiścampakaiḥ kāñcanaṃ labhetpatrairvakulajairhutvā śīghrañcotsādayedarīnmāṣahomena mūkaḥ syādunmatto'kṣairbhavedariḥsiddhārthairjuhuyānmantrī rogānmucyeta tatkṣaṇātpalāśakusumaiḥ puṣṭiṃ dhānyairdhānyāśrayaṃ labhetmarīcahomānmaraṇaṃ ripurāpnoti sarvadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahākavirbhavenmantrī vatsareṇa na saṃśayaḥlabhate maṇḍalātsiddhiṃ vācāmapratimāmapisamidbhirvā tadutthābhiryaśaḥ prāpnoti vākptateḥnandyāvartaprasūnairvā hutvā vāgvallabho bhavetsa bhavedalpakālena ramāyā vasatiḥ sthirāsa bhavedabdamātreṇa sarvadā sampadāṃ nidhiḥacirādeva mahatī lakṣmīḥ saṃjāyate dhruvamnāgavallī parṇamprāpnuyānmaṇḍalādarvāgabhīṣṭamādhikaṃ naraḥcatuḥśataṃ prajuhuyādvaśyāḥ syuḥ sarvajantavaḥplakṣairvaiśyān vaṭodbhūtaiḥ śūdrānmatrī vaśaṃ nayetdayā sarvasamṛddhiḥ syādannairannapatirbhavetapidhāya japenmantraṃ samyagaṣṭottaraḥ śatamtejovīryaśaḥkāntividyāvibhavabhāgyadamnīlotpalānāṃ homena vaśayedakhilaṃ jagatdūrvāhomena dīrghāyurbhavenmantrī nirāmayaḥmedhākāmena hotavyaṃ palāśakusumairnavaiḥtanmantritānnaṃ bhuñjīta mahadārogyamāpnuyātyānkṛtvā sādhakavaro lokatrayaprapūjitaḥjaptvā medhāṃ parāṃ prāpya kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavetjaptvā mantrī trikālajño vṛhaspatisamo bhavetsarvavedārthakuśalo jñānavānbhavati dhruvamlakṣaikajapanādasya kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtalejāyate nātra sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na cānyathālakṣaṃ japyāditi dhyātvā āpadbhyo mucyate dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na tasya vidyate bhītiḥ kadācidapi suvratavaśyā bhavanti sarve ca brāhmaṇā nātra saṃśayaḥvaśyā bhavanti rājāno nātra kāryā vicāraṇātamālodbhavapuṣpaiśca vaiśyā vaśyā bhavanti hilalāṭe vidhṛte tasya sarve vaśyā bhavanti histriyo vaśyā bhavantyatra putramātyāśca sarvathāhṛtaputraṃ samāhṛtya dadau yastaṃ vicintayetdīrghāyurapratihatabalavīryasamanvitammanorathapatiṃ labdhvā dīrghakālañca krīḍatidīyate yasya yasyeti so'cirāddāsavadvaśīpuruṣaṃ vaśayennārī anenaiva vidhānataḥaṣṭottarasahasrantu juhuyādannavān bhavetpūtanāstanapātāraṃ dhyātvā mantraṃ śataṃ japettarjayantaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ hūṃkāreṇa vināśayetnamāmi devakīputraṃ nṛtyarājānamacyutamnāśayennātra sandeho dṛṣṭimātreṇa māntrikaḥmahaiśvaryamatha prāpya viśvakhyāto bhaveddhruvambhayamāśu vinaśyet tu nātra kāryā vicāraṇāevañca manasā dhyātvā vṛṣṭiṃ varṣāsu cāharetvṛṣṭirbhavatyakāle'pi mahatī nātra saṃśayaḥājyamaṣṭaśataṃ hutvā kinnaraiḥ saha gīyatehutvā daśasahasrantu tatkṣaṇānnāśayeddhruvamdhyātvā taṇḍuladūrvābhirhutvā śāntikamāharetsarvān lokān vaśīkṛtya āśu vijño bhaviṣyatianenaiva vidhānena sarvatra vijayī bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃsārasāgarātsadyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥbījaiḥ sahasrasaṃkhyātairhomo bhayavināśanaḥmukto bandhādbhavetsadyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsarvavedāgamādīnāṃ vyākhyātā jāyate'cirātśrīpuṣpaṃ lavaṅgapuṣpamanidro mantravitpaścātsusvapnastasya jāyatenāśayedacirādeva mantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥjapenmantraṃ smaredenaṃ duḥkhānmukto bhavennaraḥputramitrakalatrāderuccāṭo jāyate ripoḥjāyate maṇḍalādarvākśatrusenānivāraṇammantrī yadi na santuṣyedanarthaḥ syānmahīpateḥśatrucauramahābhūtaiḥ kṛtvāṃvādhāṃ vināśayetevaṃ saptāravāreṣu juhuyāt kṣetrasiddhayevirodho naśyati kṣetre saha caurādyupaplvaiḥtāvadājyena juhuyānmaṇḍalātsvarṇamāpnuyātāyurārogasampattiryaśaḥ putrān vivarddhayetvimuktaḥ suciraṃ jīveccharadāṃ śatamañjasādīrghamāyuravāpnoti vāñchitāṃ vindate śriyamapamṛtyujideva syādāyurārogyavarddhanaḥsamidvaraiḥ kṛto homaḥ sarvamṛtyugadāpahaḥapāmārgasamiddhomaḥ sarvāmayanisūdanaḥśāstravyākhyānasāmarthyaṃ labhate vatsarāntarenipītaṃ kavitā-kānti-balāyuḥ-śrīdhṛtipradamevaṃ kṛte jagadvaśyo ramāyā bhavanaṃ bhavetpuṣpaiḥ payo'nnaiḥ saghṛtairhomādviśvaṃ vaśaṃ nayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: girikarṇībhavaiḥ puṣpairbrāhmaṇān vaśayeddhruvammālatīkusumairhutvā tatputrāṃśca vaśaṃ nayetsarṣapaiḥ kaṭusaṃmiśrairvaśayet pārthivān kṣaṇātnaranārīnarapatīn homato vaśayeddhruvamjāyate vatsarādarvākśriyā vijitapārthivaḥkandarpādadhikaṃ sadyaḥ-saundaryamadhigacchativijitya rogānakhilān sa jīveccharadāṃ śatamyān spṛśetspṛśyate yairvā vaśyāḥ syustasya te'cirātdarśanādeva vaśayennātra kāryā vicāraṇāmūkasyāpi hi mūḍhasya śilārūpasya nānyathāhavanānmohayenmantrī lokatrayanivāsinaḥsobhāgyena vilāsena samarthyenāpi suvrateprāpnoti mantrī mahatīṃ stambhayejjagatīmimāmnāgendrāsuradevānāṃ purandhrīrvaśamānayetpararāṣṭraṃ mahādurgaṃ samastaṃ svavaśaṃ nayetāyurvalamathārogyaṃ samṛddhirjāyate nṛṇāmdadhimākṣikahomena saubhāgyaṃ dhanamāpnuyātkālahantā rogahantā mṛtyuhantā na saṃśayaraktotpalairjagadvaśyaṃ rājāno vaśagāḥ kṣaṇātśvetotpalaiḥ śriyaṃ vācaṃ labhate havanātpriyetṛtīyalakṣe saṃjapte bhrāmayanti surāṅganāḥsādhakaṃ bhrāmayantyeva tatrāsau sthiramānasaḥpuruṣā yoṣito vaśyāścarācaramapi priyeāyāti sādhakaṃ samyakmantramūḍhā satī priyekāmabāṇavibhinnāntaḥkaraṇāṃ lolacakṣuṣam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣobhayet svargabhūrlokapātālatalayoṣitaḥmantriṇā parameśāni tatsarvaṃ tasya vaśyagamsa vaśyo jāyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāhaṭhākarṣaṇametat tu kathitaṃ nānyathā bhavetmahāpātakayuktātma, tatkṣaṇāt pāpahā bhavetmāsena hanti kaluṣaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ naraḥlakṣamātraṃ japedyastu mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyatemahāpātakamukhyāni nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥmahāpātakakoṭistu nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥkubera iva deveśi pañcalakṣānna saṃśayaḥsaptalakṣajapānmantrī khecarīmelako bhavetvaśagāstasya rājāno yoṣitaśca viśeṣataḥsarvairvandyaḥ sadā susthaḥ sarvasaubhāgyavānbhavetsarvasiddhiprado homaḥ kartavyo'tha prayatnataḥghṛtena sahito vāpi vāgīśatvapradāyakaḥṣaṇmāsaṃ dadhisaṃyuktairlakṣmīstasya sthirā bhavetyo juhotyayutaṃ devīṃ tasya vaśo bhavetlakṣamātraṃ vidhānena sa jīveccharadāṃ śatamsakṣalasaṃkhyāni yo devīṃ siddhistasya na saṃśayaḥtrisandhyaṃ māsamātrantu vāgīśatvamavāpnuyātsādhakaḥ sādhayetsiddhiṃ devānāmapi durlabhāmkevalaṃ guptabhāvena sa tu vidyānidhirbhavetvaśamāyānti te sarve sādhakasya ca nānyathāprajapedayutaṃ prājña etadeva phalaṃ labhetprajapet sa bhavetśīghraṃ vidyāyā vallabhaḥ svayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gadyapadyamayī vāṇī sabhāyāṃ tasya jāyatetasya vākya paricayājjaḍā bhavanti vāgminaḥlakṣapīṭhaphalaṃ devi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥprajapet pratidinamaṣṭottarasahasramityarthaḥtatraiva gaṇanā proktā gajāntakasahasrakamitidhanakāmena hotavyaṃ tilājyamadhusaṃyutamsarpirlavaṇahomena sadākarṣati kāminīmallikājātipunnāgakadambaiḥ puṣṭimāpnuyātkṣīrājyatagarairhomānmahatīṃ kavitāṃ labhetnīlasarasvatīpadamupalakṣaṇampratidinamiti maṇḍalaparyantamsarvasyaiva tu homasya niyamo'yutasaṃkhyakaḥmantrasiddhikaraṃ sākṣānmahāpātakanāśanamvaśīkṛtya nṛpān sarvān bhogī syād yāvadāyuṣamagurumiśritaistoyaiḥ sarvakālaḥ sukhī bhavetmarīcamiśritaistoyaistathā śatrūn vināśayetjvarāviṣṭau bhavet tena dugdhasekātsamaṃ nayetkṛtvā paśyati yaṃ mantrī taṃ kuryāddāsavatsudhīḥjapamātreṇeti pūjāvahirbhāvenetyarthaḥmiśrīkṛtya balindadyādaṣṭamyāñca viśeṣataḥsaptāhābhyantare tasya coccāṭanamidaṃ mahatnikṣipyate yasya gehe mṛtyustasya dvimāsataḥkṣārastu śyenaviṭyuktaṃ viṭalavaṇammāraya mārayetyādi sādhyasahitamityarthaḥtanme kathaya deveśi yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śavāsanagato vīro japedaṣṭasahasrakamchittvā chittvā punaśchittvā gacchatyākṛṣyate punaḥsiddhāñjano bhavenmantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇākāmasaṅkocamāsādya gacchatyavikalo naraḥbālo vāgmīdrutakabhavetgandhacandanapuṣpaiśca pūjayettāriṇīṃ śivāmpitureva likhenmantraṃ nānya eva kadācanaśāntiṃ kuryādbālakasya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha sādhakaḥityanena kuśodakena śāntiṃ kuryātmahiṣe dhanasamṛddhiḥ syānmṛge mokṣaphalaṃ bhavetnare datte mahaddhiḥ syādaṣṭasiddhiranuttamātato rudhiraṃ samāṃsaṃ baliṃ devyai dadyātnidhāya devyai dadyāt tu tadraktaṃ mantrapūrvakamiti sampūjyāgneyāṃ gaṇeśāya baliṃ dadyātna ca rogāvilādaṅgannānyadhātāddhi bhairavapūjayet tripurādevīṃ sarvasaubhāgyahetavesvagātrarudhiraṃ dattvā natvā rājatvamāpnuyātṣaṇmāsābhyantare tasya kāmamiṣṭamavāpnuyātsvagātrarudhiraṃ dattvā ātmahatyāmavāpnuyātstrīṣu roṣaṃ prahārañca varjayenmatimān sadāsarvañca yuvatīrūpaṃ bhāvayenmatimān sadātāsāṃ bhagādidevīnāmsarvathā ca na kuryāt tu cānyathā siddhirodhakṛttaddhastāvacitaṃ dravyaṃ devatābhyo nivedayetjapasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhve japañcaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaktādyaśeṣa bhakṣyāṇi bhuktvā śeṣaṃ japañcaretsvecchāniyama ukto'tra mahāmantrasya sādhaneśuddhiṃ na cācaret tatra nirvikalpaṃ manaścaretyācayedamṛtaṃ kaulaṃ tadabhāve jalaṃ pibetnamaskṛtya ca gṛhṇīyādanyathā narakaṃ vrajetgamayeddevatāpūjājapayāgastavādināsarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe kartavyo nātra saṃśayaḥśaktirūpaṃ jagatsarvam yo na jānāti nārakīsarvadā pūjayeddevīmasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥmahāniśyaśucau deśe baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayettatpunaḥ kulapūjāviṣayamsā mahārātriruddiṣṭā taddattamakṣayaṃ bhavetnityaśaḥ iti ṣoḍaśadinaṃ yāvatpṛthvīṃ kulaṃ parvataṃ stanamtriśūlaṃ trivalīm iti bodhyamsa bhavetkuladevaśca kuladrumagataḥ śuciḥtatsudhārasadhāreṇa tarpayenmātṛkānanerātrau yadi japenmantraṃ saiva kalpalatā bhavettadā māsena siddhiḥ syātsahasrajapamānataḥtatraiva mahatī siddhirdevatānāṃ sudurlabhāyena hīnā na sidhyanti janmakoṭisahasraśaḥkulācāraprasannāsye namaste śaṅkarapriyeghoraghoraravāsphāle namaste citivāsinibhāgyodayasamutpanne namaste varavarṇinībhaktebhyo varade devi mahiṣāghni namo'stu te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yuge yuge ca karttavya upadeśaḥ kalau yugebilvādipatrajaṃ śyāmamityuktaṃ varṇapañcakamkramāt | maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadrametsādhāraṇaṃ matamproktaṃ sarvasamṛddhidamdakṣiṇāṃ datvā mahāntamutsavaṃ kuryāttantrasāre prathamaḥ paricchedaḥvidyā kuṇḍalinīrūpā maṇḍalatrayabhedinītatprabhāpaṭalavyāptaṃ śarīramai cintayetyena vinā na siddhḥ syānnarakañca prapadyateniṣphalā tasya pūjā syācchaucahīnā yathā kriyāiti vacanāttasyāvaśyakatvaṃvaidikī tāntrikī sandhyā yathānukramayogataḥpurato vajrapāṣāṇe nikṣipedastramuccaranviśeṣastu snānaprakaraṇe vaktavyaḥgāyatrī tu snāna prakarane vaktavyātāvanna pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ vā maheśvarīmsandhyāyāṃ patitāyāntu gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japetnadyādau datvā vaidikasnānaṃ kṛtvā tāntrikasnānamācaretmantrasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryātkarmaṇā siddhihetavekuryātgṛhītvāmukadevasya prītaye snānāmācaretkarma kuryātdhyātvā jalāñjalīn kṣiptā tarpayediṣṭadevatāmgurupaṃki purā tarpya tarpayediṣṭadevatāmoṃ nāradaṃ tarpayāmi ityādikrameṇa prayogaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktimantraṃ puraskṛtya tasya niddhirna jāyateyoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanamtathā kulatithau durgā pūjitā varadāyinībhaumaśukro kulākhyau hi budhavāraḥ kulākulaḥviṣamāścākulāḥ sarvāḥ śeṣāśca tithayaḥ kulāḥkulāni samadhiṣṇyāni śeṣāṇi cākulāni caevaṃ kulavārādikaṃ jñātvā sādhakaḥ karma kuryātmāṃsapradhānanaivedyaṃ sandhyākāle nivedayettadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā kulabhūṣaṇaśivārāveṇa tasyāśu sarvaṃ naśyati niścitamgṛhītvā śāpamādāya śivā roditi nirjanetatraiva sarvaśaktīnāṃ prītiḥ paramadurlabhātena sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahatśubhāśubhāni karmāṇi vicintya balimāharetyadi na bhujyate vatsa tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavetevaṃ jñātvā mahādeva śāntisvastyanaṃ caretkimvā pakṣipataṅgādidarśane naiva kārayetniśchidramaṇḍape vāpi kartavyaṃ na ca sannidhauprakāśānmṛtyulābhaḥ syānna prakāśyaṃ kadācanagopanādyadi vyaktiḥ syānna guptiḥ sā vidhīyatevaraṃ pūjā na kartavyā na ca vyaktiḥ kadācanasparśanāccampaśāstrīmūlādi-brahmarandhrāntaṃkulaṃ dhyātvā guruṃ smaretkulasthānaṃ samāśritya snānārthaṃ tīrthamāśrayetātmavidyāśivaistattvairācāmyānyatsamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devānṛṣīn pitṝṃścaiva tarpayetkulavāriṇātattoyañca tridhā pītvā tridhā ca prokṣaṇaṃ tanoḥkṣiptvāvāratrayaṃ devi ācāmetsādhakāgraṇīḥayaṃ prayogaḥ pūjādau kulīnaiḥ sarvatra kartavyaḥānandena vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti devatāḥaiṃ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhā śodhayedaparāṃ tataḥsattvavaśaṅkari svāhāmantreṇa juhuyānmukhepītveti vijayāmeva prakaraṇātpūjayetpañcīkaraṇasaṅketaiḥ pūjayet kulanāyikāmsudhūpadhūpitāṃ tanvīṃ dūtīkarmasu yojayetbrāhmaṇīti tu brāhmaṇaviṣayamabhaktamānasāṃ dīnāṃ varjayetsādhakottamaḥliṅgayonirato mantrī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetpūjārhā ca yadā devi tadā mātā na saṃśayaḥsamākīrṇe niveśyātha pūjayetkulanāyikāmiti dravyaśuddhiḥvāmakāmo brāhmaṇo hi madyaṃ māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayettena śūdrasya anukalpaḥmādakasya pāpahetukatvaṃ uktamtena kṣatriyādīnāṃ mukhyasya dāne'dhikāraḥ na pāneutthāya ca punaḥ pītvā punarjanma na vidyatesabhraṣṭaḥ pūjayeddevīṃ caṇḍīmantraṃ kathaṃ japetmadyeṣu mukhyānukalpeṣukulapūjāyāmasyāvaśyakatvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: janmāntarasahasrasya sakṛtaṃ tasya naśyatitrividhaṃ māṃsaṃ saṃproktaṃ devatāprītikārakamkṣudrāṇi tāni sarvāṇi adhamāni vidurbudhāḥmahāmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ devatāprītikārakamlaśunañca mahādevi māṃsapratinidhiḥ smṛtaḥpūjākāle devatāyā mudraiṣā parikīrttitāteṣāṃ saṃjñā kṛtā mudrā mahāmodapradāyinīoṃ tadviṣṇorityādinā mudrāñca śodhayetsaṃśodhanamanācarya nācaretkulapūjanambalādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaretiti śaktiśodhanampūrvaśodhitadravyantu guptenaiva ca saṃkṣipetmahāyogī bhaveddevi pīṭhaprakṣālanairjalaiḥtena pañcamakāreṇa pūjā karttavyāvaṭukaṃ bhairavīñcaiva durgāñca kṣetrapālakamtato bālāṃ kāmeśvarīñca pūjayetiti yat sthānavaiparītyaṃ tadaicchikamaṅgirāsthāne madireti vā pāṭhaḥaiṃ āgneyai namaḥpraveśaḥ sthāpanaṃ śakternava puṣpāṇi pūjaneyatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tatkṣaṇādeva sidhyatiśrīvidyetyupalakṣaṇamata eva varārohe nirvikalpaḥ sadā bhavetkulāmṛtaṃ śodhitamsvāhāpadaṃ tato devi śukraśuddhirbhavetpriye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arghyadravyaiśca deveśi yonau devīṃ prapūjayetvidhāya vanditāṃ tāñca taducchiṣṭaṃ svayañcaretānandaṃ kārayedvīrastattvaṃ nirbhrāntitaḥ pibetiti kulapūjātripuretyupalakṣaṇamamṛtīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktiñcābhimukhīṃ nayetviśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥtāsāṃ savyeṣu karṇeṣu tataḥ stotraṃ samācarettasya pūjāphalaṃ vatsa nīyate yakṣarākṣasaiḥvisṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavetsarva eva surāḥ pūjyāḥ satyaṃ brahmaśivādayaḥna pūjayati cetkāntāṃ tadā vighnairvilipyatetasmātsarva prayatnena pūjayetkulasundarīmkuryātniśāyāñca prajaptavyaṃ rātriśeṣe japenna tuetat kalpānmahādevi mantraḥ sidhyati niścitambindutīrthe'thavā snātvā punarjanma na vidyatesā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhiste prajāyatetadudbhavāmṛtenaiva tarpayeddehadevatāmtenāmṛtena divyena tarpayediṣṭadevatāmkalāsāreṇa sampūrya tarpayettena khecarīmmahāśūnye layaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇastiṣṭhati yogirāṭtadgarbhamityantaḥkaraṇasthamabhyaseditismaran siñcetdayāpuṣpaṃ kṣamāpuṣpaṃ jñānapuṣpañca pañcamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti caturthāhutiṃ juhuyāttayoraikye samutpanna ānando mokṣa ucyatemadhupānamidaṃ devi cetaranmadyapānakampare layaṃ nayeccittaṃ palāśīti nigadyatemāṃsāśī sa bhaveddevi itare prāṇighātakāḥmuktāste maithunaṃ tatsyāditare strīniṣevakāḥkumārīpūjayā devi phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavetkumārī bhojitā yena trailokyaṃ tena bhojitamevaṃ krameṇa sampūjyā yāvatpuṣpaṃ na vidyatemahānavamyāṃ deveśi kumārīṃ ca prapūjayetkumārikā hyahaṃ nātha sadā tvaṃ hi kumārikābhaktibhāvena sampūjya kumārībhyo nivedayetdakṣiṇāñca kumārībhyo dadyātprakramatastathābhuktimuktiphalaṃ tasya saubhāgyaṃ sarvasampadaḥtatphalaṃ labhate marttyo yastu kanyāṃ vivāhayetekaikaṃ kulamuddhṛtya rudralokemahīyateśivarūpatvaṃ sampradānīye vibhāvya dadyāditi rahasyārthaḥtadā prasādamāyānti yantra-mantrārcanādayaḥjīvanmuktaśca dehānte nirvāṇapadamāpnuyātaikyaṃ jīvātmanorāhuryogaṃ yogaviśāradāḥyogāṅgairebhirjitvā tān yogino yogamāpnuyuḥaṣṭāṅgānyāhuretāni yogino yogasādhanekṣamā dhṛtimitāhāraḥ śaucaṃ ceti yamā daśadaśaite niyamāḥ proktā yogaśāstraviśāradaiḥprāṇāyāmamimaṃ prāhuryogaśāstraviśāradāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
