sanskrit: tadapetaṃ nirgarbhañca prāṇāyāmaṃ paraṃ viduḥuttamasyaguṇāvāptiryāvacchīlanamiṣyatebalādāharaṇaṃ tebhyaḥ pratyāhāro vidhīyatedhāraṇaṃ prāṇamaruto dhāraṇeti nigadyateātmanyabhīṣṭadevānāṃ dhyānaṃ dhyānamihocyatesamādhimāhurmunayaḥ proktamaṣṭāṅgalakṣaṇamidānīṃ kathaye te'haṃ mantrayogamanuttamamtāsu mukhyā daśa proktāstāsu tisro vyavasthitāḥdāḍimīkeśara-prakhyā viṣākhyā munibhiḥ smṛtāsarva-tejomayī sā tu suṣumnā bahurūpiṇīvisargādvinduparyantametattiṣṭhati tattvataḥmadhye svayambhuliṅgantu koṭisūryasamaprabhamtadūrdhve tu śikhākārā kuṇḍalī brahmavigrahādrutahemasamaprakhyaṃ padmaṃ tatra vibhāvayetbādilāntaṣaḍvarṇena yuktādhiṣṭhānasaṃjñakamsvaśabdena paraṃ liṅgaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ tato viduḥtatpadmaṃ maṇivadbhinnaṃ maṇipūraṃ tathocyateśivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ padmaṃ viśvalokaikakāraṇamkādiṭhāntākṣarairarkapatraiśca samadhiṣṭhitamanāhatākhyaṃ padmaṃ tatmunibhiḥ parikīrtyateviśuddhaṃ padmamākhyātamākāśākhyaṃ mahādbhutamājñāsaṃkramaṇaṃ tatra gurorājñeti kīrtitamevañca śivacakrāṇi proktāni tava suvratasahasrārāmbujaṃ vindusthānaṃ tadūrdhvamīritamgudameḍhrāntare śaktiṃ tāmākuñcya prabodhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śambhunā tāṃ parāṃ śaktimekībhāvaṃ vicintayetānayettena mārgeṇa mūlādhāraṃ tataḥ sudhīḥjarāmaraṇaduḥkhādyairmucyate bhavabandhanātityetaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yogamārgamanuttamamtanmayo bhavati kṣipraṃ jīvabrahmaikyayojanāttadāvayavayogena yogī yogānsamabhyasetsthāne niyojayenmantrī viśuddhaḥ śuddhacetasākṛṣṇa ityupalakṣaṇamtālavṛntena kiṃ kāryaṃ labdhe malayamārutedvayorabhyāsayogo hi brahmasaṃsiddhikāraṇamevaṃ māyāvṛto hyātmā manunā gocarīkṛtaḥdurlabhaṃ viṣayāsaktaiḥ sulabhaṃ tvādṛśāmapināḍyastatra samudbhūtā mukhyāstisraḥ prakīrtitāḥtayormadhyagatā nāḍī suṣumnā vaṃśamāśritābrahma sthānaṃ samāpannā somasūryāgnirūpiṇīdivāmārgamidaṃ prāhuramṛtānanda kāraṇamjñātau yoganidānajñaiḥ suṣumnāyāñca tāvubhaujyotiṣāṃ nilayaṃ divyaṃ prāhurāgamavedinaḥparisphurati sarvātmā suptāhi sadṛśākṛtiḥhaṃsaḥ prāṇāśrayo nityaṃ prāṇā nāḍīpathāśrayāḥdehaṃ vāpya svanāḍībhiḥ prayāṇaṃ kurute vahiḥbaddhaivamāsanaṃ yogī yogamārgaparo bhavetāsanabhūtodaye prāguktedhārayenmārutaṃ samyagyogo'yaṃ yogivallabhaḥmattabhṛṅgāvalīgītasadṛśaḥ prathamo dhvaniḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānamutpadyate pūrvaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇamavyayamajapā kathitā tābhyāṃ jīvo yāmupatiṣṭhateyadā tadbhāvamāpnoti tadā so'hamiyaṃ bhavetsandhi kuryātpūrvarūpaṃ tadāsau praṇavo bhavetātmābhedasthitaṃ yogī praṇavaṃ bhāvayet sadānityānandaguṇālayaṃ sakṛtinaṃ paśyanti ruddhendriyāḥsāndrasudhāmburāśimravimaṇḍalasthampurāṇammukuṭendukhaṇḍavilasaddivyāmṛtaughaplutamśive layaṃ nityaguṇābhiyukte, nirbījayogaṃ phalanirvyapekṣamsaṃbhāvya svagṛhaṃ gatāṃ punarimāṃ sañcintayetkuṇḍalīmsvāśrayamarkakoṭirucirā dhyeyā jaganmohinīsaṃvīkṣya svapuraṃ gatā bhagavatī dhyeyānavadyā guṇaiḥuditā kulakāmadhenureṣā bhajatāṃ kāṃkṣitakalpavallarīāgame devadevyā hi āgamācya parā gatiḥsiddhayo'ṣṭau kare teṣāṃ dhanadhānyādisūnavaḥāpnuvanti paraṃ brahma sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥpādayugeṣu yācekṣantavyametatkaruṇānidhāna, krodho na cārhaḥ khalu pāmareṣuyathoktacintayā cintyāṃ bhogamokṣapradāyinīmaṣṭākṣarī mahāvidyā gaṅgāyā bhuvi durlabhākundenduśaṅkhadhavalāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmdattvā saṃpūjayedbrahmannupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśadhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manoharaṃ sutalpañca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśaanyatsarvaṃ sāmānyapaddhatyuktavatviṣaṃ praṇavaṃ, raudraṃ māyābījamṣaṇmukhaṃ tuṅganetrañca sarvasainyapuraskṛtamdevyāścaritametat tu, sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇāmaṣṭākṣaro mahāmantraḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevyāḥ prakīrttitaḥpavitrarūpāṃ paramāṃ devasenāmahaṃ bhajemaṅgalacaṇḍyā brahmavaivarte jñeyamhalāhalaṃ praṇavaḥevaṃ jaratkārumunyāstīkamunināgādyāvaraṇānpūjayetpūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavatpūjādikaṃ pūrvavatabhiṣeke pūjane ca pātu māṃ śuklarūpiṇīpāhi māṃ sarvato rakṣetgaṅgātripathagāminīalakanandā ca vāmabhāge pṛthivyāṃ yā tu tiṣṭhatipañcākṣaramimaṃ mantraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapigurviṇī janayet putraṃ bandhyā putravatī bhavetyaḥ paṭhedgṛhamadhye tu gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhetyaḥ praṭhetprayato bhaktyā muktaḥ koṭikulaiḥ sahakathaṃ me santatistiṣṭhet brūhi me munipuṃ"gavatatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhārayaoṃ bāhuleyaḥ śiraḥ pāyāt skandhau śaṅkaranandanaḥkaṭiṃ pāyacchaktihasto jaṅghe me tārakāntakaḥskando me rakṣatāmaṅgaṃ daśadigagnibhūrmamṣāṇmāturo bhaye ghore kumāro'vyācchraśānake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhṛtvā putramavāpnoti subhavyaṃ cirajīvinamkavacasya prasādena jīvavatsā bhavetsatīdhārikāyāstathā putro nirjarairapi durjayaḥvaṃśalābhākhyakavacaṃ kṛpayā me prakāśayayasya prasādāt kamalā lebhe tanayamuttamamjayantamindravanitā devapatnyaḥ sutānapibhavānī nayane pātu bhruvau śaṅkarasundarīuru gaurī sadā pātu kauṣikī jānuyugmakampādau brahmamayī pātu śravaṇe bhuvaneśvarīrudrāṇī hṛdayaṃ pātu stanadvandvaṃ maheśvarīoṃ iti te kathitaṃ vipra kavacaṃ devapūjitamdhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā paṭhennaraḥtrinetrāṃ pāṇivinyasta pāśāṃkuśavarābhayāmvāñchāpradañca sarveṣāṃ gūḍhaṃ vedeṣu nāradaśubhāyai devasenāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namonamaḥsukhadāyai mokṣadāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥmāyāyai siddhayoginyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥbālādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥpratyakṣāyai ca bhaktānāṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥdevarakṣaṇakāriṇyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥdhanaṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi putraṃ dehi sureśvarikalyāṇañca jayaṃ dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥyaśasvinañca rājendraṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥaputro labhate putraṃ varaṃ sucirajīvinamsarvapāpādvinirmukto mahābandhyā prasūyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarpayāmipadañcoktvā namontaṃ tarpayettataḥdvitīyānteṣu cetyevaṃ tarpaṇasya manuḥ smṛtaḥhomatarpaṇayoḥ svāheti tattanmantravacanātsvāhāntaṃ tarpayantvevam ityādikulāmṛtavacanāttatrāśaktaścenmūlamantramuccārya iṣṭadevatāmātraṃ tarpayetaśaktau mūlamuccārya devīmātraṃ pratarpayetsvāhāntaṃ mantramuccāryaṃ arghyaṃ datvā japenmanumidamarghyaṃ dattvā, tattaddevatā gāyatrīṃ śatadhā vā japetiti daśadhā śaktāśaktabhedenaiti yāmalavacanātiti garuḍagāyatrīgadāpadmadharāṃ devīṃ sūryāsana - kṛtāśrayāmsūryamaṇlamadhyasthāṃ dhyāyan devīṃ samabhyasetsvecchāgṛhītavapuṣīṃ guru vidyākṣarātmikāmparitaḥ svātmamukhyābhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaśaktibhiḥcintayitvā bhagavatīṃ nityābhiḥ parivāritāmanyatra kālikāmantre ekajaṭāpadasthāne kālikāpadaprayogaḥnamaskṛtya, yāgasthānamāviśediti snānavidhiḥkuryātvāyuṃ recayetso'hamevaṃ samābhāsya jīvaṃ hṛdi samānayetsmaraṇānnarakaṃ yāti dīkṣā ca viphalā bhavetjīvaṃ tejomayaṃ dhyātvā namomantreṇa yojayetavyayabrahmasaṃyogādbhūtaśuddhiriyaṃ mateti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sucirāyuṣmantameva ṣaṣṭhīdevī prasādataḥviṣṇavī nāgabhaginī śaivā nāgeśvarī tathāmahājñānayutā caiva sā devī viśvapūjitātasya nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya vaṃśodbhavasya canāgakṣatamahādurge nāgaveṣṭitavigrahenityaṃ paṭhedvāstu dṛṣṭvā nāgavargaḥ palāyateviṣaṃ bhavetsudhātulyaṃ siddhastotro yadā bhavetmantrāṇāṃ phaladātrī ca dhātrī ca jagatāṃ satīhutāśa-dāhikāśaktistatprāṇādhikarūpiṇīdevajīvanarūpā ca devapāṣāṇakāriṇīaputro labhate putramabhāryo labhate priyāmrādhāsamā tatsakhī ca śrīkṛṣṇapreyasī priyeāvirbhūtā dakṣiṇāṃsātkṛṣṇasya tena dakṣiṇākṛṣṇadakṣāṃsavāsācca rādhāśāpācca dakṣiṇākṛpāṃ kuru mahābhāge māmeva svāminaṃ kurutvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ sarvakarma ca niṣphalamtvayā vinā tathā karma karmiṇāñca na śobhatekarmaṇaśca phalaṃ dātuṃ na śaktāśca tvayā vināyajñarūpī viṣṇurahaṃ tvameṣāṃ sārarūpiṇīsvayaṃ kṛṣṇaśca bhagavān sa ca śaktastvayā sahasarvakarmaṇi śakto'haṃ tvayā saha varānanetuṣṭā vabhūva sā devī bhajettāṃ kamalākalāmphalañca sarvayajñānāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥaśvamedhe maṅgale ca viṣṇuyajñe yaśasvarelauhayajñe svarṇayajñe pāṭane brahmakhaṇḍane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iṣṭau varuṇayāge ca kaṇṭake vairimardanebandhane karmayāge ca maṇiyāge subhadrakenirvighne ca tatkarma sāṅgaṃ bhavati niścitamnamaste revatīkānta namaste bhaktavatsalapralambāre namaste'stu trāhi māṃ kṛṣṇapūrvajayaḥ paṭhetaprayato bhaktyā sarvasiddheḥ sa bhājanamsiddhāsiddhāsiddhāsiddhāsṛjasyādisargemukhyādhyāyase'mbasādhayāmidūtāḥmatyāmetasya satatābhyāsātsiddhiḥ karatale sthitāpaṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena naimittikasamarhaṇesā kālī karavālakālakalanā hastvaśriyaṃ caṇḍikābhaktānāmabhayapradā vijayadā viśveśasiddhāsanāpunātuyakṣiṇī-nāyikānāntu saṃkṣepātsiddhidāyakamyakṣiṇī svayamāyāti kavacajñānamātrataḥpaṭhanāddhāraṇānmartyo yakṣiṇī vaśamānayetdevatā yakṣiṇī devī sarvasiddhipradāyinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ śiro me yakṣiṇī pātu lalāṭaṃ yakṣakanyakācakṣuṣī varadā pātu nāsikāṃ bhaktavatsalāskandhau kulālapā pātu galaṃ me kamalānanāvikṛtāsyā sadā pātu mahāvakrapriyā mamabheruṇḍā mākarī devī hṛdayaṃ devasammatādhārmikāguhyadeśaṃ me pāduyugmaṃ surāṅganāniṣkalaṅkā sadā pātu cāmbuvatyakhilāṃ tanumlakṣmībījātmikā pātu nijabījaprakāśinīśūnyāgāre nadītīre mahāyakṣeśakanyakāmahāsaṅkaṭamadhye tu saṃgrāme ripusañcayesarvatra sarvadā pātu bhavānī kuladāyikāasyāpi smaraṇādeva rājatvaṃ labhate'cirātvedajñānī sarvaśāstravettā bhavati niścitamyakṣiṇī kulavidyā ca samāyāti susiddhidāsthitvā japellakṣamantramiṣṭasiddhiṃ labhenniśigrahaṇāde siddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāsākṣātsiddhiṃ samāpnoti yoginīstotrapāṭhataḥrājyaṃ mitrakalatra-putradhanade mātaḥ samādhehi mekṣama kulāpatāpaṃ mudāgaurī vidyādharī śyāmā prasannā bhava sarvadātvamekā pātu māṃ dhātrī svarṇapātrakarāmbujāprasannā bhava śabdākhyā kāminī kāmadāyinīnamāmi varade devi yoginīgaṇaseviteamale kamale devi dāridryadoṣabhañjinīkalikālakṛte devi khacarīśatanāyike
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhidā vidhurāṇāñca akālamṛtyunāśinīvākyasiddhipradā devī padmarāgasumālinīmāyābījātmikā devī vadhūbījasamākulevicitrambāraśobhāṅgī nānālaṅkāraveṣṭitesmerānanābje kāmeśi mamājñāpaya durlabhamsiddhidā varadā mātā bhaginī vā bhava priyāmamāgre saṃsthirā bhūtvā siddhidā bhava sarvadāśatavarṣasahasrāṇi māmekaṃ rakṣasevakamkiṅkiṇījālamālāḍhyāṃ tripurāṃ padmalocanāmtvāmekāṃ jagatāṃ devi siddhividyāṃ namāmyahamdaśavarṣasahasrāṇi siddhe kamalalocanāmetatstotraṃ paṭhedvidvān dhyānābhyāsasamanvitamsiddhiṃ yacchanti bhūtinyaḥ stotrapūjā prabhāvataḥkavacaśravaṇe śraddhā sāmprataṃ kathyatāṃ mamanābhaktāya pradātavyaṃ deyaṃ bhaktimate sadāchando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca tridevātmā guruḥ svayamudyadbhālalalāṭaṃ me kṛpādṛṣṭirdṛśau mamahṛdayaṃ pātu mantroktirvarābhayadharaḥ karaugurupādanakhajyotsnā sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadāvatuānandabhairavaḥ pātu sadaivānanda mandiramhiṃsrebhyaḥ sarvadā pātu śrīprāsādaparo manuḥhaṃsaḥ pīṭhaṃ pātu cordhvaṃ sarvadikṣu sadāvatumānavaughāḥ kriyāṃ pāntu śrīguruḥ sarvadāvatusatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇāvṛthāśramo bhavettasya na siddhirmantrapūjane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadā mantrasya yantrasya siddhirbhavati nānyathāguru-gopyañca karttavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ kadācanadātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya kulīnāya viśeṣataḥiti te kathitaṃ putra sāvadhāno'vadhārayaprasannavadanāṃ kṣīṇamadhyāṃ dhyāyecchivāṃ gurumraktakaṅkaṇapāṇiñca ratnanūpuraśobhitāmśaravindupratīkāśavaktrodbhāsitavigrahāmevaṃ dhyātvā pūjayettadākhyā devatā proktā caturvargaphalapradāklīṃ bījaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ pātu sarvāṅgaṃ me sadāśivaḥśrīṃ bījaṃ skandhadeśaṃ me hasakhaphreṃ bhujadvayamkṣavarṇastadadhaḥ pātu lakāro hṛdayaṃ mamhūṅkāro vāmapārśvañca sakāro merumeva camakāraścāṃguliṃ pātu lakāraḥ pātu me nakhamyīṅkāraḥ pādayugalaṃ hsauḥ sarvāṅgake'vatuaiṃ bījaṃ pātu pūrve me hrīṃ bījaṃ dakṣiṇe'vatuaiṃ pātu cāgnikoṇe ca vedādyā nair-ṛte'vatupūjayāmi tathā cordhvaṃ namaścādhaḥ sadā'vatusa siddhaḥ sa gaṇaḥ so'pi śivaḥ sākṣānna saṃśayaḥtrisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭheddevi sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥtasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ gatāḥsabhāyāṃ jayamāpnoti mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥsa eva siddhalokeśo nirvāṇapadamīyateyasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācanaabhaktebhyastu deveśi putrebhyo'pi na darśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya pare ca narakaṃ vrajetjānannapi tatsundari mātarna guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikammanye mitraṃ vittakalatraṃ na guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamsādhoḥ sevā bahusurabhaktirna guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamviṣṇoriva pitṛsevanayogo na guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamiṣṭeḥ pūjā japatapobhaktirna guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamavatārādikamanyatsarvaṃ na guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamavatārāniti daśakaṃ manye na guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamyamunā revā parataratīrthaṃ na guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikametatsarvaṃ sundari mātarna guroradhikaṃ na guroradhikamguroradhikaṃ na guroradhikambrahmāṇḍāntaryadyad jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ na guroradhikamhanūmānhanūmānvāyusuto hanūmānhanūmānhanūmānvāyusutau hanūmānhanūmānsaṃgrāmajayadaṃ puṇyaṃ devānāmapi durlabhamviṣaṃ na vādhate tasya na taṃ hiṃsanti hiṃsakāḥputrārthī putramāpnoti nārī patyuḥ priyā bhavetdurbalo balamāpnoti bhavetvāyusutopamaḥbandhanānmuktimāpnoti yātrāyāṃ siddhireva cacānye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhajanti ye devi mahīpatīnāṃ brajanti te sampadamādareṇanamāmiālolanīlālakamāyatākṣaṃ mandasmitaṃ te vadanaṃ maheśidevī devadevo tribhuvanajananī caṇḍikā pātu yuṣmānpāyādvau vandyamānaḥ pralayamuditayā bhairavaḥ kālarātryābhramantīcaṇḍamuṇḍaṃ maṭamaṭamaṭitaṃ carvayantī punātusaṃhāre dhārayantī mama haratu bhayaṃ bhadradā bhadrakālītāmranetrā niśāyāmkumārī maraṇabhayaharā tvaṃ śivā caṇḍaghaṇṭāśatrūccāṭe māraṇādau jantūnāṃ mohane tathādevadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagāḥdūrāddūrataraṃ yānti kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥsarvaśāntirbhaveddevi cānte nirvāṇatāṃ vrajetśarānunā astramantreṇa iti tadarthaḥeṣā tu gulikā devi kaṇṭhalagnā sukhapradābhagavān punarācakṣe śrotrādīnāṃ nirūpaṇampaśyatītilayaṃ śrotraṃ nānyathā śṛṇuyādvacaḥcaṇḍikāyā abhāve'tra vidyunnetrahṛdāsavaḥanavo'sya parijñeyāḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥtatra tu uktamantreṇa tatpūrvabījasya grahaṇamiti śrotrādijñānamkuryādeva hi taccito mantro śrotradivijñānampuraścaraṇasampanno vīrasiddhiṃ samācaretcaturthañca tato devi padāntaṃ paricintayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāhyāṅgavibhāvanāṃ kṛtvā mantrajapādikaṃ kuryāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0)

sanskrit: brahmamārgaḥ suṣumnāsusūkṣmetenaiva vidhinā devi sthiro kuryānnijāṃ tanumṣuṣumnāvartmanātmānaṃ paramātmani yojayetityantarmārtṛkāṃ nyasya sarvāṅganyāsamācaretetāśca mātṛkāmudrāḥ rameṇa parikīrtitāḥśrīkaṇṭhādyānimānnyasyetsarvamantraḥ prasīdatiśrīvidyāviṣaye mantrī vāgbhavādyaṣṭasiddhayeviparītaphalaṃ dadyādabhaktyā pūjanaṃ yathāaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ vā cānyathā viphalaṃ bhavetśyāmādividyāyāṃ viśeṣamātṛkānyāso vaktavyaḥprāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vināsagarbho mantrajāpena nirgarbho mātrayā bhavetkālena mātrā sājñeyā munibhirvedapāragai'yaugike punarmātrāniyamaḥtattatkalpokta pīṭhaśaktīrmadhye pīṭhamanuñca nyasetsaṃsādhayati śuddhātmā sa tasya ṛṣirīritaḥgurutvānmastake cāsya nyāsastu parikīrtitaḥakṣaratvātpadatvācca mukhe chandaḥ samīritamhṛdayāmbhojamadhyasthā devatā tatra tāṃ nyasetdaurbalyaṃ yāti mantrāṇāṃ viniyogamajānatāmśaktiñca pādayoścaiva sarvāṅge kīlakaṃ nyasetdevatābhāvamāpnoti mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatedṛṣṭvāvighnāḥ palāyante siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā gajāḥsarvavighnaiḥ sa bādhyaḥ syādvyāghrairmṛgaśiśuryathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃgulīnāmiti vacanāditi sarvatra sādhāraṇamtisṛbhistarjanīmadhyamānāmābhiḥiti rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtavacanātṣaḍaṅgamantrānityuktān ṣaḍaṅgeṣu niyojayetiti śāradāvacanamviśvagviṣaktaḥ kathitāstramudrā yatrākṣiṇī tarjanīmadhyame casvanāmādyakṣaraṃ bījaṃ sarveṣāmabhidhīyatekuryādvahirarcanamśaṅkhasthāpantu dīkṣāprakaraṇe uktamiti darśanātśarīre pīṭhapūjāoṃ parāparagurubhyo namaḥ, oṃ parameṣṭhigurubhyo namaḥtripurādau tu viśeṣagurupūjā vaktavyāmadhye madhye ca śaktīrnava samabhiyajetpīṭhamantreṇa bhūyaḥtārādividyādau tu viśeṣo vaktavyaḥsavyañca dakṣiṇaṃ vidyāddakṣiṇañcottaraṃ matamanena vidhinā mantrī pūrvādau pūjanaṃ caretṣaṭkoṇakarṇikaṃ tatra vedadvāropaśobhitamprāṇapratiṣṭhāntaṃ karma kuryatsaṃyojya - yantramadhye tatsaṃsthāpyāvāhayettataḥtataḥ ṣoḍaśopa"cāraiḥ pañcopacārairvā pūjayetprayojayedarcanāyāmupacārastu ṣoḍaśaḥgandhādayo naivedyāntā pūjā pañcoparacārikā itiprayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāndaśa kramātityādinā syāttato dhūpadīpau dadyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛṣṭiparyantaṃ dīpaṃ dadyātiti vacanādupārānarghyapātrasthalenotsṛjya dadyātvaiṣṇave tu naivedye viśeṣo vaktravyaḥdadyātmantrāte karmasannipāta iti nyāyātnamaskārānantaraṃ vāiti japaṃ samarpyaṃ stutvā natvā'ṣṭāṅgapramāṇaṃ kuryātsahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyātśaṅkhahastena sarvatra pradakṣiṇaṃ prakīrtitamtataśca dakṣiṇaṃ gatvā namaskārastrikoṇavatsomasūtraṃ jalaniḥsaraṇasthānamtridhā ca veṣṭayetsamyagdevatāyāḥ pradakṣiṇeakāle darśanaṃ viṣṇorhanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtamsuṣumnāvartmanā puṣpamāghrāyodvāsayettataḥviśvaksenaḥ smṛto viṣṇostejaścaṇḍo vivasvata ityādianyadyathāyogyāya dattvā yathāsukhaṃ vihareditiviṣṇoriti tattadevatāparamnirmālyañca śucau deśe naivedyaṃ bhakṣayetsudhīḥaṅgalagnaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatibhuvaneśvarīṃ tāmbrahmādayo'pi vāṃ jñātvā lebhire paramāṃ śriyamarddhacandro'nusvāraḥata eva maheśāni bhuvaneśīti kathyatekarṇikāyāṃ hrīṃ sarvaśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥhatūryabījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ repha ucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: satyādi pañcahrasvāḍhyā nyastavyā bhūtasaṃprabhāḥsarvatra karāṅganyāse evaṃ kramaḥnyastavyaṃ vadane mūlaṃ bhūyaścaitāṃ stanau nyasetsavyāṃse parśvayugale nābhideśe ca deśikaḥevaṃ sarvatraevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya vahiḥpūjāmārabhetacaturasraṃ caturdvārameva maṇḍalamālikhetsarvatra praṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayetsavāhanāyeti kramadīpikāasya puraścaraṇaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣajapaḥtrisvāduryuktairjuhuyādaṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśataḥtrisvādviti ghṛtamadhuśarkarā itiṣaḍaṅgāni manorasya jātiyuktena deśikaḥsaumyāṃ ratnaghaṭasthasavyacaraṇāṃ dhyāyetparāmambikāmtaddaśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī pīṭhe prāgīrite yajeditivacanātpūrvavannyāsaḥṣaḍaṅgānītyādievaṃ dhyātvā pūrvavadyajetanyat sarvaṃ pūrvavadbodhāmcaturviṃśatilakṣamiti kecitasyaikākṣarīvat ṛṣicchandodevatānyāsaḥṛṣyādyāḥ pūrvamuktāḥ syurbījenāṅgakriyā mantātāmṣoḍaśadale pūjāyā anuktatvātṣoḍaśadalābhāvaḥannapūrṇa ṭhayugalaṃ manuḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: annapradāmokṣadā ca sadā vibhavadāyinīśrībījādyā yadā devi tadā sukhavivarddhinīvibhavadāyinī śrīmāyāyugmabījādyā sarvasampattipūraṇīpaṃktiśchandaḥ samākhyātaṃ devatā cānnapūrṇikākalpe ca: yadvījādyā bhavedvidyā tadbījenāṅgakalpanāevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātśūdrasya praṇavaṃ devi kathitaṃ tantravedibhiḥyadyadbījādiko mantrastenaivāṅga prakalpanāśrīmāyāmadanaiḥ prokto mantro bījatryātmakaḥmadhye devīṃ samāvāhya dhyāyetsarvaṃ samṛddhidāmdviruktaistadbījairaṅgāni ṣaṭkramātevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātityādinā ṣaḍaṅgāni pūjayettadbahirindrādīnvanitā rūpānpūjayetdakṣiṇāmūrtivacanātekārastadyuktaḥ kṣaḥ, punarbhuvaneśvarī phaṭtvaritā devatā proktā puruṣārthaphalapradāyatrāvāhya maheśānīmupacāraiḥ samarcayetpañcānanāya hṛdayaṃ pīṭhamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥmūlena vyāpakaṃ kuryātvinyasya vyāpakaṃ kuryātsamastenaiva sādhakaḥdvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryātsādhakasattamaḥevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvilvaistrimadhvaktaiḥ samidvaraiḥdrave vahnivadhūrmantro dvādaśārṇo'yamīritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛṣiḥ sammohanaśchando nivṛnnityā ca devatā itivācā kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgāni nityāṃ dhyāyedyathāvidhievaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādi visarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetkusumairayutaṃ hutvā toṣayedgurumātmanaḥsvāhānto ravisaṃkhyārṇo mantro vaśyapradāyakaḥṣaṭkoṇaṃ dvādaśadalaṃcaturdvāraṃ caturasrañcavajraprastāriṇī proktā devatābhīṣṭadāyinītivāgbhavena ṣaḍaṅgāni vidadhyānmantravittamaḥstanabhāranamitāmambikāmāśrayāmaḥrājavṛkṣaḥ śoṇāluḥiti bhaṭṭaḥdadyādāsanametena mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayetdurgā samīritā sadbhirduritāpannivāriṇītihrāmādyaiḥ saha kurvīta ṣaḍaṅgāni yathāvidhievaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātdurgāyai hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādinā pūjayettato dhūpādi visarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetvācaniko'ṣṭasahasrahomaḥvadhūvījādiḥ kavacādiśca navākṣaraḥkāmaṃ praṇavamityuktaṃ bhavedvidyā punardaśatataḥ pūrvokta - ṛṣyādinyāsañca kṛtvā karāṅganyāsau kuryāttarjaniamapi vibhratīṃ nijabāhubhiḥ śaśiśekharāmiti vacanāt śaṅkhaniṣedhaḥdīrghādyatvametāsāntu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīrghasvaraiḥ kramāditi śāradāvacanāccatasastrāṇi siddhamayī prayogañca samācaretityādi vacanātbalidānasya mantro'yaṃ mardinyāḥ parikīrtitaḥdviṭhānto jayadurgayaṃ vidyā vedyā daśākṣarīevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya arghyasthānaṃ kuryātaṣṭākṣarodite pīṭhe pūrvavatpūjayetsudhīḥbhūtendriyākṣaraiḥ prokto grahakṣudravināśakṛtśūlinī devatā proktā samastasuravanditetiśūlinyādyā huṃ phaḍantāḥ pañca vai manavaḥ kramāttataḥ patrāgreṣu tadastrāṇi pūjayetsarpiṣānnena vā homastaddaśāṃśamito bhavetvada vada vāgvādini vahnivallabhā iti daśākṣaraḥbhuvaneśīsaṃpuṭo'yaṃ mahāsārasvatapradaḥnamaḥ sarvatrahṛdi vāgīśvaryai devatāyai namaḥtato mātṛkāyāḥ karāṅganyāsau kṛtvā dhyāyetnyasya varṇān ṣaḍaṅgāni mātṛkoktāni kalpayetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttadbahirindrādīn vajrādīṃśca pūjayetpuṇḍarīkaiḥ payo'bhyaktaistilairvā madhurāplutaiḥmanuḥ ṣoḍaśavarṇādhyo vāgaiśvaryaphalapradaḥpūrvoktapīṭhaśaktiḥ pīṭhamanuñca nyasetmanoḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ padaiḥ kuryājjātiyuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādante tilairājyapariplutaiḥṅentānatyantako mantraṃ prokta ekādaśākṣaraḥṛṣyādinyāsaṃ kuryātguhye maṃ namaḥmantravarṇānnyasenmantrī vāgbhavenāṅgakalpanāevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetnāgacampakapuṣpairvā juhuyātsādhakottamaḥvāgādyo manurākhyāto rudrasaṃkhyākṣaro'paraḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣubhūyādvāgadhidevatā munigaṇairāsevyamānāniśamrudralakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥviśvasāravacanātvāgbhavabījamevaaṅgāni kalpayenmantrī dviruktairjātisaṃyutaiḥiti dhyātvā pūrvavatpūjayetpāyasairājyasammiśraiḥ saṃskṛte havyavāhanesarasvatī ṅentāḥ natiścasarasvatyai namaḥkuryāt) anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavatṣaḍdīrghasvarasabhinnabījenāṅgakriyā matābhavadabhimataprāptaye bhāratī syātiti sarasvatīmantrāḥyān jñātvā mānavā nityaṃ sādhayanti manorathānpañcāntakaṃ gakāraḥpīṭhamantro'yametena pradadyādāsanaṃ vibhoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṇeśāya devatāyai namaḥṣaḍdīrghabhājā vījena kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭkramātevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjyārghyasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetaṣṭadravyāṇi vighnasya kathitāni manīṣibhiḥaṣṭāviṃśatyakṣaro'yaṃ tārādyo manurīritaḥme vaśamānaya svāhāmahāgaṇapataye devatāyai namaḥevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥsampūjya vahiḥ pūjāmārabhetatato dhūpādī visarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetjuhuyāddravyairaṣṭābhirmodakādibhiḥṅentamagnivadhuḥ prokto mantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥuditā devatā mantre nāmnā śaktigaṇādhipaḥśaktigaṇādhipataye devatāyai namaḥevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātāvarapūjāṃ kuryātjuhuyādarcite vahnau dineśo devamarcayetasya pūjāyantrañca pūrvavatetānyaṃguṣṭhādiṣu hṛdayādiṣu vinyasetapūpairājyayuktairvā juhuyānmantrasiddhayecaturvarṇātmako nṛṇāṃ caturvargaphalapradaḥśirasi gaṇaka-ṛṣaye namaḥ ityādiṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjyārghyasthāpanaṃ kuryātpūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hotavyaṃ pūrvavatprasādanāya hṛnmantraṃ svabījādyo daśākṣaraḥekākṣaravat karāṅganyāsau kṛtvā dhyāyetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetmadhuratritayairvāpi dravyairaṣṭābhirīritaiḥbījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakamgaṇapatiṃ pūjayetāvaraṇapūjāviniyogamekākṣaragaṇapativattrimadhura-yukta haridrā-cūrṇa-miśritaistaṇḍulairayutahomaḥekākṣarī mahāviyā kathitā padmayoginākarāṅganyāso tu ṣaḍdīrghayuktena svabījenaoṃ karādyāṃ mahāvidyāṃ nijabījādikāṃ tathācaturvarṇātmikā vidyā vahnijāyāvadhiḥ priyeetāsāṃ pūjādikaṃ mahāgaṇapatimantravatyasyāḥ kaṭākṣamātreṇa trailokyamapi varddhatebījametat śriyo devyāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradamvyuṣṭirutkṛṣṭir-ṛddhiśca samproktā navaśaktayaḥaṅgāni dīrghayuktena ramābījena kalpayettato dhūpādivisarjanānta karma samāpayetvilvaiḥ phalairvā juhuyāttribhirvā sādhakottamacaturvarṇātmako mantraḥcaturvargaphalapradaḥasya pūjādikaṃ pūrvavaddodhyamkāṃkṣitaparijātalatikāṃ vande sarojāsanāmjuhuyādaruṇaiḥ phullaistatsahasraṃ jitendriyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vānte sinyai priyā vahnermanuḥ prokto daśākṣaraḥṛṣirdakṣo virāṭachando devatāśrī samīritāastraṃ kamalarūpāyai namo'ntāḥ praṇavādikāḥvidhāyāvaraṇapūjāṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī madhurākteḥ saroruhaiḥmahālakṣmyāḥ samuddiṣṭastārādyaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥmahālakṣmyai devatāyai namaḥśeṣānnyasetsaptavarṇān hṛdaye saptadhātuṣujñānaiśvaryādayaḥ proktāḥ ṣaṭkramādaṅgadevatāḥtato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetayutadvayamiti vācanikavyavasthāyakāra ekārayuktaḥ,astrametaiḥ padaiḥ kuryātribījapuṭitaiḥ pṛthakevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthānaṃ kuryātanurāgāya mahālakṣmībāṇāya namaḥ evaṃ krameṇa pūjayetdaśāṃśaṃ saṃskṛte vahnau prākproktenaiva vartmanāaṣṭākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhānorabhimatapradaḥpīṭhamantro'yamākhyāto dineśasya jagatpateḥādityo devatā prokto dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣuphaṭ dviṭhāntāḥ pṛthagīritāḥguhye iṃ bhāskarāya, caraṇayoḥ aṃ sūryāyamantravarṇān nyasedaṣṭau pratyekaṃ praṇavādināsamāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atrāpi vācanika evāṣṭasahasrahomaḥsargānvito bhṛgurbhānostryakṣaro'yaṃ samīritaḥṛṣyādinyāsaṃ kuryātmūrddhādikaṇṭhaparyantaṃ kramādvījatrayaṃ nyasetṣaḍdīrghayuktamadhyena bījenāṅgādikalpanātato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayettilairvā madhurāsiktairjuhuyādvijitendriyaḥpuṭitaṃ vimbabījena sarvakāmaphalapradamṭāntaṃ dahananetrendusahitaṃ tadudāhṛtampūrvavat-ṛṣyādinyāsaṃ kuryātvyāpakaṃ mūlabījena kurvīta tadantaramevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya arghyasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdakṣāṃśaṃ kamalaiḥ phullairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥvāksiddhimatulāṃ lakṣmīṃ saubhāgyamapi sādhayetajapākhyo manuḥ prokto dvyakṣaraḥ surapādapaḥdevatā jagatāmādiḥ saṃproktā girijāpatiḥhsāṃ ṣaḍdīrghayuktena kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ manoḥtato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī tataḥ siddho bhavennaraḥyasya saṃsmaraṇāt santo bhāvābdhe pāramāśritāḥpāvano nāma mantro'yaṃ prokto vasvakṣaraḥ paraḥvaiṣṇavācamanaṃ kuryātsacaturthīnamo'ntaiśca nāmabhirvinyaset sudhīḥhṛdi arddhalakṣmīharaye devatāyai namaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arddhalakṣmīhariḥ proktaḥ śrībījena ṣaḍaṅgakamsānusvāraḥnamaḥ sarvatravidyuddāmasamābhāḥ syuḥ paṅkajābhayavāhavaḥoṃ śrīṃ aṃ keśavāya kīrttyai namaḥ ityādismṛti dhṛtiṃ mahālakṣmīṃ prāpyānte haritāṃ vrajetkaṃ namaḥ parāya pṛthivītattvātmane namaḥ pādayoḥevaṃ tattvāni vinyasya prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaretsarvātmasaṃyogayogapadmapīṭhātmane namaḥprahvī satyā tatheśānānugrahā navamī smṛtāpīṭhātmane hṛdanto'yaṃ mantrastārādiko hareḥmantrasya devī gāyatrī devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥsahasrolkāyāstramuktamaṅgakḷptiriyaṃ matāṇāṃ namo dakṣapārśve, yaṃ namo vāmapārśveyaṃ vinā naiva tatsamyagāsuraṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetgadāyāṃ padme ca vinyasetśaṅkhacakragadāmbhojapādaṣvavahito nyasetdvādaśākṣaramantraṃ nyasettataḥ kirīṭamantreṇa vyāpakaṃ vinyasettataḥasya vijñānamātreṇa vāsudevaḥ prajāyateevaṃ nyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ paramevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātpañcapātraṃ hareḥ śuddhaṃ nānyattatra niyojayetsauvarṇe rājate raupye ityādioṃ samānāya svāha iti sarvāḍaṃgulīraṃguṣṭhena spṛśet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taddaśāṃśaṃ sarasijairjuhuyānmadhurāplutaiḥṣaḍakṣaro'yamādiṣṭo bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥśrīrāmāya devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣu rāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādievaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātnamaḥ ityādinā ṣaḍaṅgāni pūjayettato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetjuhuyādarcite vahnau brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ syāccaturvargaphalapradaḥagastyaḥ śrīśivaḥ prokto munayo'tra kramādimedhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavacca samācaretdaśākṣaro'yaṃ mantraḥ syādvasiṭaḥ syādṛṣirvirāṭaādyaṃ bījaṃ dviṭhaḥ śaktiḥ kāmenāṅgakriyā matānābhyūrujānupādeṣu daśārṇānvinyasenmanoḥanyatsarvaṃ pūrvavatdvyakṣaro mantrarājo'yaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥtryakṣaro mantrarājaḥ syātsarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥbrahmā ṛṣiḥ syādgāyatrīcchando rāmaśca devatāeteṣāṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāguktaṣaḍakṣaravatrāśinakṣatravicāre punarbījarahitena vicāraḥluptabījasvabhāvatvāddaśākṣara ihocyate || iti gautamīyātnānyathā siddhaye bhavetyadvā mūlenaiva mantreṇa sarvatra prāṇāyāmaḥtattanmantravarṇasaṃkhyākai recakāditrayaṃ kuryātmantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāyai durgāyai namaḥ iti durgā namaskuryāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punaḥ sṛṣṭisthitīti pañcadhā kuryātasurāntakacakrāya svāhā kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭiti ṣṛṣṭinyāsaḥkarttavyaḥetāni namo'ntāni vinyasetkirīṭādinyāsastu sarvatra viṣṇumantretato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdaśāyutamsasitaghṛtasusiktairārabheddhomakarmaiti sanatkumāravacanātvidhāya dhyāyetveṇuṃ dhamanaghṛto dorbhyāṃ dhyeyaḥ kṛṣṇo divākareevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātsamāpayetjuhuyāt saṃskṛte vahnau mantrī sarvārthasiddhayekāmabījādirākhyāto manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥasya puraścaraṇaṃ daśākṣarapaṭaloktamśaktiśrīpūrvakaścāṣṭādaśārṇo viṃśadakṣaraḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣutato daśatattvāni vinyasya punarmūlena vyāpaka kuryātguṇāgni vedakaraṇakaraṇākṣyakṣarairmanoḥvyāpakaṃ vidhāya yathāśakti mudrāṃ badhvā dhyāyetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātdaśākṣara - caturdaśākṣara - ekādaśākṣarāṇāmitisāmānyayantramuddiṣṭamaṣṭādaśākṣare śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyathā tāpinyādivirodhaḥ syāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetcaturlakṣaṃ hunedājyaiścatvāriṃśatsahasrakamdvāviṃśatyakṣaro mantro vāgīśatvapradāyakaḥsṛṣṭisthiti tatpūjanaṃ nāsti tadvarṇābhāvātjuhuyātkarmaṇānena mantrasiddhirbhaveddhruvamdaśārṇo manuvaryaśca bhavecchakrākṣaro'paraḥśrīkṛṣṇāya devatāyai namaḥanya nyāsapūjājapahomādi sarvaṃ daśākṣaravatkāryamtrailokyamohano viṣṇuḥ kathitastava yatnataḥtrailokyamohano viṣṇurdevatā samudīritādīrghaṣaṭkayujānena kāmabījena kalpayettato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayethunettāvacca tarpayetasya nyāsapūjādikaṃ sarva pūrvavatsvāheti mantrarājo'yaṃ bhajatāṃ surapādapaḥhṛdi śrīkṛṣṇāya devatāyai namaḥityādievaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātkarma samāpayetdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī kusumairbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥśrīśaktismarakṛṣṇāya govindāya śiro manuḥratnābhiṣekavadṛṣyādinyāsaṃ kuryātevaṃ hṛdayādiṣu śrīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityāditattadvarṇābhāvāt asya puraścaraṇaṃ japahomaśca tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śiro'ntaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇo'yaṃ rukmiṇī vallabhāhvayaḥhṛdi rukmiṇīvallabhāya devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣuśaṇasūnapītavasano nānāvibhūṣo hariḥayutaṃ juhuyāt padmairaruṇairmadhurāplutaiḥmanto vikṛtiravyarṇāvācakrādyāṅkanāvimoviṃśatyarṇoktapūjāṃ kuryātpadmotpalakare tābhyāṃ śliṣṭaṃ cakragarojjvalamdaśalakṣaṃ japedājyairhunettāvatsahasrakamśrīpūrvau ṅe'ntāvuccārya huṃ phaṭ svāheti kīrtyatebījaśaktī ca tatsameśiro'nto bālavapuṣe klīṃ kṛṣṇāya smṛto vudhaiḥhṛdi śrīkṛṣṇāya devatāyai namaḥtataḥ pūrvavanmudrādikaṃ pradarśya dhyāyetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayettarpayettāvadeteṣāṃ manūnāṃ hutasaṃkhyayāvarṇayugmaiḥ samastena proktaṃ syādaṅgapañcakamjuhuyādbrahmavṛkṣotthasamidbhipāyasena vādigvidikṣvarcayedetān indravajrādikān vahiḥsa sarvasampatsampūrṇo nityaṃ śuddhavrajetpadamsaṃprokto mārayugmāntaḥ saṃsthakṛṣṇapadena tupūrvadṛṣyādinyāsakarāṅganyāsau ca kṛtvā dhyāyettrimadhvaktairvilvaphalaiścatvāriṃśatsahasrakamayaṃ manurityarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śārdūla - kāmāṃkuśalalitagaṇākapladīptaṃ mukundammadhutrayayutairhutvā cārcayet pūrvavaddharimpradhānaṃ vaiṣṇave tantre mantro'yaṃ surapādapaḥvāsudevāya devatāyai namaḥsamastena bhavedastramaṅgakalpanamīritamdhyāyetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātkarma samāpayettatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāttilairājyapariplutaiḥcaturdaśākṣaraḥ prokto mantro'yaṃ surapādapaḥvarṇalakṣaṃ mantravarṇasamasaṃkhyalakṣammahābalāya ṭhadvandvaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥcandrāntakalpite pīṭhe prāguktena samarcayetdvābhyāmastramiti proktaṃ prakāro'ṅgasya sūribhiḥvidhāya dhyāyetevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetpāyasānnaṃ prajuhuyāddadhyannambā yathāvidhibodhayadvitayānto'yaṃ mantrastārādirīritaḥhṛdi śrīhayagrīvāya devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣutato dhūpādivisarajanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdaśāṃśaṃ vaiṣṇave vahnau juhuyānmantravittamaḥekākṣaro manuḥ proktaścaturvargaphalapradaḥhsāṃ hsīṃ hsūṃ hsaiṃ hsauṃ hsaḥ iti ṣaḍaṅgakalpanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetājyena daśāṃśa homaḥsvabījādirayaṃ mantraścaturvargaphalapradaḥanyatsarvamekākṣaravatsvāhānto manurākhyāto bījaḥ praṇavasampuṭaḥsvāhānto manurākhyāto haṃsena sampuṭokṛtaḥetayormantrayoḥ pūrvoktahayagrīvamantravatsarvaṃ jñātavyamhṛllekhāpuṭitaścet syātsarvakāmaphalapradaḥnṛsiṃhāya devatāyai namaḥtāvadbhirnayanaṃ proktamantraṃ syātkaraṇākṣaraiḥaparāṅge ca kakudi nyasedvarṇānyathākramampraṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayettato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karmasamāpayetpāyasānnaḥ prajuhuyādvidhivatpūjite'naleṣaḍakṣaro narahareḥ kathitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥnṛsiṃhāya devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣutato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayettatsahasraṃ samiddhe'gnau toṣayedvasunā gurumekākṣaro manuḥ proktaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥaukāraḥ śaktiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījenāṅgakalpanāvasulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ ityādivacanāt'ṣṭākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhajatāṃ kāmadomaṇiḥdhyānārcanādikaṃ mantrarājavatvasulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ ityādivacanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māyā tāraḥśaktaye namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣuevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetpāyasairhavanaṃ kāryaṃ saṃskṛte havyavāhanevahnijāyāvadhirmantraḥ syāttrayastriṃśadakṣaraḥmahādaṃṣṭrāya astraṃ syāt pañcāṅgāmiti kalpayettato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetiti viṣṇumantraparicchedaḥmanasā smarāmiyaḥ pūrvamṛṣayaḥ prāptāḥ śivasāyujyamañjasāprāsādākhyo manuḥ prokto bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥete rudrāḥ samākhyātā dhṛtaśūlakapālakaḥraktotpalakapālābhyāmalaṃkṛtakarāmbujāḥvāmadevo muniśchandaḥ paṃktirdevaḥ sadāśivaḥkaṭyāṃ pārśvadvaye vāmadevasya trayodaśakalā nyasetoṃ sudhāyai kalāyai namaḥvinyasya dhyāyetsarvatraiva praśasto'bjaḥ śivasūryārcanaṃ vinā ititato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetprasūnaiḥ karavīrotthairjuhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥmanuḥumāpataye devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetāragvadhaḥ śoṇāluḥpañcākṣarasamāyukto vasuvarṇo manurmataḥṛṣyādinyāsa - karāṅganyāsānkuryātvṛttottuṅgastanāgrenihitakaratalaṃ vedaṭaṅkeṣṭahastamtatsahasraṃ prajuhayātpāyasānnerghṛtaplutaiḥsthirā jakāraḥ karṇa ūkāraḥ bhṛguḥ sakāraḥmṛtyuñjayo mahādevo devatāsya prakīrtitābhṛguṇā dīrghayuktena kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ manoḥtato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavacca samācaretprayaccha ṭhadvayānto'yaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥhṛdi dakṣiṇāmūrttaye devatāyai namaḥmantravarṇairvibhaktarvā kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ manoratidakṣiṇāmūrtimoḍejuhuyāt saghṛtaiḥ padmairdaśāṃśaṃ saṃskṛte'naleanilo yakāraḥ, au svarūpaṃ, ṣaṣṭha ūkāraḥhṛdi arddhanārīśvarāya devatāyai namaḥrephādi - vyañjanaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kuryādaṅgāni phaṭ kramātkarma samāpayetayutaṃ madhurāsiktairjuhuyāttilataṇḍulaiḥnīlakaṇṭhātmako mantro viṣadvayaharaḥ paraḥhṛdi nīlakaṇṭhāya devatāyai namaḥtataḥ samāhito bhūtvā nīlakaṇṭhaṃ vicintayedititato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: haviṣā juhuyātsamyaksaṃskṛte havyavāhanepraṇavo hṛnnīlakaṇṭhāyāṣṭākṣaro'paraḥtāro hṛnnīlakaṇṭhāya mantraścāṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥṛṣirgāyatrīcchandaḥ nīlakaṇṭho devatāpañcākṣaro manuḥ proktastārādyo'yaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥmukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ, hṛdi īśānāya devatāyai namaḥpañcamūrtīrnyasetityanena vyāpakanyāsaṃ kuryātevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya, arghyasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetatra tattvaśabdena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamucyate antaraṅgatvātphaḍantaścaṇḍamantro'yaṃ trivarṇātmā samīritaḥcaṇḍeśvaro devatā ityādisarvajvālinisaṃyuktaiḥ phaḍantairaṅgamācaretevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjyārghyasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetkṣetrapālasya īritaḥātmeti śaktiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktena bījenaivāṅganyāsaṃtato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetcaruṇā ghṛtasiktena tataḥ kṣetreśamarcayettasya puraścaraṇamayutasaṃkhyako japaḥparivārebhyaḥ svasvanāmabhirbaliṃ dadyāteṣa balividhiḥ sarvagrahanivārako vijayaśrīkaraśca bhavatikāntimedhābalārogyatejaḥpuṣṭiyaśaḥ śriyaḥekaviṃśatyakṣarātmā śaktiruddho mahāmanuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdi vaṭukabhairavāya devatāyai namaḥpañcahrasvāḍhyamīśānādiṣu yojayeditiaṅgāni jātiyuktāni praṇavādyāni kalpayetvaṭukamaniśaṃ śūladaṇḍau dadhānambandhūkāruṇavāsasaṃ bhayaharaṃ devaṃ sadā bhāvayekiṅkiṇīnūpurāḍhyamāyurārogyajananamapavargaphalapradamtāmasaṃ śatruśamanaṃ kṛtyābhūtagadāpahamevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjyārghyasthāpanaṃ kuryāttato vyomapaṅkajadaleṣu asitāṅgādīnbhairavānyajetetairaṣṭābhirdvitīyāvaraṇamṣaḍaṅgāni pūjayetiti sampūjayenmantrī putravargāṃstrayodaśa itietatsaptamāvaraṇamtaddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyattilaistrimadhurāplutaiḥraktacandanapuṣpādyairniśi tasmai valiṃ haretnivedayedvalitvena vaṭukāya viśiṣṭadhīḥbalimantro'yamākhyātaḥ sarveṣāṃ vijayapradaḥevaṃ kṛte parasainyaṃ kṣīyate nātra saṃśayaḥjagadekamātāānandabījamavatādatarkyaṃ traipuraṃ mahaḥyāṃ jñātvā siddhisaṅghānāmadhipo jāyate naraḥtripureti sadā nāma kathitaṃ devataistavamūrdhnādhāre hṛdi nyaset bhūyo bījatrayaṃ kramātstanadvaye kaṇṭhadeśe trīṇi bījāni vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vilomabījairvinyasya mūrtinyāsamathācaretsatyādi - pañcahrasvāḍhyaṃ lījameṣāṃ prakīrtitamaṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ krameṇa parameśvaripañcakāmāṃstato devi bāṇasthāneṣu vinyasetṣaḍdīrghayuktenādyena bījenāṅgakriyā manoḥevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātācāryebhyo namaḥ, oṃ ācāryapādukābhyo namaḥkintu naivedyānantaraṃ śrīvidyoktavali catuṣṭayamatra deyamitipuṣpairbhānusahasrāṇi juhuyādbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥtripurābhairavī visargarahitā cet sampatpradā bhavatisargaṃ hitvā tato vinduṃ nikṣipet surasundarinyāsapūjādikañca pūrvavatdviruktaistu tribhirbījaiḥ karāṅganyāsakalpanāguṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥsiddhavidyātvāttrikūṭe sakārādiścettadā kauleśabhairavī bhavatiasyāḥ pūjādhyānādikaṃ sampatpradābhairavīvadvodhyambhairavī bhavati dhyānapūjādikantu sampatpradāvatdakṣiṇāmūrtau tathā darśanātpūjādikantu sampatpradāvatvisargāḍhyaṃ maheśāni vidyā trailocyamātṛkācaturdaśasvarayuktaṃ visargāḍhyañca iti tṛtīyampīṭhaśaktayaḥ jñānārṇavoktatvāthṛdi caitanya - bhairavyai devatāyai namaḥāvaraṇapūjāmārabhetlakṣyasaṃkhyākaṃ japenmantramityādi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ paścāt pūjayet sarvasiddhayetṛtīyaṃ bījaṃ savisargamiti kecitvindunādānvitañcādyayugmamantyaṃ visargavatdadhatīmiti śeṣaḥanenaiva vidhānena nityākhyāṃ bhairavīṃ yajetnyāsapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāḥ pūrvavadācarettṛtīyamtriṃśadbhiśca tribhirvarṇairvidyeyaṃ kathitā priyehṛdi rudrabhairavyai devātāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣukuryāttato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetiti vacanātasyāḥ pūjāyantraṃ caitanya - bhairavīvadbodhyamhṛdi bhuvaneśvarībhairavyai devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣuanyat sarva caitanyabhairavīvat karaṇīyamdhyānapūjādikantu pūrvavatcaturdaśasvarayuktamṣaḍaṅgamācareddevi dvirāvṛttyā krameṇa tuitareṣāṃ lakṣajapaḥ śrīvidyoktatvāteṣā visargavindvantā śaptātasyā jñānārṇavoktavindughaṭitasya śaptavyatvātvakṣyamāṇasārasamuccaye tathā darśanātmadhyamādhare madhyabījasya paścāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛtīyaṃ śaktibījantu śivayuktaṃ sadā bhavetevaṃ kṛtvā japenmantraṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt |)vindunādaśikhākrāntaṃ bījaṃ paramadurlabhamiyaṃ pañcākṣarī vidyā kathitā bhuvi durlabhāhaṃsāntaṃ vā mahābhāge suptādidoṣaśuddhayehaṃsabījaṃ tataḥ paścātṣoḍaśī kathitā mayāviyatkūṭatrayaṃ devi bhairavyā navakūṭakamśivacandracaturdaśasvaravindusargayuktaṃ tṛtīyamnādavindukalāyuktaṃ bījametatprakīrtimśrīkramādau tathā darśanāteṣā tvaṣṭākṣarī vidyā vāgbhavādye niyojayetjapedādau japetpaścātsaptavāramanukramātannapūrṇe ṭhayugalaṃ vidyeyaṃ viṃśadakṣarīūnaviṃśākṣarī devi dhanadhānyasamṛddhidātadupari hsauḥ sadāśivamahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥkīlakaṃ kāmabījaṃ syādityādisaḍaṅgānityādiguhyādi brahmarandhrāntaṃ padānāṃ navakaṃ nyasettato mūlena vyāpakaṃ vinyasya dhyānaṃ kuryātevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya, śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryātsājyenānnena juhuyāttaddaśāṃśamanantarammahātripurasundaryā mantrā merusamudbhavāmahāmāyā iti vāgbhavakūṭamanayorbhedamagre vakṣyāmaḥmānavīyaṃ samuditā sarvāmnāyairnamaskṛtā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asyā vāgbhavakūṭameva śaktikūtaṃ vidyeyaṃ candrārādhitāasya vāgbhavakūṭameva śaktikūṭam iyaṃ kuberapūjitāiyantu dvitīyā lopāmudrāanyat samānamanyat samānamśivaṃ vinā caturthantu tārtīye sakalaḥ śivaḥvidyeyaṃ sūryapūjitāmahāmāyā coccaretvinduhīnā nādahīnā durvāsaḥpūjitā bhavetiti pañcadaśīvidyādau pūrvokta dvādaśavidyādauvedādiḥ praṇavaḥ, maṇḍitā ādau bhūṣitākecittu anulomataḥ saṃpuṭitāmāhuḥ tanna, sarvatantravirodhātśaktyādibījaiśca vilomataḥ sā śrīṣoḍaśīyañca śivapradiṣṭāumākhyāmiti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥsampuṭaśabdārthāparijñānātiti saṃpuṭalakṣaṇāt ananvayāpatteḥ sarvatantravirodhāccaetenānulomataḥ pañcabījaiḥ saṃpuṭitāmiti mataṃ heyamtāro māyā śrīvidyā parādipañcabījānyante cetiramā māyeti matañca heyamviparītakrameṇaiva vinyasya ṣoḍaśī parācakārāt ramāṃ māyāñcatriguṇā māyābhuktimuktipradā vidyā ante kaivalyadāyinītārādyā ca mahāvidyā vijñeyā tārasundarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyutkrameṇeti pañcabījāni vinyasya ityanvayaḥgopanīyā tvayā bhadre svayoniriva pārvatirājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyā bījaṣoḍaśībālāpradhānā vidyā ca sarvaśāstre ca gopitāṣoḍaśīyaṃ sugopyā hi snehāddevi prakāśitāvaktuṃ na śakyate devi kiṃ punaḥ pañcabhirmukhaiḥrājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarīprakāśitā mahādevi yā pṛṣṭā te punaḥ punaḥanayā sadṛśī vidyā na vidyārṇavagocaretathaiva śaktibīje tu lopā saptadaśākṣarīaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīśaḥ sākṣādbhūmipurandaraḥśrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi nityasiddhipradāyinianyathā śāpamāpnoti kulaṃ tasya vinaśyatianayā sadṛśī vidyā trailokya cātidurlabhābhogamokṣapradā sākṣāt puruṣārthapradāyikānāsti nāsti punarnāsti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi tebrahmārṇaḥ praṇavaḥvarṇasaṃkhyārddhalakṣeṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyatemahāśrīsundarī vidyā mahātripurasundarīekākṣareṇa kathitā brahmavidyaiva kevalāādyabhūtairbhidyamānā sundarī ṣaḍvidhā bhavetbhagavadācāryeṇa pratipāditamjhiṇṭī ekāraḥatrāpi pūrvavadbījasaṃyogaḥeṣā tu ṣoḍaśī vidyā matabhedena darśitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eṣā śrīprāṇasaṃyuktā dāridryaduḥkhamocanīatrāpi pūrvavadbīja saṃyogaḥatrāpi pūrvavadbījasaṃyogaḥrudraśaktiriyaṃ devi pūrvāmnāye hi nāyikānādavindusamāyuktaḥ kathitaḥ parameśvarieṣā vidyā maheśāni kathitaikādaśākṣarīpūrvavat kāmarāja vidyāvatsarvatra evaṃ kramaḥviṣṇurīśaḥ akārayuktahakāraḥ kāleśo makāraḥtrikūṭānte haṃsabījaṃ tadā saptadaśī bhavetsarvānte haṃsasaṃyuktā viśākṣarī bhavettadāeṣā bhāṣāiyaṃ sṛṣṭiḥsthitireṣāeṣā saṃhṛtiḥśūnyo hakāraḥidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yadi te'sti kṛpā mayieṣā svapnāvatīeṣā madhumatīsārātsāratarā vidyā kathitaikādaśākṣarīśaktirekāraḥ, māyā īkāraḥkāmarājasya kūṭaṃ paramadurlabhamhaṃso hakāraḥiyaṃ madhumatīdevī sakāraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kathitā pañcamī vidyā trailokyasubhagodayājīvaḥ sakāraḥ, prāṇo hakāraḥetenāṣṭadhā pañcamī vāgbhavaśaktikūṭabhedenaeṣā caturddhā vāgbhavakuṭabhedāteṣāpi pūrvavadaṣṭadhā anyā caturddhāsaṃsthānakṛtarūpiṇī mahāmāyāpañcamīetāsāmiti pūrvoktaśrīkramoktavidyānāmmāyāvindvīśvarayutaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhametajjaptvā tataḥ paścādvāgbhavākhyaṃ samuccaretkāmarājaṃ tato japtvātrailokyakṣobhakārakaḥsvapnāvatīṃ mahādevi japettatra samāhitaḥmadhumatīṃ tato japtvā māyāṃ śrīṃ kūrcabījakameṣā tu dīpanī vidyā ajapā prāṇarūpiṇīatra pañcamīvadbhodhyā vāgbhavaśaktikūṭayordīpanīsarvatra kūṭe svarasambandhaḥprāṇabhūtasthito devi tattadekādaśaḥ paraḥsuvarṇarajatapañcaratnasphaṭikatāmrādyutkīrṇaṃ vā kuryātyo'tra yantre pravarteta tasya sarvaṃ harāmyahamtanmāṃsarudhireṇaiva pāraṇā tasya jāyatemamāṅgakṣatirevātra kriyate pāpabuddhināiti vacanānnātra keśarāṇipramādādaṅkite yantre śāpo bhavati tatkṣaṇāttatra devi vasennityaṃ tadyantre pūjanaṃ mamaito'dhikaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā prāyaścittī bhaveddhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naśyanti sarvavighnāni prāpyate ca yathepsitamaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmadhipo jāyate'cirātetadyantramātre jñeyamlakṣamayutamityekeidantu yantramātra viṣayam- sahasrakoṭiphaladaṃ śrīcakrapādodakamtaphalaṃ samavāpnoti kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanamtatphalaṃ labhate bhaktyā kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanammukhe tripurasundaryai devāyai namo hṛdiata eva tadevāsyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamucyateteneyaṃ śaktirucyatemodinīṃ pūjayedvācāṃ nādavinduvibhūṣitāmtato mūlena vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyetśaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kuryāttaddakṣiṇe pādyādipātraṃ saṃsthāpyāsanapūjāmārabhetvidhāya ṣaḍaṅgāni pūjayettripureti tadā nāma kathitaṃ daivatairapitarpayetsundarīṃ devīṃ samudrāñca savāhanāmnamaḥkusumbhakusumairvāpi madhuratrayamiśritaiḥsvasvabījānte tattadbhūtabījānteśeṣa sāmānyapūjāpaddhatyuktakrameṇa kuryātkuryātdhenumudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ tatastatra pradarśayetsaptakṛtvo japedvidyām abhiṣiñcet svakāṃ tanūm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triḥsapta vā tathā vārānsecayetsādhakāgraṇīḥucite vāsasī paścātparidadhyādanantaramdhṛtvā bhālatale bhasma pūrvavat śrīguruṃ smaretyathāśakti japeddevīṃ gāyatrīṃ tadanantaramcaturthīvahnijāyāntaṃ devatīrthena tarpayettridhā ṅe'ntān hṛdantāṃśca pitṛtīrthena tarpayettato devīṃ tarpayettarpaṇantu śuciḥ kuryāddevarṣipitṛpūrvakamgṛhe'pi yajanaṃ śastaṃ rasairvārkṣekṣu sambhavaiḥanyathā naiva siddhiḥ syāt kalpakoṭiśatairapikṛtvā pūjalāye cātra pañcamīṃ pūjayāmyahamitietāḥ pūjayetkuryātśaktiñca pādayoścaiva sarvāṅge kīlakaṃ nyasetcaturthīmatisaṃyuktāmamantraiḥ pṛthak pṛthaknama ityamunā brahmarandhra sthāne pravinyasetbījānte nāma saṃyojya jātiyuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakampunarbālāṃ samuccārya caturasraṃ vicintayetmūlādhāre ca hṛdaye lalāṭe brahmarandhrakemūlamantravarṇaṃ nyasetiti saṃhāranyāsaḥiti sthitinyāsaḥliṅge ca ṣoḍaśavarṇān pravinyasethṛnnābhimūladeśeṣu navanādaṃ nyasetsudhīḥrāśibhiḥ pañcamo nyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ pīṭhairnigadyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa eva pūjyaḥ sarveṣāṃ sa svayaṃ parameśvaraḥso'cirānmṛtyumāpnoti narakañca prapadyateviniyogaḥiti gaṇeśanyāsaḥlakṣābhyāntu gude ketuṃ nyasadevaṃ varānane3 laṃ kṣaṃ aṃ aḥ revatyai namo vāmapāderakṣa majjātmane namo bhrūmadhye3 yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ mīnarāśaye namo vāmagulphesampradāyavidaḥiti pañcāśattripurā mātṛkāsthāneṣu namo'ntena nyasetmātṛkāṇarnyaseddevi mātṛkāsthāna eva cavahnijāyānvitā vidyā bheruṇḍā devatā bhavetbrahmarandhre 3 paramātirahasyayoginībhyo namaḥpāśāya nama ityevaṃ vāmordhve vinyasetkarekha phreṃ khecarīṃ hsauḥ bījamudrām aiṃ yoginīmudrāmpūjākāle samastaṃ vā kuryātsādhakasattamaḥtrivalīvalayāyuktamadhyadeśasuśobhitāmtato vahiḥpūjāmārabheta tato'rghyasthāpanamsphuṭamaṃtrasiddhijanakaṃ muktipradaṃ mauktikamkalpaṃ sumadhyamaṃ proktaṃ mṛṇmamayaṃ kalpamadhyamamśāntike pauṣṭike vāpi rājataṃ kārayet priyestambhakāryeṣu pāṣāṇaṃ vidveṣe lauhamṛṇmayamkulotsādanakāryeṣu kācapātraṃ viśiṣyatenarapātrastu hṛhṇīyādbhuktimuktipradāyakamnṛtyanti sarvayoginyaḥ prītāḥ siddhiṃ dadatyapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ihaloke draridraḥ syānmṛte ca paśutāṃ vrajetpūjāsamāptiryāvat syāt tāvardarghyaṃ na cālayettato yathopacāraiḥ sampūjya tridhā santarpayetsavyena hastayogena tarpayedvā kuleśvarīmkaniṣṭhāṃguyogena stambhane tarpayet priyekṛṣṇapakṣe vicitrādikāmeśvaryantaṃ pūjayetīśānakoṇaṃ deveśi tadāgneyaṃ na saṃśayaḥiti trivāramarghyodakena tarpayetpūrvavataiṃ ātmatattvāya svāhetyādi pūrvavatsvāhetyādi pūrvavatbrāhmyavaidyakadarśanāya namaḥpūrvavatpūrvavatśāktaṃ ṣaṣṭhantu vijñeyaṃ cakraṃ ṣaḍdarśanātmakampūrvabījavilomena ratneśīyaṃ navākṣarīiti śrīvidyāprakaraṇamyasyāḥ prasādamātreṇa sadāśivo bhavennaraḥkavitvañca supāṇḍityaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥvajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭ svāhayāyutaḥmātrāṃ dvādaśikāṃ bījamādyaṃ syānmuktidāyakamatra lajjāpadaṃ kāmabījaparamanyeṣāñca munīnāṃ mate sarvatra māyāpadaṃ kūrcaparamayantu samīcīnaḥtrailokyavijayā devi sadaivaukārasaṃsthitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācamyaivaṃ chinnamastāṃ vatsarāttāṃ prapaśyatieṣā brahmasvarūpā hi bījaṣoḍhā prakīrtitājīvanmuktā daśābdataḥpādayoḥ svāhā śaktaye namaḥityādivākyātkarāṅgeṣu praṇavasaṃvalito nyāsaḥvāratrayaṃ nyasetchinnamastāṃ kare vāme dhārayantīṃ svamastakamsadyastasya śiraśchittvā devī pibati śoṇitamityasyāḥ pūjāyantramdhyeyametad-yatīnāñca gṛhasthānaṃ niśāmayakuryātpadmamadhye ratikāmābhyāmtataḥ punardhyātvā āvāhayetsvāhā iti mantreṇasarvatraiva praṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayetbrahmayoni samutpanne gaccha devi mamāntaramsiddhavidyātvātathavā madhupānādyairmadhurairvibhavakramaiḥbalimantraḥ samākhyātaḥ pūjito'yaṃ sureśvarītivajravairocanīye ca hūṃ phaṭ svāhā tataḥ paramnyāsapūjādikaṃ ṣoḍaśīvatkāryamasyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣoḍaśīvatkāryamasyāpi dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣoḍaśīvatkāryamtārādyāntā bhavatyeṣā caturvargaphalapradādhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣoḍaśīvatsamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmībījādikā saiva sarvaiśvaryapradāyinīeṣā tu ṣoḍaśīvidyā vedyā saptadaśākṣarīlajjayā puṭitā vidyā trailokyākarṣiṇī parāvāgbījapuṭitā caiṣā vāgīśatvapradāyinīeṣā vidyā mahāvidyā bhuktimuktikarī sadāete vidyottame devi bhuktimuktiprade śubhepraṇavādyā yathā caiṣā bhogamokṣakarī sadāsarvaśvaryapradā caiṣā sarvamohanakāriṇīeṣā vidyā mahāvidyā janmamṛtyuvināśinīiyaṃ sā ṣoḍaśī proktā sarvakāmaphalapradākhaḍgādyena ṭhaṭhāntāni ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetati snehataraṅgena bhaktyā dāso'smi te priyeetāsāṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ ṣoḍaśīvatkāryamyāsāṃ vijñānamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥna vittavyayabāhulyaṃ kāyakleśakaraṃ na catasya haste sadaivāsti sarvasiddhirna saṃśayaḥtasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ gatāḥante ca labhate devyā gaṇatvraṃ durlabhaṃ naraḥante vahnivadhūṃ dadyādvidyārājñī prakīrtitājvalanārṇasamayogātsarvatejomayī śubhāvindunāṃ niṣphalatvācca kaivalyaphaladāyinīśabdabījadvayenaiva śabdarāśiprabodhinīsvāhayā jagatāṃ mātā sarvāpāpapraṇāśinīdvābhyāmoṣṭhau dvirunmṛjya caikena kṣālayetkaraupraṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvāṅge krīṃ kīlakāya namaḥoṃ krāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ ityādinā vāparigṛhītabhairavīyavākyādubhayameva yuktammūlenāṣṭaśatena vyāpakaṃ kuryātkṛte'sminnyāsavarye tu sarvaṃ pāpaṃ praṇaśyatiātmavidyāśivaistattvaistattvanyāsaṃ samācaretetattrayaṃ kāmyamdhyāyetsṛkvadvayagaladraktadhārāvisphuritānanāmevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya arghyasthāpanaṃ kuryātpīṭhapūjāmārabhetmadhye tu vaindavaṃ cakraṃ bījamāyāvibhūṣitamitisvarṇe raupye'tha lauhe vā cakraṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥpīṭhasyottare gurupaṃktipūjāmūlena pādyādibhiḥ pūjayetdadyātmahākālaṃ pūjayetjaṭābhāralasaccandrakhaṇḍamugraṃ jvalannibhampañcāpacoraiḥ pūjayetphaṭsvāhayā samāyukto mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥbrahmayonisamutpanne gaccha devi mamāntaramiti mantreṇapītvā, nirmālyaṃ śirasi vidhṛtya, yathecchaṃ vihareditiidaṃ kāmyajapa evetisarvasiddhiyuto bhūtvā bhairavo vatsarādbhavettatastattaddaśāṃśena homayeddhaviṣā priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rātrau tāmbūlapūrāsyaḥ śayyāyāṃ lakṣamānataḥśūdrāṇāñca tathā proktaṃ rātrāviṣṭaṃ mahāphalamkārayitavyamekākṣaro mahāmantraḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥtriguṇā tu viśeṣeṇa sarvaśāstraprabodhinīevaṃ oṃ krāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādianyat sarvaṃ pūrvavat kāryamcaturbāhuyutāṃ devīṃ varābhayakarāṃ smarettaddaśāṃśavidhānena homayet sādhakottamaḥlakṣaṃ rātrau tathā lakṣaṃ mahāśaucaparāyaṇaḥrātrau japaikamātreṇa dakṣiṇā siddhidā bhavetindrasya samīpaṃ aindraṃ rephaḥsaptabījāni saṃhāraiḥ svāhāntaḥ praṇavādikaḥhomastu taddaśāṃśataḥdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣiṇāvadupācarettryakṣarī sā mahāvidyā cāmuṇḍā kālikā smṛtāasyā jñānaprabhāveṇa kalayāmi jagattrayamekāraḥ vahnivallabhāvarṇanyāsakarāṅganyāsau ca dakṣiṇāvatevaṃ dhyātvā dakṣiṇāvat sarvaṃ kāryamhomayettaddaśāṃśena mṛdupuṣpeṇa mantravitmahāvidyā mahākālyā mahākālena bhāṣitāetattrayaṃ vahnivallabhānijabījatrayaṃ phaṭ vahnivallabhānijabījatrayaṃ kūrcaṃ lajjā punastānyeva vahnivallabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdi kālikāyai devatāyai namaḥpūrvoktānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sarvaṃ dakṣiṇāvat kāryamanyāsāṃ mantravarṇasaṃkhyalakṣajapaḥnijabījadvayaṃ māyādvayaṃ dakṣiṇa - kālike vahnivallabhānijaṃ kūrcaṃ lajjā dakṣiṇe kālike phaṭpūrvaṣaḍbījāni vahnivallabhāanyat sarvaṃ dakṣiṇāvatbhairavo'sya ṛṣiḥnijabījadvayaṃ kūrcadvayaṃ lajjāyugaṃ vahnivallabhāasya pañcavaktra ṛṣiḥmūlatrayaṃ kūrcadvayaṃ lajjādvayaṃ vahnivallabhāmūlabījaṃ dakṣiṇe kālike vahnivallabhānijabījaṃ kūrcadvayaṃ māyāṃ punastāni vahnivallabhāhṛdayaṃ vāgbhavaṃ mūladvayaṃ kālikāyai ṭhadvayampuraścaraṇaṃ lakṣajapaḥcaturbhujāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāmityādiekādaśākṣarī kālī caturvargaphalapradādakṣiṇe kālike ceti astrāntā samudīritāpūrvavatṣaṭ tathā bījānyante ca vahnisundarīdevatā kathitā sadbhiḥ kālī dakṣiṇapūrvikābhairavo'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ sarvatantrasamanvitaḥsvāhāntā kathitā vidyā sarvakāmaphalapradāpañcākṣarī mahāvidyā pañcavaktra-ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥsvāhāntā kathitā vidyā sarvasampatkarī matāsvāhāntā kathitā vidyā sarvaśatrukṣayaṅkarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūladvayaṃ kūrcayugmaṃ tathā lajjādvayaṃ tataḥcaturdaśākṣarī vidyā caturvargaphalapradāṣoḍaśīyaṃ samākhyātā vidyā kalpadrumopamākālikāyai padaṃ coktvā tadante vahnisundarīdīrghatanucchadaṃ kālīmanuḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥlakṣasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ kuryātpuraścaraṇasiddhayemadhye tu vaindavaṃ cakraṃ bījamāyāvibhūṣitamguhyakālīṃ mahāvidyāṃ trailokya cātidurlabhāmathavetvi guhye kālike bījadvayaṃ dakṣiṇe kālike vā mantraḥasya mantrasyeti śeṣaḥdakṣiṇe padamābhāṣya bhavet pañcadaśākṣarīkāmabījaṃ parityajya ṣoḍaśākṣarīdakṣiṇe padamābhāṣya bhavedvidyā daśākṣarībalidānaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayetoṃ sadāśivamahāpretāya guhyakālyāsanāya namaḥcaturvargapradā vidyā bhadrakālī śubhāvahāviṃśatyekādhikā vidyā śmaśānakālikā matāviṃśatyarṇā mahāvidyā mahākālyāḥ prakīrtitāviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ tathā sūrya gaṇeśaṃ pūjayettataḥprasannavadanāṃ saumyāṃ navaratnavibhūṣitāmyeṣāṃ vijñānamātreṇa jīvanmuktastu sādhakaḥpāṇḍityaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu dhanairdhanapatirbhavetsarvatra jayamāpnoti bṛhaspatirivāparaḥraśmipañcakaṃ varṇapañcakamityarthaḥugrāpattāriṇī yasmādugratārā prakīrtitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ prabhṛti vidyeyaṃ phaladātrī na kasyacitmantrasya jñānamātreṇa vijayī bhuvi jāyatesatarīñca maheśāni vadhūbījaṃ prakīrtitamcandraḥ sakāraḥsarvabhāṣāmayī śuddhā sarvāmnāyairnamaskṛtāekākṣī strīṃ tena sarvatra śāpoddhāraḥjīvanīmadhyagā māyāeṣā pañcākṣarīanyāsāṃ vidyānāṃ ekajaṭaiva devathā prakṛtitvāttatrasthaḥ sādhayedyogī vidyāṃ tribhuvaneśvarīmtadeva liṅgamākhyātaṃ tatra siddhiranuttamādevāgāre ca śūnye ca nirjanaikāntaveśmanidehānte yogimukhyaḥ paramasukhapadaṃ brahmanirvāṇametitārābhedairiti ugratāraikajaṭānīlasarasvatībhedaiḥsacaturthīpraṇavādinamo'ntakāḥsvastikādikrameṇa tatropaviśetbījalikhanantu pūrvavatnīlatanoḥ paraṃ nigaditaṃ sarvārthasiddhipradamsarvatra praṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayettanmadhye pūjayeddevyā vāhanaṃ śavameva cadhyātvā tadupari hūṃkārabhūṣitāṃ kartṛkāṃ dhyāyetdhārayantīmitiiti prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ bhavatihūṃ bījaṃ mantraśaktiḥ syāccaturvargaphalapradāvāmajaṅghāyām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvavāgrūpiṇīmuktvā astrāya phaḍiti smaretsarvavighnopaśamanīṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīmsarvakāmapradāṃ nityaṃ sarvasāmrajyadāyinīṃvadānyāya kulīnāya śuddhācāraratāya caevaṃ vidhāya deveśi sādhakāya prakāśayetanyathā siddhihāniḥ syādityājñā śaṅkaraiḥ kṛtāekena sahitā rudrāḥ pañcāśat parikīrtitāḥevaṃ dhyātvā tāriṇīntu samāhitamanāściramiti rudranyāsaḥlakṣābhyāṃ gudadeśe ca ketuṃ dhūmraṃ varānaneiti lokapālanyāsaḥtataḥ paraśivo devi ṣaṭśivāḥ parikīrtitāḥsarvatra tryakṣarīmuktvā vādisāntaṃ savindukamvādilāntaṃ pravinyasya nābhau tu maṇipūrakeanāhate kādiṭhāntam īśvaraṃ kākinīṃ nyasetsadāśivaṃ śākinīntu vinyasetpūrvavattataḥparaṃ śivaṃ brahmarūpaṃ hākinīsahitaṃ nyasetiti śivaśaktinyāsaḥiti tārādinyāsaḥkaṭyāṃ 3 kāñcīpīṭhāya namaḥakṣobhyaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ nyāsasyāsya prasādataḥkramotkramādvarārohe tārāṣoḍhā prakīrtitāyoginīnāṃ bhavetpūjyaḥ na devo sa tu mānuṣaḥnāstyasya pūjyo lokeṣu pitṛmātṛmukhojjvalaḥvindusargānvitāṃ nyasyet ḍādyarṇān sthitivartmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthitestu śāntivinyāsastasmātkāryastridhā mataḥsthityanto gṛhamedhiṣu sṛṣṭayanto varṇimāmiti prāhuḥsahajānau vanavāsini sthitiñca vidyārthināṃ sṛṣṭimsaṃhṛtiḥ kṣakārādyakārāntaḥpraṇavaṃ mātṛkāvarṇeḥ puṭitaṃ mātṛkāsthalemāyābījaṃ tathā devi vinyastavyaṃ prayatnataḥkūrcabījaṃ tathā devi nyasanīyamaśeṣataḥavaśyaṃ pratyahaṃ kāryā na pūjā na japastathākālīṣoḍhāthavā devi na pūjā na japastathāoṃkārapuṭitaṃ kṛtvā manunā vyāpakaṃ nyasettataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ viracyātmābhedena devatāṃ dhyāyetkapālake trijagatāṃ hantyugratārā svayamtāstu mudrāprakaraṇe anusandheyāḥiyaṃ vacoracanā vidyādharācāryasammatāpūjānte bhojanādau ca baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayetpaṭhitvā baliṃ dadyātsahasraṃ śataṃ viṃśaṃ vā japedrahasyamālayāsamāpayetjapaṃ samarpayeddhīmān guhyātiguhyamantrakairahasyamālāmādāya lakṣamekaṃ sadā japetmahāśaṅkhe'pyaśaktaścet sphāṭikīmālayā japetpañcatvaṃ jāyate tasya athavā vātulo bhavetrājadvāre sabhāyāñca vijayī bhavati dhruvamititarpaṇañcābhiṣekañca daśāṃśaṃ viprabhojanamtarpayecca parāṃ devīṃ tatprakāra ihocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājyāktairjuhuyānmantri taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇamtarpayecca parāṃ devīṃ tatprakāra ihocyatesantarpya vidhivaddevīṃ parivārānpṛthakpṛthakvāriṇīṃ siñcayāmiti jalaṃ mūrdhni vinikṣipetdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavatsamupācaretcaturlakṣajapenāsyāḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hikāmeśvarī bhadrakālī ityaṣṭau tāriṇī smṛtāpārśvāntañca tathā ñāntaṃ śarāntaṃ parikīrtitambhedāṣṭakaṃ bhavetaṣṭameti vadhūḥ kūrcaṃ māyā phaṭśambhupatnī maheśāni catuvargeṣu yojayetkālalakṣaṃ japenmantramevamuktena vartmanādhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavatsamupācarettattā svāheti mantro'yaṃ daśākṣara udāhṛtaḥratnapādukayornyastapādāmbujayugāṃ smaretdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī ghṛtāktai raktapuṣpakaiḥdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavacca samācaretmāye svāheti mantro'yaṃ proktaḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥjapamasyāścaredyastu sa syādadrutakavistathāeṣā aṣṭākṣarī vidyā kathitā bhuvi durlabhāanayorjapapūjādīn pañcākṣarīvadācarettadante yadi phaṭkāro manuḥ pañcākṣaro bhavetvadhūbījamaparo'sau guṇākṣaraḥathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatenikṣipya bhūmau hastārddhamānataḥ kānane vane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekākī prajapenmantrī sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥsa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇātāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavetaṣṭamyādinavamyantamupavāsaparo bhavetsahasrasaṃkhyajaptena puraścaraṇamiṣyatenavamīrātrau pūjāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥṣaṭasahasraṃ japennityaṃ bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥkevalaṃ japamātreṇa mantrāḥ siddhā bhavanti hibhavettāvajjaptvāmaheśāni puraścaraṇamiṣyatesādhayet svahitaṃ mantrī mantradhyānaparāyaṇaḥcaturdaśiṃ na vīkṣeta mantrameva samabhyasetsamāmaguṇasampannaiḥ sādhayedvītabhīḥ svayamanyānapi ca rakṣārthaṃ kiñciddūre niveśayetcāṇḍālādiṣu saṃprāptā kevalaṃ śīghrasiddhidāmahāsvaccho dayāvāṃśca sarvabhūtahite rataḥpraṇamya manunānena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipetvīrārdanena mantreṇacaturdikṣu rakṣāṃ kuryāttatastaistaiḥ suhṛdvargai rakṣito nābhibhūyatetadadhaścāstramantreṇa nikhanetkuladīpakambhūtvā japenmantramananyadhīḥgajāntakamiti aṣṭottarasahasramityarthaḥpunardevatā sampūjya japetsatyantu kārayitvā ca varayedvaramuttamambaliñca yavāpiṣṭamayenadināntare'pi dāsyāmi svīkṛtya svagṛhaṃ vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: piṣṭeneti yavadhānyodbhavenetyarthaḥcandrahāsena vidhivattattanmantreṇa ghātayetgurave guruputrāya tatpatnyai vā nivedayetvilvamūle śmaśāne vā tatsamīpe vanasthalebhaumavāre tamisrāyāṃ sādhayet siddhimuttamāmtilāḥ kuśāḥ sarṣaṃpāśca sthāpanīyāḥ prayatnataḥghātaya hūṃ phaṭ oṃ sahasrāre hūṃ phaṭvikīrya, vihitaśavasamīpaṃ gacchetpalāyanaviśūnyantu sammukhe raṇavartināmstrījanañcedṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sarvathā parivarjayetkṣudraprayogakartṛṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvasiddhayepuṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dattvā praṇamet sparśapūrvakamraktākto yadi deveśi bhakṣayetkulasādhakampunaḥ prakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā japasthāne samānayetcatuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo ḍākinībhyo'pi saṃdiśetatra śmaśānasādhanakrameṇa japaḥ kāryaḥśavaṃ jale tu garte vā nikṣipya srānamācaretdattvā piṣṭhamayānante kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇampañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyakānapi brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ snātvā ca bhuktvā ca nivaseduttamasthaletrirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍrātraṃ navarātrantu gopayettadā vastraṃ parityajya gṛhṇīyādvasanāntaramdurjanaṃ patitaṃ klīvaṃ na spṛśecca kadācanaprātarnityakriyānte ca vilvapatrodakaṃ pibettato dakṣiṇāṃ dattvācchidrāvadhāraṇaṃ kuryāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caṇḍograśūlapāṇeśca mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena tārādyena ṣaḍaṅgakamsurāpānarasāviṣṭaṃ sādhakābhīṣṭadāyakamdaśāṃśaṃ saṃskṛte vahnau hunedraktotpalena caraktapadmasya homena mahatīṃ śriyāmāpnuyātkusumbhatailahomena ripūn hanyānna saṃśayaḥkevalaṃ śuddhabhāvena haviṣyāśī divā japetasyaiva japamātreṇa sarvasiddhimupālabhetasyopāsanamātreṇa vāksiddhiṃ labhate'cirātmātaṅgī ṅeyutā cāstraṃ vahnijāyāvadhirmanuḥmātaṅgī devatā devī sarvakāryapradāyinīṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena praṇavādyena kalpayetvedairbāhudaṇḍairasikheṭakapāśāṃkuśadharāmevaṃ puraskriyāṃ kṛtvā prayogavidhimācaretrātriyogena kartavyaṃ sadā pūrṇaśca sādhakaḥśāstre vāde kavitve ca bṛhaspatirivāparaḥvinā matsyairvinā māṃsairnārcayet paradevatāmsavisargaṃ mahādevi sarvasiddhipradāyakamekonaviṃśatyarṇo'yaṃ sarvābhīṣṭakaro bhavetyāṃ yāṃ prārthayate siddhiṃ haṭhāttāṃ tāmavāpnuyātvalimapi ucchiṣṭenayasya tiṣṭhati mantro'yaṃ na ca vighnaiḥ sa bādhyatevāmadakṣiṇayogena dhyāyenmantraviduttamaḥucchiṣṭe japamānasya jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥsahasraikavidhānena bhavanti kulasiddhayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nūnaṃ tasya bhavantyeva sadyo vidyāścaturdaśadurbhagāyā haṭhāddevi saubhāgyaṃ śubhadāyakamhomaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetucchiṣṭadūṣaṇaṃ tyaktvā sa pavitro japed dhruvamnibandhakārāḥdhūmāvatīmanuḥ prokto vairinigrahakārakaḥdhūumāvatyai devatāyai namaḥevaṃ dhāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādiviraladvijā viraladantā(tataḥ pūrvavat pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya japetśatrūnuccāṭayennūnaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇācitibhasmakīlitamarergehe taduccāṭanamityādi prayogaḥastramagnipriyānto'yaṃ bhadrakālīmahāmanuḥśivaliṅge sampūjyetyarthaḥdantairjambuphalābhaiḥ pariharatu bhayaṃ pātu māṃ bhadrakālīyatheṣṭacintayā cintyā dharmakāmārthasiddhidāpuraścaraṇamaṣṭottarasahasrajapaḥhastipiśāci likhe'gnivanitā gaṃ tadādita iti tattvabodhātguhyaṃ sarvāgameṣveva hitabuddhyā prakāśitamsarvakāmaphalapradaḥtataḥ praṇavena karāṅganyāsau kṛtvā dhyāyetbahiḥpūjāmārabhettataḥ puṣpamekaṃ dakṣiṇadiśi kṣiptvā kṣamasveti visarjayetaprasaṅgādanaucityādanācānta iti darśanātvibhīṣaṇamate māṃsanaivedyaṃ dattvā tadeva khādayan
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tat sarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ sūryeṇaiva tamo yathāevaṃ kṛtvā vyayasthāntu taddhaneśvaratāṃ gataḥaṣṭottaraśatairmantrī mūlamantrābhimantritamnikhanenmandire yasya bhaveduccāṭanaṃ paramkanyāgṛhe tu nikhanenna vivāho bhaveddhruvamnikhanenmandire yasya maraṇaṃ tasya niścitamyasya nāmnā japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ sa vaśo bhavetsahasradaśahomena rājā sadyo vaśo bhavetdaśalakṣeṇa tadrāṣṭraṃ vaśyaṃ tasya ca sarvathākhecaratvaṃ bhavennityaṃ sarvajñatvañca jāyatesaubhāgyaṃ sarvarakṣā ca bhavettatra suniścitamvahnijāyāvadhiḥ prokto mantrarājottamottamaḥlakṣmīpraṇavaṃ śrībījaṃ kuberānumato'yaṃ mantraḥhṛdidhanadāyai devatāyai namaḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣuevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya vahiḥpūjāmārabhetpunardhyātvāvāhya pañcāpacāraiḥ pūjayetlakṣe japte mantrasiddhiṃ puraścaryāṃ samācaretetenaiva susiddhaḥ syāt puraścaryādiko vidhiḥyaḥ smareddevi vidyāṃ tāṃ dāridryairnābhibhūyatetena devyāṃ mahāprītirvāñchitārthaṃ dadāti casarvālaṅkāramutsṛjya dattvā yāti nijālayampurayitvā maheśāni vaśagā jāyate śubhādātavyaṃ sarvadā tasmai nityaṃ dāridryaśāntayenaivedyañca pradātavyaṃ nityaṃ dāridryaśāntaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasya dāridryasaṃnyāsaṃ dāsīvat karavāṇyahamhomo'pi ca vidhātavyaḥ kṣaṇāddāridryaśāntayetāmrapātre tathā kāryaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sumanoharamkuto dāridryaśaṅkāsya sa hi koṭīśvaro bhavetkuberasya matenāsyāḥ pūjādi kriyate sadāpūrvādi - uttarāntañca madhye devīṃ prapūjayethṛdayādiṣunānālaṅkārabhūṣāṅgīṃ nagnāṃ mattāṃ sadāsavaiḥnagno bhūtvā mahāpūjāṃ kuryādrātrau viśeṣataḥtadvahirasitāṅgādibhairavān pūjayetvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśena homayetkālikā devyā iti nijabījena ityarthaḥyasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa pavano'pi sthirāyatevahnihīnendrayuṅmāyā sthiramāyā prakīrtitāityapi mantrāntaramhlīṃ bījaṃ guhyadeśe tu svāhāśaktistu pādayoḥkaraśākhāsu talayoḥ karāṅganyāsamācaretkrameṇa mantravarṇāṃstu nyasya dhyāyedyathāvidhievaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya bahiḥpūjāmārabhetpūjopakaraṇañcābhyukṣayettarjanyāṃguṣṭhayogena sāṅgāvaraṇāṃ bagalāmukhī tarpayetpriyaṃgukusumenāpi pītapuṣpaiśca homayetpītabhūṣaṇabhūṣāñca ratnasiṃhāsane sthitāmjapahomaprayoge ca mantraṃ cāpyayutaṃ japetstambhayetparasainyāni nātra kāryā vicāraṇa
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stambhaneṣu ca sarveṣu prayogaḥ pratyayāvahaḥetā daśa mahāvidyā siddhavidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥlabhate'cireṇa niyataṃ paiśācikī bhaktitaḥpiṇḍaṃ piśāci svāheti nṛpārṇaḥ kathitaḥ priyesarvajñāṃ śavahṛtkṛtādhivasatīṃ paiśācikīṃ tāṃ numaḥdagdhamīnaṃ baliṃ dattvā rātrau sampūjya saṃjapetsvāheti dagdhamīnabaliṃ dadyātamṛtaṃ kuru deveśi svāheti prokṣayejjalaiḥmūlaṃ raktacandanena likhitvā yantropari iṣṭadevatāṃ pūjayetsiddhirbhaviṣyatīti jñātvā tathā vidhamācarettataḥ sarvajño bhavati nāsya pūjādhyānambhūtabhaviṣyādikaṃ paśyatiśrīmañjughoṣo jayatāṃ sādhakānāṃ sukhāvahaḥīyantu dīpanī proktā mūlamantrastu kathyatevidyā śrutidharī proktā eṣā varṇatrayātmikāsarvajñavidyeyamekarṇātmikā priyelikheccandanalekhanyā prayatnāt sādhakottamaḥkuce śrutidharo nityaṃ gomuṇḍe ca mahākaviḥvaraṃ prāpya ca tasmādvai viharet yathāsukhamtribhirmāsairbhavenmarttyaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥvakeśaḥ śakāraḥmañjughoṣaṃ namāmisarvasiddhi pradāyeti puṣpaṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥkapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥpūjā etāstu yoginyo hṛllekhābījapūrvikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī mahāyogīśvaro bhavetśaṃkaraṃ paripapraccha pārvatī parameśvaramvāñchitārthapradaṃloke mañjughoṣaṃ bravīhi mebhaktānāṃ kāmadaṃ mantraṃ kalpavṛkṣamivāparamyajjñātvā jaḍadhīḥ prāyo vācaspati samobhavetjapāt siddhipradaṃ mantraṃ vinā homārcanādibhiḥsarvajñatvamavāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ hi pārvatīsarvaśāstreṣu so'pyuccairbṛhaspatisamo bhavetdhyeyaḥ ko vātra tatsarvaṃ brūhi me bhaktavatsalasa eva maṃjughoṣākhyo bhaktidānena muktidaḥtadā muktiprado mantro nātra kāryā vicāraṇāyathā dhyātvā japenmantraṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇudhyānaṃ vakṣye maheśāni krameṇa hitakāmyayāsiddhipradaṃ sādhakānāṃ bhaktānāṃ cintitapradamaprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacitvasupradaḥ syātbalinaivedyabhuk sākṣādbṛhaspatirivāparaḥmāsatrayeṇa satataṃ kavireva na saṃśayaḥyantre mantraṃ likhedādau paścānmantraṃ japet punaḥnirjanaṃ sthānamāgatya japennanmatramadhomukhaḥaṣṭādhikaiśca saṃpūjya japenmantraṃ catuṣpathebṛhaspatisamo vaktā nātra kāryā vicāraṇātrimuṇḍametadvikhyātaṃ sādhakānāṃ sukhāvahamdakṣiṇe ca śivāmuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ samācaretvṛṣamastakasthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navakuṃkumarocanābhiḥvarakhaḍgahastamariṣṭagehe niśi tailamevamādāya yatnātkarapallavenaākiṃśukākṣoḍataroścamūle, vilipya pādau vadanāmṛtenasākṣādgīṣpatirnātra citramvākpatirīśvaraḥ syātgīramṛtāyamānājuhuyādyatnato mantrī sarvasiddhimavāpnuyātnavagīṣpatiḥ syātdhanavaṃśapradaṃ ramyaṃ sārvajñavāgmitāpradamadoṣakavitāmūlaṃ sarvatra pratibhāpradammaṃjughoṣaḥ sa kaḥ kīdṛktasyānuṣṭhānameva himaṃjughoṣastu yo devaḥ so'haṃ devi na saṃśayaḥtasyānuṣṭhānamadhunā śrūyatāṃ mama tattvataḥrasalakṣāvadhistasya jāpya eva surepsitaḥsukavitvaṃ bhavet tasya pratibhā viśvajitvarīṣaṇmāsaṃ yastujapati sa sarvajñaḥ kuśāgradhīḥtuṇḍakīnāladānena bhavedācamanīyakammaṃjughoṣaṃ namāmiśṛṇu devi mahābhāge kalau sadyaḥ phalapradamtaṃ namāmi hitaṃ nāthaṃ maṃjughoṣaṃ namāmyahamraktaṃ rajoguṇairyuktaṃ maṃjughoṣaṃ namāmyahamtaṃ śāntaṃ tamasāyuktaṃ pītavastraṃ namāmyahamcaraṇe patito jīvo buddhaye taṃ namāmyahamhṛṣṭaṃ samastasārañca maṃjughoṣaṃ namāmyaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sakalaṃ niṣphalañcaiva taṃ namāmi hitapradamdakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadyādgurutuṣṭiryathā bhavetyāvat kārla suto duḥkhī pitā tu narakaṃ vrajetcaturvargaphalā vidyā sarvasiddhipradāyikānavākṣaro manurdavi tāriṇyāḥ samudīritaḥaṣṭasiddhipradā devī caturvargaphalapradāanayā sadṛśī siddhirna bhūtā na bhaviṣyatibinā chando binā śikṣāṃ binābhyāsena pārvatijihvāyāṃ jāyate tasya kavitvaṃ rasanirmitamdvirācamya śikhāṃ baddhā tato bhūmiviśodhanamkarau saṃśodhya deveśi cāstramantreṇa tatparamtadudbhutāgnibalibhiḥ śarīraṃ dahyate budhaiḥśarīrasya viśodhena prāṇāyāmaṃ caret tataḥmantranyāsastato devi śrūyatāṃ mantrasiddhidaḥpādayoḥ vāgbhavaśaktaye namaḥtathā bījena tu ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetkālī gaurī śivā caiva ityaṣṭau śaktayaḥ smṛtāḥdehapīṭhe tato devīṃ dhyāyetsusthiramānasaḥcandrasūryāgnibhedena trilocana-samanvitāmcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ aṣṭavajrasamanvitamraktapuṣpairmahādevi nānāgandhasamanvitaiḥvedavidyāprakāśastu tanme brūhi jagatpateetadeva purā pṛṣṭhaṃ kalpādau viṣṇave mayāyatproktaṃ tena me brahman tatte vakṣyāmi yatnataḥyasyā vijñānamātreṇa jāḍyāpaharaṇaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhyāsācca bhavedyasya vācaścitrā bhavanti hidvaipāyano'pi yaṃ jñātvā vedavyāso'bhavanmuniḥjaped dvādaśalakṣantu mūko'pi vākpatirbhavettasyopari punardhyāyed devīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ tataḥātmābhedena dhyātvaivaṃ tataḥ sampūjayet kramātāvāhya pūjayet tasyāṃ devīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ tataḥevaṃ sampūjayenmantrī japapūjārataḥ sadāna vismarati medhāvī śrutān vedāgamānapibhīmāṃ saṃprāpya vāksiddhiṃ kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavettatprabhāpaṭalaṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vicintayetkavitvaṃ jñānaśaktyā tu pāṇḍityamadhikaṃ bhavetevaṃ kṛtvā vidhānantu sākṣādvaiśravaṇo bhavetpadmahomena mahatīṃ prāpnuyātśriyamurjjitāmsneha bhāvena samproktaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacitviṣṇunā dattamasmabhyaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ dvijottamagadyapadyamayīṃ brāhmīṃ siddhavidyāprasādaḥbhaktibhāvena te devi kathayāmi śucismitekavitāmatulaiśvaryaṃ dadāti padamuttamamnṛpāṇāṃ vaśyatā caiva jāyate ca tathā priyeṅeyutā caṇḍikā caiva mantraḥ prokto daśākṣaraḥādāvaṅgāni sampūjya śastrapūjā tataḥ paramdikṣu pūjyā imā devyaḥ susiddhāḥ phaladāyikāḥevaṃ sañcintayed devīṃ jāyate narapuṅgavaḥbhujaṅgeṣu yathā tārkṣyaḥ krūrakāryo yathā śaniḥidanta paramaṃ guhyaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ mayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: palāyante mahādevi sādhvasena kṣaṇāttataḥtaṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaṃ devi hṛtkṣobho jāyate ripoḥpalāyante mahādevi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsahasratritayaṃ hutvā vāgīśo jāyate'cirātdurbhagā ca bhavetpatyuḥ subhagātimanoramānīlotpalaiḥ sarojairvā hutvā vai śravaṇāyatedevi sa ripūnnāśayeddhruvamharirvā śaṃkaro vāpi na śakto rakṣituṃ kvacitumābījaṃ hṛllekhābījaṃ cāmuṇḍābījaṃ śyāmābījamacchedyābhedyakāyaḥ syāt ripūṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥiti kātyāyanīkalpaḥyasyāḥ prasādamātreṇa bhaved gaṅgādharaḥ svayamekākṣarīsamā nāsti vidyā tribhuvane priyevināyāsairmahādevi japamātreṇa siddhidācaturvargapradā durgā sarvasattveṣu saṃsthitātryakṣarī vividhā vidyā kathitā brahmaṇā purākālīvadācaredvidyāṃ japedvidyāmaharniśamprajapetparayā bhaktyā durgāṃ durgatināśinīmpūjayetparayā bhaktyā durgā durgatihāriṇīmnānāmāṃsairnānādravyaiḥ pūjayet parameśvarīmtadā bhavenmahāsiddhirnātra kāryā vicāraṇāpraphullakamalārūḍhāṃ dhyāyet tāṃ bhavagehinīmprabhādyāḥ śaktayaḥ pūjyā gandhādyairnavakoṇakesuprabhā vijayā sarvasiddhidā nava śaktayaḥprasaṅgāt kathitā vidyā trailokyadurlabhā priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥvākyantu oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādievaṃ dhyātvā mahādevīmupacāraiḥ prapūjayettato yathāśakti japtvā pūrvavacca samācareditidviṭhāntaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ sadbhirudāhṛtahrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādipīṭhamanvantaṃ sampūjya, punardhyātvāvāhya, devīṃ pūjayettato dhūpādivisarjanāntaṃ karma samāpayetdaśāṃśaṃ homayedājyaiḥ puraścaraṇasiddhayeyasmai kasmai dīyate sa vaśyo bhavati niścitametat pūjādikaṃ saubhāgyavaśyasarvasampatkaramsarvastrīpuruṣavaśaṅkari suyuddhadurghorāṃ hrīṃ svāhāsuyuddhadurghorarāve hrīṃ svāhā astrāya phaṭasyāṅgairlokapālairmātṛkābhistrīṇyāvaraṇānijapantribhuvanavaśyakaraḥjapādau sarvajanasthāne sādhyanāma deyamitiiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādievaṃ dhyātvāvāhya pūjayettato vajrādīnpūjayetājyena tilairayuta homaḥparamā śrīrbhavativiṣamālokanenaiva hanyānnāgakulodbhavampraṇavo bījaṃ, svāhā śaktiḥhṛdayādiṣvevampādakaṭihṛdayavaktramūrddhasu pañcavarṇānnyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayetghṛtāktaiḥ kṛṣṇapuṣpairdaśāṃśahomaḥsvāhāevaṃ dhyānamātreṇa daṣṭo nirviṣyaḥ samutthāya ciraṃ jīvetiti garuḍastotramkiñcidanyat tu devānāṃ sādhanaṃ yadi kathyatāmtatsādhanavidhiṃ vakṣye nṛṇāṃ siddhikaraṃ drutamjayena sādhanaṃ kṛtvā jitaṃ sarvaṃ carācaramekāgracittamādhāya sādhayet sādhanaṃ mahatlakṣajapāt prasannaḥ syāt satyaṃ te kathitaṃ mayādivārātro japaṃ kuryād yāvat sandarśanaṃ bhavetsuprasannastato bhūtvā prayāti sādhakāgrataḥvaraṃ labdhvā sādhakendro viharedātmanaḥ sukhamiti garuḍatantre devīśvarasaṃvāde hanūmatsādhanammūlamantraṃ tato japtvā siñcedādityasaṃkhyayākarāṅganyāsau kuryātiti dhyātvā ṣaṭsahasraṃ japetdaśārṇo'yaṃ manuḥ prokto narāṇāṃ surapādapaḥtatkṣaṇādeva cāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitamsa ca visargabinduyuktaḥ khakāradvayasvarūpaḥpādayoḥ binduśaktaye namaḥdhyānārcane śāradoktavaiśvānaramantravatsarvavedanāñca nāśayetiti mūṣikaviṣaharamantraḥiti mūṣikavināśanamantraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti durgāmantro lūtāviṣaharaḥiti viṣṇumantraḥ sarvakīṭajātiviṣaharaḥityārdrapaṭīmanorathān pūraya hūṃ phaṭ svāhānyāsaśuddhyādikaṃ kiñcinnātra kāryā vicāraṇādhyātvaivaṃ sādhakaḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayenmanasi sthitampūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ kumbhasthāne sthitā imāḥbrāhmyādyaṣṭaśaktīḥ pūrvādikrameṇa pūjayetsaptāhādvairiṇaṃ hanti kālīmantraprayogataḥdakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitvā grāmāderdakṣiṇāmukhaḥoṃ namo hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādismṛtimātreṇa vai mantrī ripūna sarvān vināśayetvā nikhanet, sa unmatto bhavativā nikhanet tasya samastaparivārā naśyantitena śāntirbhavatisahasreṇābhimantritaṃ yasya gehe nikhanet, sa jvareṇa vinaśyativā nikhanet, tasya sarvānnāśayatidattaṃ tasya samvidā nottame nāke aghoroha vairamtuṣṭupchando bandhanādivyasanaparihāre viniyogaḥtato bandhanādvyasanācca mukto bhavati nānyathāsaptabhirdivasairbhūpān vaśayedvidhināmunāvaśyo bhavati sādhyaśca nātra kāryā vicāraṇāvaśyāya sarvajantunāṃ prayogo'yamudāhṛtaḥurvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtātvibhaktairmantravarṇaiśca ṣaḍaṅgānāñca kalpanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amukasyāmukaśāntaye viniyogaḥpāṇyornāsikayoḥ śīrṣe mantravarṇānnyasetkramātguhyorujānupadeṣu nyāsamevaṃ samācaretevaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya arghyasthāpanaṃ kuryātvahnaye vāyave viyate yajamānāyadaugdhaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi punardūrvāstāni vidurbudhāḥsākṣānmṛtyorvimucyeta kimanyāḥ kṣudrikāḥ kriyāḥādhivyādhivinirmukto dīrghamāyuravāpnuyātāmayānakhilāñjitvā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyātdhanadhānyasamṛddhiḥ syādacireṇaiva sidhyatiasya japātsarvasiddhirbhavatidhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt mṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtātasya japāt savasiddhibhavatiyaddṛṣṭaṃ tripurātantre yaddṛṣṭaṃ bhūtaḍāmaresvāhāntaṃ mantra muddhṛtya japed daśasahasrakamākarṣayenna sandehaḥ kiṃ punarmānuṣīmihayāvadāyāti santrastā madanālasavigrahācāmuṇḍā śavavāhinī japavidhau dhyeyā sadā sādhakaiḥyayornāma tayoḥ śīghraṃ vidveṣañca parasparamyasya nāma bhavet tasya vidveṣañca parasparammantrantu saṃpravakṣyāmi mahābhairavasaṃjñakametanmantraṃ likhettatra vidveṣo jāyate dhruvamjñānamātreṇa śatrūṇāṃ vidveṣo jāyate dhruvambhasmanā tena yaṃ hanyādvidveṣastadbhavennṛṇāmyadā mithyā bhaveddevi yogarājaḥ sudurlabhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
