sanskrit: pūrvadravyeṇa vidveṣaṃ kārayedatha sādhakaḥparasparaṃ bhaveddveṣī yogo'yaṃ kubjikāmatedhyānayuktena manasā śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetevaṃ vidhaṃ dhiyā bhāvyaṃ kāryamuccāṭanaṃ ripoḥgopanīyaṃ prayatnena na prakāśyaṃ kadācanahūṃ amukaṃ hana hana svāhāmūlamantreṇa kuryādititataḥ sukhaprasavobhavatimantrayitvāñjayennetre devairapi na dṛśyatedattvā, trailokyādṛśyo bhavatiatiguhyā mahāvidyā devānāmapi durlabhāasyā abhyarcanenaiva rājatvaṃ labhate naraḥkṛtvā ca prajapenmantraṃ niśīthe yāti sundarīsucandanaṃ sumanaso dattvābhilaṣitaṃ vadetbhūpatitvaṃ prārthitaṃ yat tad dadāti dine dinebhātṛvat pālitaṃ loke kāmanābhirmanogataiḥtatsarvaṃ sādhakendrāya nivedayati niścitamanyastrīgamanaṃ tyaktvā anyathā naśyati dhruvampūrvavat sakalakāryaṃ candanairmaṇḍalaṃ likhetgandhaṃ puṣparasañcaiva tāmbūlādīṃśca mūlataḥvaraṃ varaya śīghraṃ rtva yatte manasi varttateprāṇāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṅgañca māyayā ca samācarettato'rcitā prasannā sa puṣṇāti prārthitañca yatsa cāśeṣaṃ vyayaṃ kuryāt sthite tattuna dāsyatiavyāhatagatistasya bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tava snehena bhaktyā ca vaddho'haṃ parameśvariprāṇāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṅgañca māyayātha samācaretarghyamucchiṣṭaraktena dadyāt tasyai dine dinekāyena mamasā vācā pūjayecca dine dineāniśīthaṃ japenmantraṃ baliṃ dattvā manoharamsādhakendro'pi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā dadyādarghyādikaṃ tataḥvastrabhūṣādikaṃ tyaktvā yāti sā nijamandiramātmabhāryāṃ parityajya bhajet tāñca vicakṣaṇaḥvahnerbhāryā mahāmantraḥ sādhakānāṃ sukhāvahaḥevaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ niśīthe yāti sā tadāstrībhāvena tadā tasyai dadyāt pādyādikaṃ tataḥannādyai ratibhogena pativat pālayeta sadāevaṃ pratidinam tasya siddhiḥ syāt kāmarūpataḥvahnijāyāṣṭasahastryaṃ japenmantraṃ dine-dinejñātvā dṛḍhaṃ sādhakendraṃ niśīthe yāti niścitamsusantuṣṭā sādhakendraṃ toṣayed ratibhojanaiḥtyaktvā bhāryāṃ bhajetāñca anyathā naśyati dhruvamsarvatra kuśalaṃ jñātvā yāti sā sādhakālayamtyaktvā bhāryāṃ bhajet tāñca sādhakendraḥ sadā priyejñātvā yāṃ sādhitā vidyā balā cātibalā priyemahāvidyeti kathitāṃ gopanīyā prayatnataḥmūlamantreṇa sakalaṃ kuryācca susamāhitaḥevaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ sahasrañca dine dinegandhacandanatāmbūlaṃ dadyāt tasyai sadā budhaḥsudṛḍhaṃ sādhakaṃ matvā yāti sā sādhakālayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā santoṣayed bhaktyā naṭinī tatatkarotyalamsvarṇaśataṃ siddhidravyaṃ dadāti sā dine dineatītānāgatāṃ vārttāṃ sarvāṃ jānāti sādhakaḥyadyadvāñchati tatsarvaṃ dadāti nātra saṃśayaḥjīvanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet tatra prasannadhīḥevaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ sahasrantu dine dinedhūpadīpavidhānaiśca trisandhyaṃ pūjayenmudāprabhātasamaye yāti sādhakasyāntikaṃ dhruvamcarvyaṃ coṣyādikaṃ dravyaṃ divyaṃ dadāti sā dhruvamānīya dīyate satyaṃ sādhakāśānurūpataḥsādhakāya varaṃ datvā yāti sā nijamandiramreme sārddhaṃ tayā devī sādhakendro dine dinevahnibhāryā manuḥ proktaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥguhyādguhya hyeṣā tava snehātprakīrtitāathādhikāriṇaḥ ke vā samāsena vada prabhosadā dhyānaparo bhhūtvā taddarśanamahotsukaḥanena vidhinā sākṣādbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥiti yoginī sādhana prakaraṇamyantrañca pratimāsthānamarcane sarvadā hareḥkāryā na tu kevalabhūtalekiṃ punaścārcanaṃ tatra harisānnidhyakarāṇammaṇḍalādīnāntu sarvasādhāraṇatvātvā śilāsthāṃ vā pūjayet parameśvarīmetat sarvaṃ yantrābhāvetathādau vilikhed yantraṃ devatāyāśca vigraham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yantramityāhuretasmin devaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥiti yantrasya pūjayāṃ prādhānyamitiidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi pratiṣṭhākarmanirṇayamtasyodyāpanakarmāṅgaṃ sarvavarṇavinirṇayamtoyadhūpāntaraiḥ kuryāt pañcāmṛta vidhiṃ budhaḥkaṣāyajalasampūṛnaiḥ kārayet snānamuttamamaṣṭottaraśataṃ devi devatābhāvasiddhayephalatāmbūlanaivedyairdevīṃ tatra samarcayetsarvametat prayatnena dadyādātmahite rataḥbalidānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇamedyantrarājakamhomakarmaṇya śaktaśced dviguṇaṃ japamācaretgurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tato devyā visarjanamdhanadhānya-putra-pautra-yaśa-āyūṃṣi muñcatiyasya vai mamatā devi putra-pautragṛhādiṣusarvatra snānaṃ mūlamatreṇaviniyogaḥiti prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya devīmāvāhyet tataḥtato dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā acchidrāvadhāraṇaṃ kuryāttantrasāre tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥśuddhāsanaṃ samāsādya bhūtotsāraṇamācaretbaddhapadmāsano mantrī samāhitajitendriyaḥrātro pūjane nāyaṃ nimayaḥśivārcanaṃ sadāpyevaṃ śuciḥ kuryādudaṅmukhaḥśaktidvayaṃ tathā sūryadvayamekatra nārcayeteteṣāmarcanānnityamudvegaṃ prāpnuyādgṛhī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratyekenāthavā devi bilvapatraiḥ prapūjayetśālagrāmaśilāmekāṃ gṛhastho'pi prapūjayetna dūrvayā yajed durgāṃ bilvapatrairdivākaramunmattamarkapuṣpañca viṣṇorvarjya sadā budhaiḥvilvapatraistatprasūnairnārcayeddevakīsutamiti yadbilvavidhānaṃ tadvihitapuṣpābhāveghusṛṇaṃ kumudaṃ raktaṃ hayāriñca visarjayetvāsobhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ nītaṃ matimānnārcayecchivesvayaṃ vikasitairiti puruṣeṇa svayaṃ vikāsitairityarthaḥbhūgataṃ varjayet puṣpaṃ śephālīṃ vakulaṃ vinātamālasya ca padmasya chinnabhinne na dūṣyatidinaikaṃ karavīrāṇi yogyāni ca tapodhananirmālyabhūtaiḥ kusumairucchiṣṭaiḥ parameśvaritulasīghrāṇamātreṇa kruddhā bhavati sundarīmahādevyai yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥnārcayet tu mahādevīṃ kuśakāśodbhavena cana dūṣyecchinna-bhinnañca jātīpuṣpañca śaṅkaribilvairmarūvakādyaiśca tulasīdalavarjitaiḥiti tathāpi tānniyamastu na tripurādauitarāsāntuṃ pūjāyāṃ tadasattve sattve vā na doṣaḥniṣedhaparamna tvarghyādiniṣedhaparamevaṃ na dūrvayā yajed durgāmityādiiti śrīkramīyavākyātkartavyā sarvadevānāṃ bhaktiyogo'tra kāraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: idantu vihitapuṣpābhāve atyanta bhaktiviṣayamapāmārgaiśca bhṛṅgaiśca tulasīvarjitaiḥ śubhaiḥityādi puṣpaniyamo boddhavyaḥtatra setuṃ vinā japasya vyarthatvāttannirūpyatemantrastathaiva niḥsetuḥ kṣaṇāt kṣarati yajvanāmsa cānusvāranādābhyāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ seturucyatepañcaśuddhiṃ vinā pūjā abhicārāya kalpateṣaḍaṅgādyakhilanyāsairātmaśuddhirudīritāpañcavarṇarajobhiśca sthānaśuddhiritīritākramotkramād dvirāvṛttyā mantraśuddhiritīritādarśayeddhenumudrādīn dravyaśuddhiḥ prakīrtitāpañcaśuddhiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ paścātpūjāṃ samācaretpunastenaiva karttavyaṃ tataḥ siddho bhaveddhruvampunastenaiva karttavyaṃ tataḥ siddho na saṃśayaḥupāyāstatra karttavyaḥ sapta śaṃkarabhāṣitāḥdahanāntaṃ kramāt kuryāt tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥuśīracandanābhyāntu mantraṃ saṃgrathitaṃ likhetpūjanājjapanāddhomātbhrāmitaḥ siddhido bhavetevaṃ ruddho bhavet siddho na cedetadvaśīkurudhāryaṃ kaṇṭhe bhavet siddhiḥ pīḍanaṃ vāsya kārayetpīḍito lajjayāviṣṭaḥ siddhaḥ syādatha poṣayetpoṣito'yaṃ bhavet siddho na cetkurvīta śoṣaṇamśoṣitaścāpyasiddhaśceddahanīyo'gnibījataḥkaṇṭhadeśe tato mantraḥ siddhaḥ syācchaṅkaroditamekenaiva kṛtārthaḥ syādbahubhiḥ kimu suvrate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niścitaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syādityuktaṃ tantravedibhiḥprayogo'syākleśasiddhiḥ siddhestu lakṣaṇaṃ paramityādiguṇasampattirmadhyasiddhestu lakṣaṇamsiddhamantrastu yaḥ sākṣāt sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥārādhitā mahāvidyā vīryahīnābhavat tadāśareṇa pīḍitā pūrvaṃ bhuvaneśyāḥ pratiṣṭhitāmayā pratiṣṭhitā vidyā tārā candrasvarūpiṇīchinnā ruddhā ca vṛddhā ca nirvījā śaktihīnakāativṛddhaḥ pīḍitaśca vakṣyāmyeṣāñca lakṣaṇamcaturddhā pañcadhā vāpi sa mantraśchinnasaṃjñakaḥruddhamantraḥ sa vijñeyo bhūktimuktivivarjitaḥśaktihīnaḥ sa kathito yasya madhye na varttateasau parāṅmukhaḥ prokto hakāro bindusaṃyutaḥnetrahīnaḥ sa vijñeyo duḥkha śokāmayapradaḥmāyā namāmi ca padaṃ nāsti yasmin sa kīlitaḥna vidyete sa mantrastu stambhitaḥ siddhivarjitaḥsaptadhā dṛśyate tantu dagdhamantraṃ pracakṣatesrastaḥ sa kathito mantraḥ sarvasiddhivivarjitaḥśivo vā śaktirathavā bhītākhyaḥ sa prakīrttitaḥsa eva malino mantraḥ sarvavighna samanvitaḥastraṃ tiṣṭhati mantraḥ sa tiraskṛta udāhṛtaḥsa eva bhedito mantraḥ sarvaśāstravivarjitaḥtrivarṇo haṃsahīno yaḥ suṣupta udāhṛtaḥtadvadastraṃ sthitaṃ madhye yasya mantraḥ sa mūrcchitaḥvirāme'ṅgasya ye mantro hṛtavīrya sa ucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñātavyo bhīma ityeva yaḥ syādaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥhṛllekhāṃkuśabījāḍhyaḥ pradhvastastaṃ pracakṣateṣoḍaśārṇo yuvā prauḍhaścatvāriṃśallipimanuḥcatuḥśatākṣaraścapi vṛddhaḥ sa parikīrttitaḥśivaśaktyarṇahīno vā sa nirbīja udāhṛtaḥsa mantraḥ siddhihīnaḥ syātmandaḥ paṃktyakṣaro manuḥdvivarṇaḥ sattvahīnaḥ syāccaturvavarṇastu kekaraḥsārddhadvādaśavarṇo'pi dhūmitaḥ satu ninditaḥviṃśatyarṇastriṃśadarṇo yaḥ syādāliṅgitaḥ smṛtaḥkṣudhāttaḥ sa tu vijñeyo caturviṃśativarṇakaḥtrayoviṃśativarṇo vā mantro dṛpta udāhṛtaḥtriṃśadekonavarṇo vā tvaṅgahīnaḥ sa eva hiatikruddhaḥ sa vijñeyo ninditaḥ sarvakarmasuatikrūraḥ sa vijñeyo ninditaḥ sarvakarmasutāvatsaṃkhyā nigaditā mantrāḥ savrīḍasaṃjñakāḥte sarve kathitā mantrāḥ sthānabhraṣṭā na śobhanāḥte sarve vikalā jñeyāḥ śataṃ sārddhaṃ śatantathāyāvat śatatrayaṃ saṃkhyā niḥsnehāste prakīrttitāḥativṛddhaḥ sa mantrastu sarvaśāstravivarjitaḥsiddhirna jāyate tasya kalpakoṭiśatairapite sarve siddhimāyānti mātṛkārṇaprabhāvataḥtadā mantro mahāvidyā yathoktaphaladā bhavetmantravarṇāṃstataḥ kuryāt śodhanaḥ tantrasammatamsahasraṃ prajapenmantrī mantradoṣapraśāntayekṣiptvā cādau śriyañcaiva taddūṣaṇavimuktaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yasya yatra bhavedbhaktaḥ so'pi mantro'sya sidhyatiamṛtatrayasaṃyogādduṣṭamantro'pi sidhyatisumanohara-mekhalāyonyādiviśiṣṭamityarthaḥbhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kuryādyāvadāyatanaṃ bhavetdhanyadhānyakarīṃ vaiśyā śūdrā tu ninditā bhavetśalyādiśodhanaṃ kuryāt pauruṣaṃ vā khanet tataḥdiśi saṅkalpayenmantrī maṇḍapañca vibhāgataḥpañcahastantu ekakuṇḍapakṣetadekakuṇḍaṃ gṛhasyottarabhāge praśastamlakṣahome tu tatkuryāt gṛhamadhye na dūṣaṇamcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ toraṇādyairalaṃkṛtamcaturasrāṃ tato vedīṃ maṇḍalāya prakalpayetkṣetraṃ vibhajya madhye'ṃśe pūrvādi parikalpayetaṣṭāśāsvaṣṭakuṇḍāni ramyākārāṇyanukramātṣaḍasraṃ paṅkajākāramaṣṭāsraṃ tāni nāmataḥsamantātkuṇḍametat tu caturasraṃ śubhāvahamnyaset purastādekāṃśaṃ koṇārddhārddha pramāṇataḥsūtrayugmaṃ tato dadyāt kuṇḍaṃ yoninibhaṃ bhavetarddhacandranibhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyamidaṃ bhavetjyāsūtraṃ pātayedagre śarāvārddhatayā yataḥsūtratrayaṃ budhaḥ kuryāt tryasraṃ kuṇḍamudāhṛtambhrāmayet tena mānena vṛttaṃ kuṇḍamudāhṛtambhāgaṃ nyasedekamekaṃ mānenānena madhyataḥsūtraṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyāt ṣaḍasraṃ kuṇḍamīritamekaṃ bhāgaṃ bahirnyasya bhrāmayet tena varttulam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyathā mānādhikyāpadyeḥtadagrāṇi caturthe syurvṛttānyevaṃ prakalpayediti bhaṭṭaḥaṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍametaddhi tantravidbhirudīritamevaṃ proktāni kuṇḍāni kathyete sruksruvau tataḥśrīparṇī-śiṃśapā-kṣīra-śākhiṣvekatamaṃ guruḥhastamātraṃ bāhumātramviṃśatyaṃśairbhaved daṇḍo vedī tairaṣṭābhirbhavetvedītryaṃśena vistāraḥ kaṇṭhasya parikīrttitaḥkaniṣṭhāṃgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya cavidadhīta bahistasyā ekāṃśenābhito'vaṭamaṃśenaikena parito dalāni parikalpayetdaṇḍamūlāgrayoḥ kumbhau guṇavedāṃgulaiḥ kramātṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavetmukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge'syāḥ samproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ srucaḥdvāviṃśatyā daṇḍamānam aṃśairetasya kīrttitamaṃśadvayena vilikhet paṅke mṛgapadākṛtimgaṇḍī kaṅkaṇakumbhayoriti bhāguriḥvidadhyātvāśvatthapatre saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇitaputrapradaṃ yonikuṇḍamarddhendvābhaṃ śubhapradamdṛṣṭidaṃ rogaśamanaṃ kuṇḍamaṣṭāsramīritammāraṇe ca tathā yojyaṃ varttulaṃ mantribhiḥ sadāuccāṭe cānile kuṇḍaṃ yāmye ca māraṇaṃ bhavetvaiṇyānāmarddhacandrābhaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ tryasramīritamsarvādhikārikaṃ kuṇdaṃ sarvadaṃ caturasrakammānāṃgulena karttavyaṃ nānyenāpi kadācana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajamānasya karttavyaṃ nānyasyāpi kadācanamānakṛdyajamānaḥ syādviduṣāmeva nirṇayaḥmadhyasva dairghyamānena mānāṃgulamudāhṛtampramāṇāṃguṣṭhametat tu sarvakarmaṇi cāpareadīrghayojitairhastaścaturviṃśatibhirbhavetkanyasaṃ ṣaḍbhiruddiṣṭamaṃgulaṃ munisattamaiḥdvihastamayute tacca lakṣahome catuṣkaramdaśahastāt paraṃ kuṇḍaṃ nāsti home mahītalelakṣāṇāṃ daśakaṃ yāvat tāvaddhastena varddhayetsarvakuṇḍeṣu sarvatra varddhayed vidhināmunāpūcche tu dukhasambhūtiḥ kroḍe sarvārthasādhanamsiddhāḥnāgaḥkhātādhike bhavedrogī khātahīne dhanakṣayaḥmekhalārahite śoko hyadhike vittasaṃkṣayaḥapatyadhvaṃsanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kaṇṭhavivarjitamtṛtīyā tāmasī proktā mekhalānāṃ vinirṇayaḥutsedhāyāmato jñeyātvekārddhāṃguli sammitāhastamātramite kuṇḍe vedāgninayanāṃgulāḥcaturhaste tu tā jñeyā vasutarkayugāṃgulāḥvistārotsedhato jñeyā mekhalāḥ sarvato budhaiḥmekhalānāṃ bhavedantaḥ parito nemiraṃgulānābhiyonyorekamānasya dṛṣṭatvātkuryāt gajoṣṭhavattāntu kuṇḍavitsarvalakṣaṇamṣaṭ-caturdvyaṃgulāyāmavistāronnatiśālinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yavadvayapramāṇena yonyagramapi varddhayetbāhyasthamekhalāvāhyasthalādārabhya kārayetsarandhrakamityubhayatra saṃvadhyatemadhyato madhyaparyantamityarthaḥrandhraṃ kuryāt tathā vidvān dvitīyamekhaloparibahiraṃśadvayenāṣṭau patrāṇi parikalpayetnamo'nta iti paurāṇikamantraparamna tu oṃ ādityāya namaḥ, etat pādyaṃ sūryāya namaḥ ityāditenasvāhāntamantre svāhāntaraṃ na vaktavyampañcāṃgulaṃ bahistyaktvā dhārayet śaṅkhamudrayetianukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyatevibhūtiñcāgnikāryeṇa sarvasiddhiñca vindatibalivaiśyādikañcaiva brāhmaṇaḥ samupācarethutvā stutvā namaskṛtya visṛjedindumaṇḍalepūrvādidikkrameṇaiva tato homaṃ samācaretkuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ saṃskṛtetenaiva prokṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ matamudagagreṣu brahmavaivasvatendūnpūjayetevaṃ krameṇa pūjayettato homaṃ prakūrvīta devatāsannidhānataḥpuṣpāñjalīn dadyāt, sundarī pakṣe tu bālayātato raṃ vahnyāsanāya namaḥsundarī pakṣe tu kāmeśvaraṃ kāmeśvarīṃ pūjayetśrotriyāṇāṃ gehajañca vanasthaṃ vāthavā harettasmāt sarvaprayatnena vahnimuktaṃ samāharet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: huṃ-phaḍantena mūlena kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajetātmano'bhimukhaṃ devyā yonāvenaṃ kṣipetsuvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukham ityupatiṣṭhetvajrādyastrebhyo namaḥsvāheti agnimukhetataḥ saṃkalpaṃ vidhāya tattatkalpoktadravyeṇa homaṃ kuryātiti saṃkṣepahomavidhiḥtato homaṃ prakurvīta devatāsannidhānataḥtato mūlamuccārya oṃ kuṇḍāya namaḥ iti kuṇḍaṃ sampūjayethuṃphaḍantena mūlena kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajetmantreṇa vahniṃ jvālayetityanena vahnimupatiṣṭhetetāḥ sāttvikayāgakarmaṇinyāsantu bījayogena pūrvavat karmabhedena sarvatra boddhavyaḥvahnimantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā jihvānāṃ saptadeśikaiḥevaṃ hṛdayādiṣu sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādisarvatra ādau praṇavaḥtārādyagnipadādyāḥ syurnatyantā vahnimūrttayaḥjaṭābhiḥbrahmādidevatāḥ pūjyāḥkrūre sarayūṃ viśvamūrtaye namaḥ ityādibahurūpā yathākhyātā dakṣiṇottara saṃsthitāsvasvadikṣu pūjayetsthāpayettaddarbhayugmaṃ agnau visarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantreṇa tatkuśābhyāṃ ātmasammukhe dhṛtasamplavaṃ kuryāthomaṃ kuryātsarvatrāhutisampātaḥ pātrāntaresampādayetśubheṣu syurdhvivāhāntā mṛtvyantoḥ krūrakarmasuiti pratikarmāṇi krameṇājyāhutīrjuhuyāt360) ityekaikāhutiṃ dadyāt, iti kalpasūtrapratipāditamjuhuyātvauṣaḍityanena juhuyātmanunā gāṇapatyena hunetpūrvaṃ daśāhutīḥvicintya pañcopacārādibhiḥ pūjayetpūjayāmīti viśeṣaḥviśeṣaḥyataḥ samastasiddhīnāṃ sāvitrī bahurūpiketiuccāṭane'tiraktākhyā bahurūpā susiddhidāsarve mantrāḥ prasiddhyanti mudrāmantraprayogataḥagnerjihvāṅgamūrttīnāmekaikāhutiṃ dadyātnaimittike dahenmantrī nitye na tu dahedimānalābhe dakṣiṇā jñeyā gurusantoṣakāriṇītiśataṃ vā juhuyātiti vṛhaddhomapaddhatiḥmātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā kṛtamśayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇṇaṃ śeṣavastuṣunāsikāyāṃ manaḥpīḍāmastake dhanasaṃśayaḥyatra prajvalitā jvālā sā jihvā jātavedasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suvarṇaretaso varṇaḥ śobhanaḥ parikīrttitaḥpāvakasya śubho gandha ityuktastantravedibhiḥsukhadā yajamānasya rājyasyāpi viśeṣataḥpūtigandho hutabhujyo hoturduḥkhaprado bhavetsarvatantrānusāreṇa prayogaphalasiddhidammāraṇāntāni śaṃsanti ṣaṭkarmāṇi manīṣiṇaḥvaśyaṃ janānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidheyatvamudīritamsnigdhānāṃ dveṣajananaṃ mitho vidveṣaṇaṃ matamsvadevatādikkālādīn jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayetṣaṭkarmadevatāḥ proktāḥ karmādau tāḥ prapūjayetbasantagrīṣmavarṣākhya-śaraddhemantaśaiśirāḥprāvṛṭkālo'parāhnaḥ syāt pradoṣaḥ śiśira smṛtaḥturyayāme ca varṣākhyaḥ śaradastaṃ gate ravaujñeya śaranmāraṇakarmaṇipaurṇamāsī mandabhānau vijñeyā dveṣakarmaṇiuccāṭane tithiḥ śastā pradoṣe ca viśeṣataḥmanda bhaumadinopetā śastā māraṇakarmaṇipaurṇamāsī tu vijñeyā tithiḥ stambhanakarmaṇirodrakarmaṇi riktārke mṛtyuyoge ca māraṇampaścime stambhanaṃ vidyāduttare śāntikaṃ bhavettathābhicāre kāryā ca dakṣiṇaplavanā mahībhūṣaṇaṃ lauhadravyeṇa vāmena pūjanādikamakṣamālāṃ samālokya vidveṣoccāṭane japetvajraṃ bhadrakamityāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥanyāni vaktavyāni
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūṣalāśanikhaḍgākhyāḥ śāntikādiṣu karmasuuccāṭane smṛto vāyurbhūyo'gnirmāraṇe smṛtaḥtattatkarma vidhātavyaṃ mantriṇā niścitātmanāvarṇāḥ syurmantra bījāni ṣaṭkarmasu yathākramamyogaḥ pallava ityete vinyāsāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasugrathanaṃ tadvijānīyāt praśastaṃ śāntikarmaṇividarbha eṣa vijñeyo mantribhirvaśyakarmaṇieṣa syāt stambhane śasta ityukto mantravedibhiḥvidveṣaṇavidhāneṣu praśastamidamuttamamante nāmno bhavenmantraḥ pallavo māraṇe mataḥvarṇato mantrasaṃproktā devatāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasugṛha dhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudīritamṣaṭkarmāṇi prayuñjayota yathoktaphalasiddhayestambhane ca namaḥ proktaṃ svāhā śāntikapauṣṭikeiti viśeṣavacanāddhome'pyayaṃ vidhiḥsarvakāryeṣu sauvarṇaṃ krūre syāt pretakarpaṭamsarvakārye'ṣṭagandhaḥ syāt krūre cāṣṭaviṣāṇi cahemnā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi krūre syāt kākapucchikādevālaye ca sarvāṇi śmaśāne krūrakarma cakṣveḍādināśane śastamudaye ca vihāyasaḥpītā bhūmirityādinacetphalañca nāpnoti devatāśāpamāpnuyātevaṃ sarvatra vijñeyamanyathā viphalaṃ bhavetīḍe sakalasampattyai jagatkāraṇamambikāmvimalayāmyahamambike tvām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parivartanaṃ yatsvadṛṣṭyāsthitāsipunaḥ patantikhalvaśeṣabhuvanādibhuvaḥ prathantekhamaśnuvānāgarbhabhājaḥgauri mūrttimbhuvaneśvari yoginastvāmbhavāni durgāpulindataruṇīmasakṛtsmarāmividadhe tavāṃghrītavānatosmivilaṅghayetāmkadāpi nāhameva jātaḥpurāṇapāśaḥpādanamrakṣitipamukuṭalakṣmīlakṣaṇānāṃ cirāyaśrutāścādhigatāḥ sarvāḥ śrotumicchāmi sāṃpratamtrailokya maṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ mantravigrahampaṭhanāddhāraṇānmartyastrailokyaiśvaryabhāgbhavetdharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥaiṃ pātu dakṣanetraṃ me hrīṃ pātu vāmalocanamvāmakarṇaṃ sadā pātu aiṃ ghrāṇaṃ pātu me sarvadāvākpuṭā ca trivarṇātmā kaṇṭhaṃ pātu parātmikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: klīṃ karau tripuṭeśānī tripuraiśvaryadāyinīkrauṃ pātu nābhideśaṃ me tryakṣarī bhuvaneśvarīhrīṃ pātu guhyadeśa me namobhagavati kaṭimannapūrṇā sadā pātu svāhā pātu padadvayamtāraṃ māyā ramā kāmaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇāstataḥ paramtāraṃdurgeyugaṃrakṣaṇīsvāheti ca daśākṣarīmāyābījādikā caiṣā daśarṇā ca tataḥ parātāraṃ hrīṃ duṃ ca durgāyai namo'ṣṭārṇātmikā parāmahiṣamardini svāhā vasuvarṇātmikā parāmāyā padmāvatī svāhā saptārṇā parikīrttitāpāśāṃkuśa puṭā māyehi parameśvari svāhāsarasvati paṃcasvare nityaklinne madadravetāraṃ māyā tu kavacaṃ khe rakṣetsatataṃ vadhūḥtvaritāṣṭāhibhiḥ pāyācchivakoṇe sadā ca māmabiṃdvantā bhairavī bālā bhūmau māṃ sarvadā'vatusārātsārataraṃ puṇyaṃ mahāvidyaughavigrahampuṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ dattvāmūlenaiva sakṛtpaṭhetprītimanyonyataḥ kṛtvā kamalā niścalā gṛheyo dhārayati puṇyātmā trailokyamaṅgalābhidhamsarvaiśvaryayuto bhūtvā trailokyavijayī bhavetbahuputravatī bhūyādvandhyāpi labhate sutametat kavacamajñātvā yo bhajedbhuvaneśvarīmdāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya so'cirānmṛtyumāpunyātnamo bhaktipriye devi hyannapūrṇe namo'stu temāheśvari namastubhyamannapūrṇe namo'stu te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalākāṣṭhāsvarūpe ca hyannapūrṇe namo'stu tecandradūḍe mahādevi hyannapūrṇe namo'stu teśivanṛtyakṛtāmode hyannapūrṇe namo'stu tebrahmāṇyādisvarūpe ca hyannapūrṇe namo'stu tesarvānandakare devi hyannapūrṇe namo'stu tekucabhāranate devi hyannapūrṇe namo'stu tesarvasampatprade devi hyannapūrṇe namo'stu tetasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīrjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥtasyaivānnasamṛddhiḥ syādbarddhamānā dine dineprakāśāt siddhihānistadgopāyedyatnataḥ sudhīḥkṛpayā kathitāḥ sarvāḥ śrutāścādhigatā mayātrailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ mantravigrahampaṭhanāddhāraṇānmarttyastrailokyaiśvaryabhāgbhavetdharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥhrīṃ namo bhagavatyante māheśvari padaṃ tataḥpātu māmannapūrṇā sā yā khyātā bhuvanatrayepātvannapūrṇā sarvāṅge ratnakumbhānnapātradāpraṇavādyā bhruvau pātu kaṇṭhaṃ vāgbījapūrvikātāraṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ ca namonte ca bhagavatīpadaṃ tataḥnābhimekārṇaviṃśarṇā pāyānmāheśvarī sadāśiraḥsthā sarvadā pātu viṃśatyarṇātmikā parādhvajañca sarvadā pātu viṃśatyarṇātmikā ca yāśiraḥ śrīṃ hrīṃ tathā klīṃ ca tripuṭā pātu me gudamindro māṃ pātu pūrve ca vahnikoṇe'nalo'vatupaścime varuṇaḥ pātuvāyavyāṃ pavano'vatustathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvādhaḥ pātu satataṃ brahmānanto yathā kramātiti te kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ trailokyarakṣaṇaṃ parambrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca dhāraṇātpaṭhanādyataḥpuṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ devyai mūlenaiva samarpayetvāṇī vaktre vaset tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥbhūrje vilikhya guṭikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayedyadimālyāni kusumānyeva sukhadāni bhavanti hibhāvayāminarāsteprāpnuvantinarendrāḥteṣāmdurgrahāstāṃstyajantisaṃvicintyasuvakṣojanabhrāmdadhānāṃ bṛhadratna bhūṣāṃ sumadhyāṃ sukāñcīmdhṛtābhiḥtriśaktiṃ bhajāmipāmaro'pibhavet saḥlabhenmānavo'pijagadvāyurūpāprasīdaprasīdaprasīda
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasīdasarvārthasādhanaṃ nāma kathayasva mayi prabhosarvārthasādhanaṃ nāma trailokye cātidurlabhampaṭhanāddhāraṇānmarttyastraislokaiśvaryabhāgbhavetdharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitahrīṃ pātu dakṣanetraṃ me vāmanetraṃ sureśvarīlakṣmīrghrāṇaṃ sadā pātu vadanaṃ keśavaḥskandhadeśa ratiḥ pātu bhujau tu makaradhvajaḥbrāhmī kukṣiṃ sadā pātu nābhi pātu maheśvarīvārāhī sakthinī pātu aindrī pātu padadvayamindraḥ pūrve sadā pātu āgneyāmagnidevatāpaścime varuṇaḥ pātu vāyavyāṃ vāyudevatāūrdhvaṃ prajāpatiḥ pātu adhaścānantadevatātriśaktiśca mahālakṣmīḥ sarvatra māṃ sadāvatusarvārthasādhanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutamsarvasiddhiśvarāḥ santaḥ sarvaiśvaryamavāpnuyuḥsaṃvatsarakṛtāyāstu pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyātvāṇī ca nivasadvaktre satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥsarvaiśvaryayuto bhūtvā trailokyavijayī bhavetbahuputravatī bhūtvā bandhyāpi labhate sutamdāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya so'cirānmṛtyumāpnuyātasya prasādamātreṇa durgā prītā bhavet satīāryā durgā jayā ādyā trinetrā śūladhāriṇīanantā bhāvinī bhāvyā bhavyā'bhavyā sadāgatiḥsarvavidyā dakṣakanyā dakṣayajñavināśinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṭṭāmbaraparīdhānā kalamañjīrarañjinīvanadurgā ca mataṅgī mataṅgamunipūjitācāmuṇḍā caiva vārāhī lakṣmīśca puruṣākṛtiḥbahulā bahulapremā sarvavāhanavāhanāmadhukaiṭabhahantrī ca caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinīsarvaśāstramayī vidyā sarvāstradhāriṇī tathākumārī caika kanyā ca kaiśorī yuvatī yatiḥmahādevī muktakeśī ghorarūpā mahāphalāagnijvālā raudramukhī kālarātristapasvinīnārāyaṇī bhadrakālī viṣṇumāyā jalodarīkātyāyanī ca sāvitrī pratyakṣā brahmavādinīnāsādhyaṃ vidhate devi triṣu lokeṣu pārvaticaturaṅgaṃ tathā cānte lābhenmuktiñca śāśvatīmpūjayet parayā bhaktyā paṭhannāmaśatāṣṭakamrājāno dāsatāṃ yānti rājyaśriyamavāpnuyātvilikhya yantraṃ vidhinā vidhijño, bhavetsadā dhārayate purāriḥvilikhya prapaṭhet stotraṃ sa bhavet sampadā pradampaṭhitvā dhārayitvā ca naro mucyeta saṅkaṭātsa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya pare ca narakaṃ vrajetgopanīyaṃ prayatnena sāvadhānāvadhārayacakṣuṣo khecarī pātu karṇau catvaravāsinījihvāṃ ca caṇḍikā pātu grīvāṃ saubhadrikā tathākaṇṭha pātu mahāvāṇī jaganmātā stanadvayamkaṭiṃ bhagavatī devī dvāvūrū vindhyavāsinīrakṣa māṃ sarvagātreṣu durge devi namo'stu te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00013 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhetbhūtapretapiśācebhyo bhayantasya na vidyatesarvatra pūjāmāpnoti devīputra iva kṣitauprāptānantarasārṇave mama manohaṃsaściraṃ nandatukarivairiṇa kimaribhirbhītirbhavatsevināmyojacumbanaparaṃ māmadya sambhāvayaśrīmatpādapayojacintanavidhau cittaṃ sadaivāstu naḥmaccitte'kṣatasampadaṃ prasaratu kṣemaṅkari kṣamyatāmnāsvāditaḥśrīmadbhaktirasātidurddinaparīvāhaḥ sadā sarpatuprodbhinnāñjana nīlanīradamahaścitte sadaivāstu naḥdṛṣyaddaivatavairidāraṇapaṭurjīyājjayāhlādinīkhaṇḍavikhaṇḍatākhilaśakuntakṣutpipāsojjvalecāruṇāṅgane raṇamudā ghūrṇāyamānāṃ smaretskhaladvīrāsphālalasatkarālavadanāṃ ghorāṭṭahāsodbhaṭāmsvayaṃ jāyatehastagatā bhavanti jagatāṃ mātarnamaste jayaḥyasya prasādamāsādya bhavetsākṣātsadāśivaḥprapaṭhetkavacaṃ nityaṃ mantravarṇasya siddhayeādyāśaktirdevatā caturvargaphalaprāptaye viniyogaḥmakāraḥ pātu māṃ devī cakṣuryugme maheśvarīṣakāraḥ pātu māṃ śvetā jihvāyāñcāparājitārddikāraḥ pātu māṃ devī sāvitrī kālanāśinīśikhāyāṃ kavace pāde mukhe jaṅghāyuge tathākāmādyā pātu māṃ svāhā sarvāṅge marddinī śiraḥ
